Title: Medior Data Scientist / Machine Learning Engineer
Description:
Join Allianz Direct!

The machine learning engineering chapter at Allianz Direct is a global team consisting of experienced data scientists / machine learning engineers that have been pioneering new use cases in insurance and building a modern machine learning platform. The team is responsible for the development, deployment, and maintenance of machine learning models in all 5 countries where Allianz Direct is currently active. We are looking for a medior data scientist / ML engineer to grow the team in Rotterdam, to build and deploy machine learning solutions end-to-end to serve business needs.

You Will Get To


Work with experienced data scientists / ML engineers and focus on building one or two machine learning solutions at a time. Develop your models end-to-end, from ideation with business stakeholders to deployment and monitoring.
Dive into a range of challenging modelling problems around our pricing engine, claim processes, customer contact center and operations. You can expect to tackle problems using classification, regression, anomaly detection, survival modelling, time series and large language models.
Utilize our mature next generation data platform hosted on Databricks, containing well organized data across all Allianz Direct countries.
Help to extend our machine learning platform used for development and deployment of a range of models, in both batch and API inference modes.
Collaborate with dev engineers to embed a deployed model into company processes.
Contribute to our continuously evolving way of working and internal packages, as well as benefit from and contribute to our weekly knowledge sharing sessions.
Work on a modern tech stack. We use Python, Databricks, AzureML, MLflow and can leverage shared compute for large training jobs.
Work together with diverse international colleagues based in Spain, Netherlands, Germany, Italy, and France.


Your Profile


Located in the Netherlands, since this hybrid role requires working with the team at the office location in Rotterdam.
Academic degree (MSc or PhD), preferably in a relevant technical field such as computer science, data science, physics, econometrics, or engineering.
A strong foundation in machine learning fundamentals. You know how to properly apply a wide range of algorithms for classification, regression, and other predictive problems.
At least 3 years of experience in a similar data science or ML engineering role.
A love for coding. Programming experience in Python is required and you are familiar with libraries like pandas/scikit-learn, and have experience doing hyper parameter tuning for a diverse set of models including boosting models.
Experience with MLOps on Databricks or experience within the insurance business are a strong plus.
You are a self-learner. You are eager to keep developing and improving, and stay on top of the latest developments. You enjoy both sharing knowledge and learning from others.
Fluent in English. Able to communicate complex topics in a clear and precise manner to audiences with different backgrounds and at different levels.


What We Offer

At Allianz Direct you will find yourself in an inspiring working environment where there is plenty of room to set up your own initiatives, in an international scope. We believe that success starts with satisfied employees. That's why we offer you:


An attractive monthly salary based on knowledge and experience, starting at €5200.00 (based on full-time employment of 38 hours).
A bonus of 12.5% of your gross annual salary and 8% holiday allowance.
An NS business card which you can also use privately, or a travel allowance (€0.23/km).
Flexible working: 60/40 home/office, for which you will receive a home working allowance of up to €40.00 per month.
Vacation days: 25 for full-time employment. You can get up to 38 vacation days per year for 40 hours per week.
A pension plan with a small personal contribution of only 3.5%.
An annual contract with the intention of a permanent contract.
A prime office location in the heart of Rotterdam, close to shops and restaurants.
Festive moments are celebrated: an extensive end-of-year drinks party and a fun summer party.
Discount on Allianz Direct insurance products.


We invest in your personal and professional growth so that you can be successful in your work and beyond.

About Us

Allianz Direct is Europe's leading digital insurer. We are building a fully data-driven organization in which technology, automation, and customer experience are central. As ML engineer, you will play a key role in realizing that ambition. You will ensure that the available data is used intelligently to continuously improve our products, processes, and customer interactions.

Curious about what we can offer you as ML engineer? Then we invite you to apply immediately!

Description:
Sia is a next-generation, global management consulting group born digital, augmented by data, enhanced by creativity, and driven by responsibility. We partner with clients to resolve challenges and capitalize on opportunities. We believe that in today’s world of change and disruption, optimism is a force multiplier.

Job Description

The Amsterdam Data Science team is diverse, dynamic, and rapidly growing. You will collaborate closely within multidisciplinary teams, applying advanced analytics and machine learning techniques to solve complex business problems and deliver impactful solutions. Our flat structure encourages initiative, entrepreneurial spirit, diversity, well-being, and knowledge sharing so that we grow together.

Responsibilities

As a Data Science Consultant, you will collaborate with our Data Scientists, Data Engineers, and Consultants on various client projects in multidisciplinary teams. You will use advanced analytics, machine learning, and GenAI techniques to solve complex business problems and deliver impactful solutions.

Responsibilities include:


Collaborate with colleagues to identify business challenges and extract actionable insights from data.
Develop and implement statistical models, optimization solutions, and advanced machine learning techniques.
Apply Generative AI and large language models to create innovative solutions.
Clearly present analytical results and assist in facilitating client workshops.


Your profile


Motivated, analytical, and eager to learn.
Thrive in collaborative, multidisciplinary environments.
Clear communicator, comfortable translating complex technical concepts into actionable recommendations.

Completed WO Master's degree in Data Science, Econometrics, Applied Mathematics, Computer Science, (Energy) Engineering, or a related technical field involving substantial programming.
1 to 3 years of relevant professional experience.
Strong coding skills in Python and at least one additional analytical language (e.g., R, SQL).
You have a strong interest in data and AI-related topics, the ability to quickly build expertise in these areas, and you’re excited about helping our clients seize the opportunities they offer.
Solid knowledge of Machine Learning techniques, optimization methods, and Generative AI.
Previous exposure or interest in cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) is a plus.
Fluent in English and Dutch, both written and oral. Additional languages are considered advantageous.

Training and development opportunities to advance your expertise.

Opportunities to participate in international projects.
Flexible working hours and performance-based promotion.
Competitive salary, bonus, and benefits package (health insurance, pension).

Title: Data Science & Machine Learning Engineering Consultant – Strategy & Consulting
Description:
The work

If you’re looking for an exciting career working in a vibrant environment where you will be supported by a global network of experts, this could be the role for you!

As a Data Science & Machine Learning Engineering Consultant, you will be in our AI & Data team, which is part of the Strategy & Consulting practice. You will work directly with our clients in the Netherlands and sometimes also abroad to advise them on their data challenges. Your work can vary from advice on the big data platform and architecture they (need to) work on, to building scalable AI solutions by making use of state-of-the art technologies. As part of your day to day activities, you will be working with the largest big data vendors in the world and the top clients in the Netherlands and abroad.

People:



Partner with clients to identify the most suitable data solutions and understand their specific needs to define solution architecture designs.

Build long-term relationships with key stakeholders, ensuring effective communication and alignment of objectives.

Collaborate closely with clients to define solution architecture designs that meet their business requirements.



Processes:



Analyze large, complex datasets and prepare them for various data science use cases, ensuring data quality and relevance.

Develop scalable data pipelines and machine learning solutions, optimizing data flow, and ensuring efficient processing.

Drive the productionization of machine learning models in cloud environments, following established best practices.

Build GenAI-powered applications or intelligent AI agents that support decision-making or automate processes.



Technology and Data:



Design and build scalable data pipelines and machine learning solutions using appropriate technologies and frameworks.

Apply a diverse array of machine learning techniques to extract insights and deliver value from data.

Develop production-ready code for machine learning models and ensure successful deployment and management in cloud platforms.



With all our roles, there is in-person time for collaboration, learning and building relationships with clients, peers, leaders, and communities. As an employer, we will be as flexible as possible to support your specific work/life needs.

Who We Are

In today’s world, business leaders want to reinvent rapidly and confidently to increase resilience, mitigate risk, and grow with sustainable value. That’s where Accenture Strategy & Consulting comes in. We bring together strategic visionaries, industry experts, practitioners from across every enterprise function, business intelligence professionals, change specialists, data and AI authorities, and many other specialized skills to co-create each client’s unique path to reinvention. You will be a trusted partner to business leaders, working with a diverse team of experts to deliver successful tech-enabled transformation and new kinds of value for your clients. Join our global network of people using the latest assets, platforms and partnerships to help bring ideas to life.

Accenture Applied Intelligence is driving these exciting changes across 40 industries and in more than 120 countries, covering skills that range from strategy development to data science professionalization. Our advice is based on best practice and situational analysis and enables our clients to act with speed and confidence. Whether we are investigating complex issues or identifying new opportunities, our work always comes down to one thing: unlocking value and creating real, tangible impact.

Strategy & Consulting is one of five services that make up one Accenture – the others are Operations, Technology, Song and Industry X.

Here’s What You’ll Need



Master’s degree in a quantitative field (Mathematics, Physics, Computer Science, Engineering or Econometrics, Business Analytics, or Information Management) with a specific emphasis on data.

3+ years of professional experience in creating and maintaining data pipeline architectures, identify data related process improvements and build tools that enable data science activities.

You know your way around relevant programming languages (SQL, Python, R, etc.), Machine Learning techniques (Neural Networks, Random Forest, etc.), Cloud computing (Azure, AWS, or GCP) and ML frameworks (PyTorch, Tenserflow, etc.).

Familiar with Git, DevOps principles, command line, Spark, Docker and API frameworks

You have proven affinity with data.

You have strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

You have good communication skills.

You can translate business requirements into data solutions.

You have excellent stakeholder management skills.



Practical information

To consider your application, please submit your CV along with a motivation letter. You can upload all of these documents under the CV section.

What’s in it for you?

Accenture is a global company with a world-class brand and reputation. Our people are Change Makers, and to support them as an employer, we make five promises:



Work with flexibility, in a culture based on trust.

Embrace a sustainable growth mindset.

Live a human-led culture of Inclusion & Diversity by caring deeply for all our people.

Lead and transform our clients with technology.

Connect with our global network of 700.000 colleagues.



These promises are reflected through our excellent employee benefits, including:



Flexible working hours (4x9) & work location

Paid leave: Parental leave, Partner leave for all non-birthing parents, Bereavement leave, and Gender affirmation leave.

Paid transport (budget for electric bicycle or car, NS-Business card)

Pension scheme, Accenture shares, annual bonus, collective health insurance scheme

Social activities like Friday Drinks, sport events and parties



What We Believe

Accenture is an equal opportunity employer. Our leaders are committed to building a better, stronger and more equitable company for future generations to create positive, long-lasting change. Inclusion and diversity are fundamental to our culture and core values. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. Our rich diversity makes us more innovative and creative, which helps us better serve our clients and our communities.

Our position as partner to many of the world’s leading businesses, organizations and governments affords us both an extraordinary opportunity and a tremendous responsibility to make a difference. Sustainability is one of our greatest responsibilities, which we embed it into everything we do and for everyone we work with.

Accenture is committed to providing equal employment opportunities for all.

Title: AI Solution Lead
Description:
Functieomschrijving

Stel je voor: jij mag richting geven aan de AI-koers van een bedrijf dat al 128 jaar succesvol is. Geen bestaande blauwdruk, geen eindeloze goedkeuringslagen. Wél een schone lei en steun van de directie. Word je daar enthousiast van? Lees dan snel verder.

Wat ga je doen?

Je vertaalt complexe vraagstukken uit de business en operatie naar slimme AI- en dataoplossingen. Je verbindt mensen, herkent kansen die anderen missen en realiseert oplossingen die écht waarde toevoegen. Geen pilots die in een la verdwijnen, maar toepassingen die dagelijks het verschil maken.

Een voorbeeld. Een bemanningslid aan boord van een van onze schepen is midden op de oceaan ziek geworden. Wat moet er gebeuren? Het antwoord staat keurig beschreven in de HSEQ-documentatie, maar waar precies? Dankzij een slimme AI-engine verschijnt dat antwoord met één druk op de knop. Of neem het brandstofverbruik van onze schepen. Hoe kunnen we data en AI gebruiken om zo efficiënt mogelijk te varen en weerstanden van wind en water te beperken?

Als AI Solution Lead bedenk, prioriteer, ontwerp, implementeer en beheer je data- en AI-oplossingen die verschil maken binnen ons internationale, logistieke familiebedrijf. Je speelt een sleutelrol in het bouwen van een datagedreven en AI-gedreven organisatie en werkt op het snijvlak van business, operations, OT en IT. Je bent niet alleen een inhoudelijke expert, maar ook een verbinder. Iemand die mensen, kennis en technologie samenbrengt tot oplossingen die werken. Je luistert scherp, denkt strategisch en weet anderen mee te nemen in wat er mogelijk is.

Waarom wij?


Je krijgt de ruimte om iets nieuws op te bouwen, van fundament tot toepassing.
We bieden studiemogelijkheden die aansluiten bij jouw talent en loopbaanwensen.
We hebben veel aandacht voor een goede werk-privébalans.
Je krijgt een prima salaris en goede secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden, zoals een 13e maand en gratis boottickets naar Ameland en Schiermonnikoog.
Een werkplek die vanaf Groningen met de auto en met de trein in een halfuur te bereiken is.


Wie ben jij?


Je hebt een wo-denk- en werkniveau.
Je hebt een afgeronde opleiding in bijvoorbeeld Artificial Intelligence, Econometrie of Wiskunde.
Je hebt minimaal drie jaar relevante werkervaring binnen Data Science, AI, Analytics of vergelijkbare vakgebieden en ervaring met IoT-, OT- of industriële omgevingen.
Je hebt kennis van Machine Learning, Predictive en Advanced Analytics, time-series analyses en moderne cloud- en data-architecturen en -platformen.
Je hebt sterke analytische skills en een oplossingsgerichte houding en beschikt over overtuigingskracht, nieuwsgierigheid en het vermogen om complexe vraagstukken eenvoudig uit te leggen.

Title: Lead Data Science
Description:
Iedere dag verschuiven we bij Zonneplan honderden MWh duurzame energie van momenten van overaanbod naar momenten van tekort. Als Lead Data Scientist bepaal jij hoe we dat nog slimmer doen. Je bouwt zelf mee aan de voorspellings- en optimalisatiemodellen die onze energiehandel en asset-aansturing aansturen, en je zorgt dat die modellen betrouwbaar in productie draaien. Tegelijkertijd coach je een team van data scientists: je helpt ze groeien, bewaakt de kwaliteit van hun werk en zorgt dat kennis wordt gedeeld.

Je werkt in team Trading & Optimization, waar diepgaande domeinkennis en technische slagkracht samenkomen. Je krijgt verantwoordelijkheid en vrijheid om je eigen projecten te leiden, met korte lijnen naar software engineering, data engineering en trading. We sturen meer dan 200 megawatt aan batterijen, zonnepanelen en laadpalen aan, en doen dat steeds beter. Dat is niet alleen financieel interessant, het is precies wat de energietransitie nodig heeft. Door assets slimmer aan te sturen maken we ze aantrekkelijker om in te investeren. Dat creëert schaal, en schaal is uiteindelijk het enige wat echt klimaatimpact oplevert. Zo dragen we direct bij aan plan Zero.

Jouw impact bij Zonneplan


Jij bouwt en verbetert de modellen die onze energiehandel aansturen. Je werkt 40 tot 60 procent van je tijd hands-on aan forecasting- en optimalisatiemodellen. Je schrijft productie-ready Python-code, doet code reviews en zorgt dat experimenten die werken snel en stabiel naar productie gaan.
Jij verankert de data science lifecycle binnen het team. Je richt een werkbare MLOps-werkwijze in zodat de weg van experiment naar productie korter wordt en minder handmatig. Je monitort model drift en performance, en stuurt bij waar nodig. Als een model niet presteert, trek je het terug.
Jij laat het team data scientists groeien. Je coacht, begeleidt en beoordeelt het team via 1-op-1's, ontwikkelplannen en functioneringsgesprekken. Je zorgt dat iedereen een eigen specialisatie heeft én voldoende context in aangrenzende domeinen om mee te denken, te reviewen en in te vallen.
Jij vertaalt business-vragen naar realistische trajecten. Je werkt nauw samen met de Product Lead T&O en business stakeholders om scope, prioriteit en verwachtingen helder te houden. Je schat kans van slagen en doorlooptijd realistisch in, zodat het team focust op wat echt waarde oplevert.


Dit krijg je van ons


Een salaris tussen €5.000 en €7.000 bruto per maand, afhankelijk van je kennis en ervaring.
25 vakantiedagen (met de mogelijkheid om er meer bij te kopen) en reiskostenvergoeding.
Een persoonlijk keuzebudget voor sport, boodschappen of iets anders dat bij je past.
Vanaf dag één investeren we in jouw groei met de Zonneplan Academy, goede tools en ruimte om te blijven leren.
Een team waarin domeinkennis en technische diepgang samenkomen. Samen met de netbeheerders pakken we netcongestie aan, een probleem met grote maatschappelijke gevolgen waar woningbouw en hele regio's op vastlopen. Dat is waar je aan meewerkt.


Dit neem jij mee


Je hebt aantoonbare ervaring met het ontwikkelen, evalueren en in productie zetten van data science modellen, niet alleen met experimenteren.
Je schrijft productieklare Python en bent gewend aan de volledige lifecycle: van experiment en ontwikkeling tot monitoring en verbetering.
Je hebt ervaring met timeseries data en voorspellingsmodellen.
Je hebt data scientists of een klein technisch team begeleid en weet hoe je mensen laat groeien door coaching, feedback en kennisdeling.
Je denkt en werkt op WO-niveau en bent pragmatisch en resultaatgericht: hypotheses snel toetsen, kansloze richtingen tijdig afkappen en werkende oplossingen naar productie brengen.


Zo ziet het proces eruit


1. Solliciteer op deze vacature.
2. Kennismakingsgesprek met Alice (recruiter).
3. Eerste gesprek met Dennis (direct leidinggevende van de functie) en iemand van het team.
4. Persoonlijkheids- en capaciteitentest, gevolgd door een technische casus met iemand van het team waarin je laat zien hoe je een model bouwt of een code review aanpakt.
5. Is er een match? Dan doen we je snel een aanbod.


Heb je vragen? Bel of mail 088 020 3012 / alice.kalle@zonneplan.nl

Title: Deep Learning Engineer
Description:
Train the intelligence behind our radars – turning complex signal data into instant, real-world detection.

As our Deep Learning Engineer, you develop, optimize, and deploy neural networks that enhance real-time radar performance. You work side-by-side with AI, Software Engineering, Hardware, and Product Management colleagues – translating abstract radar signal modalities into models that spot small airborne objects in noisy environments. You report to the Team Lead AI, and your models directly safeguard critical sites around the globe.

What You'll Do


Model design and architecture: Design, train, and optimize deep learning models for detection, segmentation, and classification. Tailor neural networks to process abstract, non-natural 3D, 4D, and 5D radar imagery.
Target classification and tracking: Build advanced neural network architectures to detect and track small objects like birds and drones. Ensure models perform reliably despite real-world background noise and weather.
Data engineering and automation: Prepare, preprocess, and augment large-scale radar datasets for training pipelines. Implement automated labeling strategies to streamline data preparation at scale.
Edge optimization and deployment: Optimize trained neural networks for high-performance inference on edge computing hardware. Collaborate with Software Developers and Radar Specialists to integrate models seamlessly into production systems.
Research and field validation: Evaluate emerging deep learning techniques to continuously lift our radar capabilities. Test model robustness under diverse field conditions and document design choices clearly.


What You Bring


MSc in Data Science, Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, or a related technical field
2-4 years of experience in Deep Learning, specifically within Computer Vision
Strong proficiency in Python and hands-on experience using PyTorch
Practical experience with edge deployment and model optimization tools like TensorRT or ONNX
Familiarity with non-natural signal modalities such as radar, sonar, LiDAR, or medical imaging

Title: Decision Scientist, Account Verification
Description:
Brief Info About Vinted

Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life – or even a third.

The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission:

Vinted Marketplace is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life.

Vinted Go enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 60 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces.

Vinted Pay is the newest part of the Vinted Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members.

Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania's first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we've grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people.

Information About The Position

As a Decision Scientist at Vinted, your work will have a tangible impact on millions of members, helping build a safe, trustworthy marketplace so people can buy and sell sustainably with confidence.

We are looking for a Decision Scientist to join our Account Verification team within the Security domain. You will join a cross-functional team dedicated to ensuring that accounts are protected from unauthorized access. From multi-factor authentication and biometrics to phone verification and account recovery, our goal is to make security industry-leading yet effortless.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys problem-solving and is passionate about using data to drive meaningful and fast change. You will act as a strategic partner, leveraging data to challenge assumptions, quantify trade-offs (balancing security protection vs. user friction), and shape our product strategy.

In this position, you’ll


Drive Data-Informed Decisions: Partner with product manager, engineers, and designers to identify strategic opportunities, challenge default assumptions, and bring an evidence-based lens to product discovery.
Balance Security & Member Friction: Model and analyze the trade-offs between security controls and user experience.
Champion Rigorous Experimentation: Define tracking requirements, design A/B tests, and evaluate test results to validate the business impact of new verification methods and friction-reduction initiatives.
Own Team Metrics & Root-Cause Analysis: Define, monitor, and iterate on key performance indicators (KPIs) for Account Verification; proactively investigate metric anomalies and uncover root causes.
Empower Stakeholders: Build and maintain self-service Looker dashboards that enable stakeholders to independently track feature performance.
Make Data Count: Participate actively in Vinted’s broader Data Science & Analytics (DSA) community, promoting analytical best practices, metric rigor, and knowledge-sharing.


About You


Experience in a Decision Science or Data Analytics role.
Good analytical thinking and problem-solving skills, with the ability to balance depth of analysis with business impact.
Working experience with SQL and Python or R
Experience with BI tools (e.g., Looker, Tableau, Power BI)
Knowledge of statistical methods, such as A/B testing, regression analysis, and other inferential techniques.
Highly results-oriented and comfortable with iterative processes
Strong communicator who can convincingly present results to both technical and non-technical audiences
Fluent in English, both written and spoken
Advantage: experience working in the Trust & Safety or Fraud-related area.


Work perks


The opportunity to benefit from our share options programme
25 days of paid annual leave
Newest MacBook models
Confidential Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for you and your family
Frequent team-building events
Home office support: we provide IT workstation equipment and a personal budget of up to €540 for home workplace furniture
Lunch benefit per working day
Company bike leasing scheme
Monthly budget for a flexible benefits platform
Work from Home allowance
A personal monthly budget for shopping on Vinted
Collective Defined Contribution Pension plan
NS Business Card for your commute to the office by public transport
A dog-friendly office


Working at Vinted

Workation policy

Better balance holidays with workdays by working remotely! Up to 90 days per year in the EU, of these, 21 days can be spent globally. For non-EU citizens, it's 21 days worldwide. This can be combined with time off for vacation or personal time.

Individual learning budget

Each year, you’ll be given a learning budget (starting at €3,000), and a total of up to 10 working days over a 2-year period to support your personal and professional development.

Hybrid work

Our hybrid model, with 2 recommended office days a week, gives you and your team the flexibility to decide if and when you want to work from home, and when to catch up in person.

Equal opportunity

We welcome applications from everybody, regardless of your background, identity, or life experiences. Job openings come with guides, not checklists. If you’re excited about a role, but don’t identify with every point in the ‘About you’ section, apply anyway – you might still be the perfect match!

The annual gross salary range for this position excluding 8% holiday pay is:

€53.900—€72.900 EUR

Title: Data Scientist - Verzekeringen & Pensioenen
Description:
Functiebeschrijving

Vind jij het leuk om te spelen met data? Ben je goed in problemen identificeren en oplossen? Kun je omgaan met gevarieerde technieken en een snel veranderde omgeving? Ga als Data Scientist aan de slag en kom ons groeiende Financial Services AI team te versterken.

Jouw rol in ons team

Je helpt onze klanten om hun toekomstige data gedreven strategie vorm te geven en geeft inzichten waarop ze kunnen acteren. Je voert analyses uit en maakt daarbij gebruik van de nieuwste concepten en mogelijkheden uit de wereld van artificial intelligence. Je ontwikkelt machine learning algoritmes die de laatste technologische vraagstukken kunnen beantwoorden. Daarnaast help je onze klanten door je opgedane informatie visueel inzichtelijk te maken, zodat jij deze kennis op een begrijpbare manier kan delen met onze stakeholders.

Met je opgedane werkervaring ben je in staat om de laatste domein- en IT trends te vertalen naar (innovatieve) AI-oplossingen, die passen bij de bedrijfsvoering van onze klanten. Je bent een teamspeler en bent in staat om in een gevarieerd team je rol te pakken en samen met andere experts tot de beste oplossing te komen.

Hoe jij ons team versterkt

Je bent proactief en houdt van een uitdaging. Met jouw kennis kom je tot de beste oplossingen voor onze klanten en weet je welke oplossingen de meeste toegevoegde waarde opleveren. Door jouw ervaring weet jij ook jouw teamleden naar een hoger niveau te begeleiden en te coachen. Daarnaast breng je de volgende kennis en ervaring mee:


Een afgeronde HBO of WO opleiding met een sterk statistisch component, zoals (toegepaste) wiskunde, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, Computer Science, of Econometrie.
Kennis en ervaring met Python en/of R (pandas, tensorflow, scikit-learn, matplotlib)
Kennis en ervaring met het gebruik van advanced analytics, big data, machine learning
Kennis en ervaring van ML Libraries (scikit-learn, keras, pytorch)
Kennis en ervaring met DevOps
Aantoonbare ervaring in het oplossen van complexe uitdagingen met behulp van data analyse en modellering
Minstens 2 jaar ervaring binnen het data domein.
Kennis op het gebied van Agile werkmethoden.
Aantoonbare ervaring met cloud platformen, zoals Azure, AWS of Google.
Goede beheersing van de Nederlandse en Engelse taal in woord en schrift.


Het is een pré als je ook ervaring hebt met:


Software development / DevOps
Docker of Kubernetes
ML-OPS
Linked-Data


Waar kom je terecht (optional)

De huidige financiële markt is in "full swing". Bedrijven staan voor grote uitdagingen en moeten adequaat inspelen op de toegenomen verwachtingen van de klant. Daarnaast ligt er druk op kostenbesparing, de toepassing van data science-technieken, de voortgaande digitalisering en de toenemende wet- en regelgevingen die om oplossingen vraagt. Technologie maakt het mogelijk om deze uitdagingen aan te gaan. CGI levert van oudsher een belangrijke bijdrage aan de digitalisering van grote bedrijven.

Je komt terecht in een divers team, waar we klanten helpen met het realiseren van hun nieuwste AI-innovaties. Door te werken met de nieuwste technologieën helpen we onze klanten verder in hun AI gedreven reis. We zijn daarom op zoek naar professionals die mee willen denken over het ontwikkelen en implementeren van innovatieve oplossingen met behulp van data en AI. Jouw kennis en expertise zijn nodig om de huidige en toekomstige uitdagingen van de wereld te overwinnen.

Waarom CGI

CGI is één van 's werelds grootste IT-consultancy bedrijven. Onze mensen houden Nederland draaiende. Overheidsinstellingen, banken, lucht- en ruimtevaart, infrastructurele organisaties en energie-, transport- en productiebedrijven zijn klanten van CGI. We werken aan interessante projecten die het alledaagse leven van miljoenen mensen raken. We zijn regionaal aanwezig, versterkt met wereldwijde domeinkennis, ons ecosysteem en collega's verspreid over de hele wereld.

We zijn trots op de impactvolle projecten die we samen met onze collega’s tot een succes maken.

Bij CGI hechten we veel waarde aan diversiteit en inclusie, omdat dit niet alleen de samenwerking bevordert, maar ook vaak leidt tot betere resultaten. We kijken uit naar jouw bijdrage aan ons team! Werken in kleine zelfsturende teams bestaande uit experts in je vakgebied.


De regie over je eigen carrière met daarbij de ruimte om jezelf te blijven ontwikkelen.
Een uitstekend salaris en aantrekkelijke secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden
Direct een vast contract
Parttime mogelijkheden
En de mogelijkheid om CGI aandeelhouder te worden


Sluit je aan bij ons team van experts en solliciteer direct!

We nemen dan zo snel mogelijk contact met je op! Heb je nog vragen over de inhoud van de vacature, stel ze aan Erwin de Kok via erwin.de.kok@cgi.com

Vragen over de sollicitatieprocedure? neem contact op met recruiter Jana Kreckova via jana.kreckova@cgi.com

We werken niet samen met externe recruitment bureau’s. Acquisitie wordt daarom niet op prijs gesteld.

Taken en verantwoordelijkheden

Criteria

Together, as owners, let’s turn meaningful insights into action.

In 1976 opgericht als een familiebedrijf, is CGI vandaag de dag een van de grootste onafhankelijke zakelijke en ICT-dienstverleners ter wereld. Bij ons draait het om ownership, teamwork en respect. Je krijgt de ruimte om al je talenten volledig te ontplooien.

Vanaf je eerste werkdag ben je mede-eigenaar van CGI. We profiteren samen van ons succes en je krijgt de kans én verantwoordelijkheid om actief bij te dragen aan de koers en strategie van ons bedrijf.

Jouw inzet voegt waarde toe. Je werkt aan innovatieve oplossingen en bouwt aan je netwerk van collega's en klanten. Je hebt toegang tot wereldwijde kansen om je ideeën te realiseren, mogelijkheden te benutten en te profiteren van onze kennis van de industrie en technologische expertise.

Ontdek bij ons de mogelijkheden voor jouw persoonlijke ontwikkeling en zet de volgende stap in je carrière. Hier staat jouw succes centraal!

Technologie maakt het mogelijk om deze uitdagingen aan te gaan. CGI levert van oudsher een belangrijke bijdrage aan de digitalisering van grote bedrijven.

We zijn regionaal aanwezig, versterkt met wereldwijde domeinkennis, ons ecosysteem en collega's verspreid over de hele wereld.

We zijn trots op de impactvolle projecten die we samen met onze collega’s tot een succes maken.

Bij CGI hechten we veel waarde aan diversiteit en inclusie, omdat dit niet alleen de samenwerking bevordert, maar ook vaak leidt tot betere resultaten. We kijken uit naar jouw bijdrage aan ons team! Werken in kleine zelfsturende teams bestaande uit experts in je vakgebied.

Title: Data Scientist
Description:
Job Number: R0245919

Data Scientist

The Opportunity:

As a data scientist, you’re excited at the prospect of unlocking the secrets held by a data set, and you’re fascinated by the possibilities presented by IoT, machine learning, and artificial intelligence. In an increasingly connected world, massive amounts of structured and unstructured data open new opportunities. As a data scientist at Booz Allen, you can help turn these complex data sets into useful information to solve global challenges. Across private and public sectors—from fraud detection to cancer research to national intelligence—we need you to help find the answers in the data.

On our team, you’ll use your analytical skills and data science knowledge to create real-world impact. You’ll work closely with your clients to understand their questions and needs, and then dig into their data-rich environments to find the pieces of their information puzzle. You’ll develop algorithms and systems and use the right combination of tools and frameworks to turn sets of disparate data points into objective answers to help clients make informed decisions. Ultimately, you’ll provide a deep understanding of the data, what it all means, and how it can be used.

Work with us as we use data science for good.

Join us. The world can’t wait.

You Have:


3+ years of experience developing and maintaining machine learning, AI‑driven, or data‑centric applications
3+ years of experience designing, building, and operationalizing data and ML pipelines in production environments
3+ years of experience retrieving, parsing, and processing structured, semi‑structured, and unstructured data to support analytics, feature engineering, and model development
3+ years of experience integrating large language models (LLMs) into analytic and ML workflows, including prompt design, inference orchestration, and automated data processing
Experience collaborating within cross‑functional teams, such as data scientists, ML engineers, analysts, and platform engineers, to deliver end‑to‑end DS or ML solutions
Secret clearance
Bachelor’s degree



Nice If You Have:


3+ years of experience with Python, SQL, or TypeScript in data or ML engineering contexts
3+ years of experience with UI/UX design
3+ years of experience working with geospatial datasets, spatial analytics, or geospatial ML workflows
3+ years of experience with distributed data and compute ecosystems, such as Spark, Databricks, Hadoop, Hive, AWS EMR, and Kafka, for large‑scale ML workloads
Experience operating in a Combatant Command or international mission‑focused environment and applying DS or ML methods to operational decision‑making
Experience using Palantir Foundry for data modeling, pipeline development, or operational analytics
TS/SCI clearance preferred



Clearance:

Applicants selected will be subject to a security investigation and may need to meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information; Secret clearance is required.

Compensation

At Booz Allen, we celebrate your contributions, provide you with opportunities and choices, and support your total well-being. Our offerings include health, life, disability, financial, and retirement benefits, as well as paid leave, professional development, tuition assistance, work-life programs, and dependent care. Our recognition awards program acknowledges employees for exceptional performance and superior demonstration of our values. Full-time and part-time employees working at least 20 hours a week on a regular basis are eligible to participate in Booz Allen’s benefit programs. Individuals that do not meet the threshold are only eligible for select offerings, not inclusive of health benefits. We encourage you to learn more about our total benefits by visiting the Resource page on our Careers site and reviewing Our Employee Benefits page.

Salary at Booz Allen is determined by various factors, including but not limited to location, the individual’s particular combination of education, knowledge, skills, competencies, and experience, as well as contract-specific affordability and organizational requirements. The projected compensation range for this position is $99,000.00 to $225,000.00 (annualized USD). The estimate displayed represents the typical salary range for this position and is just one component of Booz Allen’s total compensation package for employees. This posting will close within 90 days from the Posting Date.

Identity Statement

As part of the hiring process, we will ask you to complete an identity verification process that leverages advanced biometrics and artificial intelligence to ensure authenticity and protect against identity fraud. You are expected to be on camera during interviews and assessments. We reserve the right to take your picture to verify your identity and prevent fraud.

Candidate AI Usage Policy

AI is a part of our daily work at Booz Allen, and we are committed to the responsible and ethical use of AI tools. However, we want to ensure a fair candidate process based on your own skills and knowledge. As part of this commitment, the use of artificial intelligence (AI) or other tools to assist with responses during interviews (whether in-person or virtual) is prohibited unless permission is explicitly provided.

Work Model

Our people-first culture prioritizes the benefits of collaboration, whether it occurs in person or virtually. To support engagement and effective communication, employees working virtually are generally expected to have their cameras on during meetings.


Remote: If this position is listed as remote, there may still be occasions when you are required to work in person at a Booz Allen or customer facility.

Title: Consultant Data Science & ML Engineering (m/w/d) in Stuttgart
Description:
Deloitte bietet führende Prüfungs- und Beratungsleistungen in Audit & Assurance, Tax & Legal, Consulting und Advisory - für nahezu 90 % der Fortune Global 500® und zahlreiche private Unternehmen. Wir liefern innovative Denkansätze, lösen komplexe Herausforderungen und fördern nachhaltiges Wachstum. Mit rund 470.000 Mitarbeitenden weltweit eröffnen wir hervorragende Karrierechancen - getragen von einem starken „Wir“ und einer Vielfalt an Perspektiven und Fähigkeiten.

Du willst im Bereich Consulting – Artificial Intelligence and Data Kunden helfen, strategische Entscheidungen zu AI & Data zu treffen? Unser Team unterstützt von der Definition der AI & Data-Strategie über die Implementierung groß angelegter Datenplattformen und Visual Analytics Programme bis hin zu Einführung smarter "Age of With"-Lösungen. Sichere unseren gemeinsamen Erfolg und mach mit uns den Unterschied: als Consultant Data Science & ML Engineering (m/w/d).

Standorte: Berlin, Düsseldorf, Frankfurt (Main), Hamburg, Hannover, Köln, Mannheim, München und Stuttgart.

Dein Impact:

Als Consultant Data Science & ML Engineering (m/w/d) unterstützt du unsere Kunden dabei, Daten in messbaren Geschäftswert zu verwandeln und moderne Data-Science- und Machine-Learning-Lösungen erfolgreich umzusetzen.


Konzeption: Du unterstützt bei der Identifikation von Potenzialen für Data-Science- und Machine-Learning-Lösungen, analysierst Anforderungen und Datenquellen und wirkst bei der Bewertung des geschäftlichen Nutzens neuer Anwendungsfälle mit.
Analyse: Du analysierst Datenbestände, bewertest deren Qualität und leitest gemeinsam mit dem Projektteam wertvolle Erkenntnisse für datengetriebene Entscheidungen ab.
Lösungsentwicklung & Umsetzung: Du entwickelst und implementierst unter Anleitung erfahrener Kolleg:innen Data-Science- und Machine-Learning-Modelle und unterstützt dabei, fachliche Anforderungen in datenbasierte Lösungen zu überführen.
Operationalisierung: Du wirkst bei der Integration, dem Testing und der Produktivsetzung von Analytics- und ML-Lösungen mit und unterstützt den Aufbau nachhaltiger MLOps-Prozesse.
Innovation: Du bringst dich bei der Evaluierung neuer Methoden, Frameworks und Technologien im Bereich Data Science und Machine Learning ein und unterstützt die prototypische Entwicklung innovativer Lösungen.


Dein Skillset:


Erste Berufserfahrung in der Entwicklung, Umsetzung oder Produktivsetzung von Data-Science-, Analytics- oder Machine-Learning-Lösungen im Unternehmenskontext
Erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Studium, idealerweise in den Fachrichtungen Statistik, (Wirtschafts-)Informatik, Wirtschaftswissenschaften mit Statistikbezug, Mathematik, Data Science oder einem vergleichbaren Studiengang
Gute Kenntnisse in Python und SQL sowie erste praktische Erfahrungen mit Data-Science- und Machine-Learning-Frameworks wie beispielsweise scikit-learn, LightGBM oder vergleichbaren Technologien
Grundkenntnisse in statistischen Verfahren, Machine Learning sowie idealerweise erste Erfahrungen mit MLOps-Tools, Cloud-Plattformen (Azure, AWS oder GCP) oder der Produktivsetzung datengetriebener Anwendungen
Reisebereitschaft sowie Deutsch (C1) und Englisch sehr gut in Wort und Schrift


Deine Chance:


Spannende Aufgaben in einem innovativen Umfeld mit hochmotivierten Kolleg:innen, die sich schon jetzt auf deine Impulse freuen
Gute Rahmenbedingungen mit attraktivem Gehalt und zahlreichen Zusatzleistungen, z. B. Firmen-Smartphone zur privaten Nutzung, Fahrradleasing und Corporate Benefits
Work-Life-Balance durch Mobile Working & Teilzeit, EU Remote Working, Sabbaticals, Mitarbeiter:innen-Events, Well-being Angebote wie z. B. Gesundheitstage, Kooperationen mit Fitness-Anbietern und den Familienservice, der dich bei privaten Herausforderungen unterstützt
Exzellente Weiterbildung an der Deloitte University, in On- und Offline-Seminaren und im Rahmen der Berufsqualifikation, z. B. durch [bitte fachspezifisches Training einsetzen]
Vielfältige Gestaltungsspielräume und aktive Förderung einer inklusiven Unternehmenskultur – u. a. durch unsere Diversity & Inclusion Mitarbeiter:innen-Netzwerke

Title: Data Engineer
Description:
About Us

Founded in 2017, Wayve is the leading developer of Embodied AI technology. Our advanced AI software and foundation models enable vehicles to perceive, understand, and navigate any complex environment, enhancing the usability and safety of automated driving systems.

Our vision is to create autonomy that propels the world forward. Our intelligent, mapless, and hardware-agnostic AI products are designed for automakers, accelerating the transition from assisted to automated driving.

In our fast-paced environment big problems ignite us—we embrace uncertainty, leaning into complex challenges to unlock groundbreaking solutions. We aim high and stay humble in our pursuit of excellence, constantly learning and evolving as we pave the way for a smarter, safer future.

At Wayve, your contributions matter. We value diversity, embrace new perspectives, and foster an inclusive work environment; we back each other to deliver impact.

Make Wayve the experience that defines your career!

The Role

As a Data Engineer within the Machine Learning team in Application Software, you’ll contribute to critical initiatives that push the frontier of model-based autonomous driving—both in terms of core driving performance and feature-level intelligence such as personalization, comfort, and collaboration.

You’ll design and deliver scalable data pipelines that transform vast amounts of data from diverse internal and external sources into structured, reliable, and model-ready datasets. Your work will span data ingestion, data quality assurance, transformation, curation, evaluation and ML support. You’ll collaborate deeply with Wayve’s Data Corpus teams and ML engineers to build systems that are performant, adaptable, and ready for production.

Key Responsibilities


Build and improve scalable data pipelines that support model development, evaluation, and production ML workflows for autonomous driving.
Ingest, transform, and curate large-scale real-world, synthetic, and partner-provided datasets into structured, reliable, and model-ready formats aligned with standardised taxonomies and coordinate systems.
Develop data quality checks, validation processes, and monitoring to ensure both raw data from our vehicle platforms and processed datasets are high-quality, complete, consistent, traceable, and fit for ML use cases.
Curate and mine real-world and synthetic data to drive scenario diversity, coverage, and feature-specific development.
Improve pipeline performance, reliability, and usability, helping reduce bottlenecks and increase iteration velocity across ML development.
Collaborate closely with Machine Learning engineers, Data Corpus, AI Platform, and external partners to ensure data pipelines integrate effectively with production-scale learning systems.


About You

In order to set you up for success as a Data Engineer at Wayve, we’re looking for the following skills and experience.

Essential


Proven experience building and operating scalable data pipelines or distributed data processing systems in production environments.
Strong software engineering skills in Python, with a solid foundation in maintainable, reliable, and well-tested software development practices.
Proficient in SQL and PySpark, with experience using warehouse/OLAP concepts, window functions, and Spark for distributed data processing.
Experience with modern data pipeline architectures, including workflow orchestration and DAG-based systems such as Airflow, Flyte, Ray, or similar.
Solid understanding of robotics and automated driving data concepts, including sensor characteristics, timestamping and clock synchronisation, coordinate transformations, calibration, and ego-motion signals such as GNSS/IMU and vehicle odometry.
Understanding of machine learning development workflows, including training data generation, evaluation datasets, scenario mining, and model iteration.
Excellent communication and collaborative skills, capable of working effectively with interdisciplinary teams.


Desirable


Prior work in calibration, perception, imitation learning, or trajectory prediction.
Experience with third-party dataset ingestion and transformation.
Familiarity with automated driving data and scenario taxonomies, including ODD definitions, manoeuvre and behavior labels, scene classification, event tagging, semantic understanding.


This is a full-time role based in our office in Leonberg. At Wayve we want the best of all worlds so we operate a hybrid working policy that combines time together in our offices and workshops to fuel innovation, culture, relationships and learning, and time spent working from home. We operate core working hours so you can determine the schedule that works best for you and your team.

Wayve is committed to creating an inclusive interview experience. If you require any accommodations or adjustments to participate fully in our interview process, please let us know.

We understand that everyone has a unique set of skills and experiences and that not everyone will meet all of the requirements listed above. If you’re passionate about self-driving cars and think you have what it takes to make a positive impact on the world, we encourage you to apply.

At Wayve we're committed to creating a diverse, fair and respectful culture that is inclusive of everyone based on their unique skills and perspectives, and regardless of sex, race, religion or belief, ethnic or national origin, disability, age, citizenship, marital, domestic or civil partnership status, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, pregnancy or related condition (including breastfeeding) or any other basis as protected by applicable law.

For more information visit Careers at Wayve.

To learn more about what drives us, visit Values at Wayve

For US candidates only, please visit E-Verify Notice and Participation and Right to Work

However, we do look to capture information about care responsibilities, and disabilities among other diversity information as part of an optional DEI Monitoring form to help us identify areas of improvement in our hiring process and ensure that the process is inclusive and non-discriminatory.

Duales Studium - Data Science / KI (m/w/d)

1991 gründeten die Brüder Andreas und Ralf Luithle das Unternehmen Luithle + Luithle GmbH in Gemmrigheim bei Stuttgart.

Heute tritt das Unternehmen als Full-Service-IT-Dienstleister auf und betreut Kunden aus dem B2B-Sektor aller Branchen. Zum Kundenkreis zählen Unternehmen aus ganz Deutschland und dem Ausland, dabei sind die regionalen Wurzeln geblieben.

In sicheren Rechenzentren betreibt Luithle + Luithle eigene und fremde IT-Systeme als Managed Services. Darüber hinaus werden standardisierte Internet- und Cloudlösungen angeboten.

Das Wichtigste für uns ist das Arbeiten mit Herz & Verstand!

Deine Aufgaben


Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit unserem Team KI-gestützte Funktionen und Prototypen für unsere Service-Management-Plattform Tesseron.
Du recherchierst aktuelle KI-Technologien und bewertest deren Einsatzmöglichkeiten für unsere Produkte und Kundenprojekte.
Du unterstützt bei der Integration von KI-Funktionen in Service- und Geschäftsprozesse und arbeitest dabei eng mit unseren Entwicklern und Consultants zusammen.
Du testest KI-Modelle und Prototypen hinsichtlich Qualität, Zuverlässigkeit, Nachvollziehbarkeit und praktischer Nutzbarkeit.
Du unterstützt bei der Erfassung und Aufbereitung großer Datenmengen als Grundlage für fundierte, datengetriebene Entscheidungen.
Du dokumentierst Deine Ergebnisse und stellst sie verständlich im Team sowie gegenüber weiteren Stakeholdern vor.
Du erhältst dabei Einblicke in die Umsetzung kundenzentrierter Software- und KI-Projekte, bringst Dein Wissen aus den Theoriephasen der DHBW aktiv in unsere Produktentwicklung ein und übernimmst mit zunehmender Erfahrung eigene Aufgabenpakete.


Deine Qualifikationen


Du verfügst über die allgemeine Hochschulreife, eine fachgebundene Hochschulreife oder die Fachhochschulreife und erfüllst die Zulassungsvoraussetzungen der DHBW.
Du begeisterst Dich für Künstliche Intelligenz, Daten, Mathematik und Statistik sowie moderne Softwaretechnologien.
Du besitzt analytisches Denkvermögen und gehst strukturiert, sorgfältig und lösungsorientiert an neue Aufgaben heran.
Du hast idealerweise bereits erste praktische Erfahrungen mit Python, APIs, Datenbanken oder vergleichbaren Technologien gesammelt.
Du arbeitest gerne im Team, bringst eigene Ideen ein und kannst technische Zusammenhänge auch für Fachfremde verständlich erklären.
Du verfügst über gute bis sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.

Als Teil unseres multidisziplinären AI-and-Data-Teams bringst du dein technologisches Wissen ein, um aktuelle Fragestellungen für unsere Mandant:innen verschiedenster Branchen mithilfe Künstlicher Intelligenz zu lösen. In unserem Team wirst du vielfältige Aufgaben übernehmen, darunter:

Du hast dein technisches, naturwissenschaftliches, mathematisches oder vergleichbares Studium erfolgreich abgeschlossen.

Title: AI Engineer (w/m/d)
Description:
Unternehmensbeschreibung

Wir stehen jeden Morgen dafür auf, eine lebenswerte Zukunft für nachfolgende Generationen zu schaffen. Je nach Projekt sind wir Berater, Umsetzer – oder beides – nachhaltiger, innovativer und wirtschaftlicher Lösungen für Immobilien, Industrie, Energie und Infrastruktur. In interdisziplinären Teams unterstützen unsere über 6.500 Mitarbeitenden an mehr als 80 Standorten weltweit unsere Kunden. Wir denken visionär und realistisch. Wir arbeiten eigenständig und im Team. Mit Leidenschaft und modernsten Technologien. We unite. Join us at Dreso and let’s create a world we want to live in.

Stellenbeschreibung

Als AI Engineer:in entwickeln Sie gemeinsam mit Business-, AI-, Data- und IT-Teams konkrete KI-Lösungen für Drees & Sommer – von der ersten technischen Bewertung über Prototyping bis hin zur produktiven Nutzung. Die Position ist zentral ausgeschrieben – Ihr Einsatzbereich ergibt sich dort, wo Ihre Expertise, Ihr Branchenverständnis und die konkreten AI-Potenziale am besten zusammenpassen. So können Sie Ihre Stärken gezielt einbringen und dort Wirkung entfalten, wo sie den größten Mehrwert schaffen. Bewerben Sie sich jetzt an einem unserer Standorte in Hamburg, Berlin, Leipzig, Köln, Düsseldorf, Frankfurt, Stuttgart oder München.


Bewerten von AI-Use-Cases aus technischer Perspektive hinsichtlich technisch machbarem Ansatz, Aufwand, Architektur, Risiken, Datenbedarf und Betriebsreife
Übersetzen von Business-Bedarfen gemeinsam mit Fachbereichen in robuste technische Zielbilder sowie Entwickeln, Testen und Betreiben von KI-Lösungen auf Basis freigegebener Plattformen, Architekturen und Enterprise-AI-Guardrails
Aufbauen und Einbinden von KI-Komponenten wie LLM-basierten Anwendungen, RAG-Pipelines, Agents, Tools, Skills, APIs und MCP-Anbindungen
Entwickeln und Warten von Frontend-, Backend- und Integrationskomponenten je nach Use Case sowie Sicherstellen sicherer, stabiler und wartbarer Lösungen unter Berücksichtigung von Cyber Security, Datenschutz, Compliance, Berechtigungen und Betriebsmodellen
Unterstützen von Rollout, Monitoring, Weiterentwickeln und Skalieren produktiver KI-Lösungen sowie Dokumentieren von Lösungen, Architekturentscheidungen und Betriebswissen zum Erhalt von Know-how im Unternehmen
Zusammenarbeiten mit AI Lab, Digital Services, IT, Cyber Security, Data Governance, AI Experts und Business Stakeholdern sowie Evaluieren neuer Modelle, Frameworks und Technologien mit Ableiten pragmatischer Einsatzmöglichkeiten für Drees & Sommer und Weiterentwickeln lokaler AI-Prototypen zu sicheren, wiederverwendbaren und skalierbaren Enterprise-Lösungen


Qualifikationen


Abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Informatik, Computer Science, Data Science, Software Engineering oder eine vergleichbare technische Qualifikation
Relevante Berufserfahrung im Software Engineering, AI Engineering, Data Science, Machine Learning Engineering oder in einem vergleichbaren technischen Umfeld
Praktische Erfahrung mit modernen AI-Anwendungen, z. B. LLM-Integration, RAG-Systemen, Agentenarchitekturen, Context Engineering, Tool Use, Prompting, Evaluation oder Fine-Tuning
Sicherer Umgang mit relevanten Technologien, z. B. Python, TypeScript, React, FastAPI, Docker, APIs, Cloud-Plattformen, CI/CD oder vergleichbaren Stacks
Gutes End-to-End-Verständnis von AI-Anwendungen – von Datenquellen, Retrieval, Orchestrierung und Modellanbindung bis zu Berechtigungen, Evaluation, Monitoring und Betrieb – sowie Verständnis für Security, Datenschutz, Compliance und Governance in Enterprise-Umgebungen
Kommunikationsstärke, strukturierte und zuverlässige Hands-on-Arbeitsweise sowie Freude an der Zusammenarbeit mit Business-Stakeholdern, AI Expert:innen, Data- und IT-Teams
Fließende Englisch- und gute Deutschkenntnisse


Zusätzliche Informationen


Zur Sicherstellung Ihrer Work-Life-Balance bieten wir die Möglichkeit zum mobilen Arbeiten
Ihre berufliche und persönliche Entwicklung fördern wir durch individuelle Aus- und Weiterbildungen in der Drees & Sommer - Academy
Ihre Gesundheit unterstützen wir mit einem Bonus für sportlich Aktive oder einem Zuschuss zur Mitgliedschaft bei EGYM-Wellpass

Title: Data Engineer
Description:
Du bist interessiert an der Stelle als Data Engineer bei audit.neo GmbH?

Auf Instaffo kannst du dich für diesen und weitere Jobs ohne großen Aufwand bewerben. Erstelle dein Profil in unter 2 Minuten und starte den Bewerbungsprozess mit nur wenigen Klicks.

Anforderungen

Bitte beachte, dass für diese Stelle eine Arbeitserlaubnis für Deutschland erforderlich ist.

Sprache: Deutsch - Verhandlungssicher (C2)

Must-have:


Interesse an Datentransformation und Datenaufbereitung (z. B. mit Python, KNIME oder BI-Tools)
Freude daran, pragmatische Lösungen für reale Datenprobleme zu entwickeln
Strukturierte Arbeitsweise und ein gutes Verständnis für Datenqualität und Datenlogik


Nice to have:


Kenntnisse in der Wirtschaftsprüfung oder einem verwandten Umfeld
Programmierkenntnisse in Python


Tätigkeiten


Rohdaten in saubere, strukturierte Zielsysteme überführen – von der Analyse der Datenstruktur bis zur fertigen Transformation.
Datenaufbereitungs- und Verarbeitungsprozesse automatisieren und so manuelle Aufwände dauerhaft reduzieren.
Tools und Skripte zur effizienten Datenbearbeitung entwickeln und kontinuierlich verbessern.
Datenflüsse qualitätssichern und optimieren – mit Blick auf Korrektheit, Nachvollziehbarkeit und Performance.
Im direkten Austausch mit Kunden deren Fragen und Anforderungen aufnehmen und in konkrete Datenlösungen übersetzen.


Unser Tech-Stack: KNIME


Python
SQL
Cloud-Infrastruktur (Azure)
Git
BI-Tools
Automatisierung


Team

Wir sind ein kleines, eingespieltes Data-Team – mit kurzen Wegen, direkter Kommunikation und ohne unnötige Prozesse. Die Rolle ist bei uns keine Randrolle: Du arbeitest produktnah, bringst dich in technische Entscheidungen ein und hast direkten Einfluss darauf, wie unsere Datenflüsse und -prozesse wachsen. Datenpipelines werden gemeinsam gedacht, Lösungen end-to-end entwickelt und zusammen live gebracht.

Das Team sitzt in Stuttgart und arbeitet hybrid. Wie oft du ins Büro kommst, stimmen wir individuell ab – alles zwischen einmal pro Woche und einmal im Monat ist möglich.

Über das Unternehmen

audit.neo entwickelt die All-in-One-Plattform für Wirtschaftsprüfer. Unsere Software bildet den gesamten Prüfungsprozess digital ab – von Auftragsannahme und Risikoanalyse über Datenanalyse und Dokumentation bis zum fertigen Prüfungsbericht. Alles in einem System, ohne Medienbruch.

Was wir bauen

Wirtschaftsprüfung ist hochreguliert, datenintensiv und technisch anspruchsvoller, als viele denken. Unsere Plattform verarbeitet große Datenmengen aus ERP-Systemen, erkennt Auffälligkeiten mit KI und führt Prüfungsteams durch komplexe, mehrstufige Workflows.

Warum audit.neo?

Wir sind ein kleines Team mit hoher Geschwindigkeit und viel Verantwortung. Wer bei uns arbeitet, sieht die eigene Arbeit direkt im Produkt – und das Produkt direkt beim Kunden.

Kurze Entscheidungswege, wenig Overhead, keine Buzzword-Architektur – dafür echter Produktfokus und technische Herausforderungen mit unmittelbarem Impact.

Title: Data Engineer - Digital Health Excellence Center (w/m/d)
Description:
Are you ready to shape your future with confidence?

Gemeinsam die Welt jeden Tag ein bisschen besser machen. Für diesen Anspruch setzen wir bei EY alles in Bewegung und gehen als Team „all in“. Schließlich haben wir ein klares Ziel vor Augen: nachhaltigen Wert und Wachstum zu schaffen – für unsere Mandant:innen, Mitarbeitenden und die gesamte Gesellschaft. Unser globales Netzwerk aus rund 400.000 Mitarbeitenden weltweit bietet dir alle Möglichkeiten zu wachsen, dich zu entwickeln, dich zu spezialisieren sowie deine Stärken und Interessen beruflich zu verfolgen. Wir glauben daran, dass der richtige Karriereweg so individuell ist wie du.

Deine Aufgaben

Als Teil unseres international aufgestellten Digital Health Excellence Centers arbeitest du mit Kolleg:innen aus verschiedenen Ländern zusammen – und bist gleichzeitig an einem unserer deutschen Standorte in Köln, Berlin, Düsseldorf, Frankfurt/Main, Hamburg, München oder Stuttgart verankert. Wir realisieren sowohl internationale Projekte als auch Vorhaben für deutsche Verwaltungen auf Bundes-, Landes- und Kommunalebene und gestalten dabei moderne, sichere Systeme für Millionen von Menschen.

Im Fokus steht dabei die digitale Transformation des Gesundheitswesens – von interoperablen IT-Lösungen bis hin zu innovativen Digital-Health-Strategien. Dabei übernimmst du vielfältige Aufgaben:


Design und Entwicklung skalierbarer Datenpipelines (ETL/ELT) zur Aufnahme, Transformation und Verarbeitung großer sowie komplexer Datenmengen
Entwicklung und Betrieb von Orchestrierungs-Workflows mit Apache Airflow oder Apache NiFi
Unterstützung im Aufbau von AI/ML/LLM-Pipelines durch Aufbereitung, Strukturierung und Optimierung von Daten für die Nutzung von Modellen
Optimierung von Datenbanken (PostgreSQL, Oracle) mit Fokus auf Performance-Tuning, Indexierung und Query-Optimierungen
Sicherstellung von Datenqualität, Datenintegrität und Zuverlässigkeit innerhalb produktiver Pipelines


Dein Skillset


Mindestens 5 Jahre Erfahrung im Data Engineering und Aufbau moderner Datenplattformen, inklusive Entwicklung von AI-/ML-Pipelines, Datenaufbereitung, Feature Engineering sowie LLM-Integrationen.
Fundierte Kenntnisse in Python (insbesondere pandas), SQL, ETL/ELT-Prozessen, Workflow-Orchestrierung (z. B. Airflow oder NiFi), Verarbeitung großer Datenmengen sowie tiefgehende Datenbankexpertise in PostgreSQL oder Oracle inklusive Performance-Optimierung.
Praktische Erfahrung in Data Governance, Datenschutz und DSGVO-konformer Datenverarbeitung sowie idealerweise Kenntnisse relevanter Gesundheitsdatenstandards wie HL7, FHIR, OMOP und openEHR.


Dein Mindset


Agil: Du bist der Meinung, dass eine flexible Denkweise genauso wichtig für den Erfolg ist wie Wissen und Fähigkeiten.
Neugierig: Du bist ambitioniert und engagiert. Wir suchen Menschen, die in Chancen und nicht in Herausforderungen denken und durch gezielte Fragen bessere Lösungen finden.
Teamorientiert: Du schätzt vielfältige Perspektiven und arbeitest gerne im Team. Wir suchen Menschen, die gemeinsam mit uns etwas erreichen und ein vertrauensvolles Arbeitsumfeld schaffen wollen.


Deine Benefits

Bei EY arbeitest du in leistungsstarken, interdisziplinären Teams mit innovativen Technologien. In einem flexiblen und inklusiven Arbeitsumfeld unterstützen wir dich in deinen unterschiedlichen Lebenssituationen. Inspirierende Kolleg:innen sowie Trainings- und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten on- und off-the-Job helfen dir dabei, über dich hinauszuwachsen und die Fähigkeiten weiterzuentwickeln, die du zukünftig brauchst. Title: Data Strategist & Analytics Specialist
Description:
SMX is seeking an experienced Data Strategist & Analytics Specialist to serve as the primary data authority for our organization's Theater/Tactical Mission Network (TMN) operations. This individual will be responsible for the full data lifecycle — from sourcing and validation through workflow design and strategic planning — ensuring that data assets are accurate, actionable, and efficiently utilized across all supported units and subcontractor deliverables.

This position requires an active DoD Secret clearance with Top Secret SCI eligibility which requires US citizenship for work on DoD contracts.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities:

Data Source Validation

Evaluate, vet, and validate data sources for accuracy, reliability, completeness, and relevance to mission requirements.
Conduct structured assessments of data providers to determine operational and analytical value, and provide go/no-go recommendations to leadership.
Maintain a registry of approved, conditional, and rejected data sources with supporting rationale.

Data Visualization Review (DVR) Oversight

Review and quality-assure Data Visualization Review (DVR) products created by subcontractors in response to supported unit Requests for Information (RFIs).
Assess DVR deliverables against defined standards for accuracy, design fidelity, analytical integrity, and alignment with the originating RFI.
Provide written feedback, approval, or rejection of subcontractor products, and coordinate revisions as needed.

TMN Data Strategy Development

Develop, document, and maintain a comprehensive TMN Data Strategy that aligns data collection, management, and dissemination practices with organizational and mission objectives.
Identify capability gaps in current data infrastructure and recommend improvements.
Establish data governance frameworks including ownership, stewardship, quality standards, and lifecycle policies.

Data Usage & Utilization Efficiency

Analyze current data usage patterns and identify redundancies, inefficiencies, and underutilized assets across the organization.
Implement best practices to maximize the value extracted from existing data resources while reducing waste and duplication.
Collaborate with supported units and internal stakeholders to align data consumption with operational priorities.

Data Workflow Design & Implementation

Design, document, and optimize end-to-end data workflows, including ingestion, processing, storage, access, and dissemination pipelines.
Standardize workflow procedures to ensure repeatability, traceability, and quality control across all data operations.
Work with technical teams to automate or streamline manual data processes where feasible.

Data Provider Evaluation

Conduct structured evaluations of current and prospective data providers to assess the value, reliability, and mission relevance of their offerings.
Develop and apply a repeatable provider assessment methodology, including criteria such as data freshness, coverage, accuracy, licensing, and cost-benefit analysis.
Produce provider validation reports and present findings and recommendations to decision-makers.

Required Skills/Experience:

 Bachelor's degree in Data Science, Information Systems, Operations Research, Computer Science, or a related field (Master's preferred).
5+ years of experience in data analysis, data management, or a related discipline, preferably in a defense, intelligence, or government contracting environment.
Demonstrated experience reviewing and evaluating data products or visualizations for technical accuracy and analytical quality.
Strong understanding of data governance, data quality frameworks, and lifecycle management principles.
Experience developing or contributing to organizational data strategies or roadmaps.
Proficiency with data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI, ArcGIS, or similar platforms).
Familiarity with structured data environments, relational databases, and common data formats (JSON, XML, CSV, shapefiles, etc.).
Excellent written and verbal communication skills; ability to produce clear technical documentation and present findings to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Must have an active DoD Secret security clearance.

Desired Skills/Experience:

Experience working within or in direct support of military or DoD organizational structures, particularly in a TMN, C2, or ISR context.
Familiarity with RFI/DVR processes and subcontractor product review workflows.
Knowledge of geospatial data sources and GEOINT products.
Experience with data pipeline tools (e.g., Apache NiFi, Databricks, etc.)
Relevant certifications such as Certified Data Management Professional (CDMP), CompTIA Data+, or equivalent.
DoD Top Secret and TS-SCI preferred

#CJPOST

 The SMX salary determination process takes into account a number of factors, including but not limited to, geographic location, Federal Government contract labor categories, relevant prior work experience, specific skills, education and certifications. At SMX, one of our Core Values is to Invest in Our People so we offer a competitive mix of compensation, learning & development opportunities, and benefits. Some key components of our robust benefits include health insurance, paid leave, and retirement.

The proposed salary for this position is:: $110,000 USD - $133,000 USD

 

At SMX®, we are a team of technical and domain experts dedicated to enabling your mission. From priority national security initiatives for the DoD to highly assured and compliant solutions for healthcare, we understand that digital transformation is key to your future success.

We share your vision for the future and strive to accelerate your impact on the world. We bring both cutting edge technology and an expansive view of what’s possible to every engagement. Our delivery model and unique approaches harness our deep technical and domain knowledge, providing forward-looking insights and practical solutions to power secure mission acceleration.

SMX is an Equal Opportunity employer including disabilities and veterans.

Selected applicant may be subject to a background investigation and/or education verification.

SMX does not sponsor a new applicant for employment authorization or immigration related support for this position (i.e. H1B, F-1 OPT, F-1 STEM OPT, F-1 CPT, J-1, TN, E-2, E-3, L-1 and O-1, or any EADs or other forms of work authorization that require immigration support from an employer).

Title: Junior Managers Program (Trainee) - Start your Leadership Journey in Business Intelligence & Analytics
Description:
Company Description

Do you want to turn your ideas into useful and meaningful technologies? Whether in Mobility Solutions, Consumer Goods, Industrial Technology or Energy and Building Technology - with us you will improve the quality of life for people all over the world. Welcome to Bosch.

Robert Bosch GmbH is looking forward to your application!

Job Description

Ready to make a real impact with data? We are looking for analytically strong and tech-savvy master’s graduates with a drive to make a difference, who will drive Bosch's data-driven transformation with us in our Junior Managers Program. If you burn for data analytics, machine learning, and strategic challenges and aspire to build a leadership career, we want to meet you.

Over an intensive 12 to 24-month journey, you will rotate through predominantly commercial and IT-related departments in Germany and abroad. Your mission is to gain a deep understanding of our business and data-driven decision-making processes, while building expertise in data analytics, digitalization, and machine learning.

You will analyze complex challenges, identify optimization potentials along our business processes, and collaborate with specialist departments to develop innovative, data-based, digital solutions. In doing so, you will work on strategically relevant topics such as market analyses, forecasting, and the development of data-driven business decisions.

Your academic foundation:

You have graduated with an outstanding (full-time) Master's degree in Business Administration, Economics, Mathematics, Statistics, (Business) Informatics, or a related field. Your focus ideally lies on topics such as data analytics, data science, machine learning, or quantitative methods. Perhaps you already bring an MBA, PhD, or initial work experience.

Qualifications

Your passion for data-driven topics:

You have a strong passion for data and analytical challenges. You are motivated to structure and analyze large volumes of data and derive concrete, actionable recommendations from them. Initial practical experience in data analytics, data science, or data mining is an advantage.

Your eye for the bigger picture:

You find it exciting to understand how business models work and how data-based insights contribute to the optimization of processes and strategies. You are highly motivated to link analytical results with entrepreneurial goals.

Your understanding of human-centric leadership:

You are convinced that sustainable success is created through human collaboration. With empathy, openness, and enthusiasm, you succeed in winning others over to data-driven solutions and driving change forward together.

Your continuous development:

You bring a strong growth mindset and are ready to continuously develop yourself in a dynamic environment, learning new technologies and methodologies quickly.

Your language proficiency:

You communicate very well in English and possess good German language skills to navigate confidently within both our international and local environments. International experience of at least three months rounds off your profile.

Additional Information

Why you will love being part of our community

We are deeply invested in the growth of our team members. We have created an environment where you are supported, valued, and empowered to do your best work.


Mentoring & Sponsoring: An executive-level mentor will accompany you on your journey, actively support your development, and open doors for your next career steps with us.
A culture of belonging: From day one, you will become part of a global community of trainees from diverse backgrounds and locations. Build authentic connections beyond formal projects through virtual hangouts, local meetups, or our (global) trainee summits.
Flexible & hybrid working: We trust you to manage your work in a way that fits your life, with a flexible start date and a permanent employment contract. We offer a hybrid model that combines office and remote collaboration.
Continuous learning: Benefit from up to 6 rotations across different departments, including an international rotation, supported by a generous budget for your professional development (courses, certifications, and conferences).


Are you ready to shape the future of Business Intelligence with us? Apply now and tell us why you are the perfect candidate to lead the digital revolution.

Do you have questions about the application process?

Claudia Mertens-Baaij (Human Resources)

Telephone: 0711 811 7200

a Video Interview, Assessment Center and a Final Interview.

Aufgaben

Die Mercedes-Benz Bank mit Sitz in Stuttgart gehört zu den führenden Autobanken in Deutschland und ist Teil der Mercedes-Benz Group AG. Als Finanzierungsspezialist unterstützen wir den Absatz von Mercedes-Benz Fahrzeugen durch datengetriebene Entscheidungen und innovative Analytics-Lösungen.

Im Controlling – als zentrale Funktion innerhalb des Vorstandsressorts Finance & Risk – gestalten wir aktiv die finanzielle Zukunft der Bank. Wir verantworten die finanzielle Steuerung und schaffen Transparenz über Geschäftsentwicklung, Profitabilität, Risiken und Werttreiber. Unser Anspruch ist es, Controlling konsequent datengetrieben weiterzuentwickeln und die digitale Transformation des Finanzbereichs aktiv voranzutreiben. Dazu verbinden wir tiefes Business-Verständnis mit modernen Analytics-, Data- und AI-Ansätzen, um fundierte Entscheidungsgrundlagen für Management und Fachbereiche bereitzustellen.

Deine Aufgaben:


Fachlich-technische Gestaltung datengetriebener Lösungen unter Nutzung moderner Datenarchitekturen (DWH, Data Lake, Data Mesh) in enger Zusammenarbeit mit den verantwortlichen Plattformteams
Entwicklung skalierbarer Datenpipelines (ETL/ELT) und analytischer Datenmodelle (Data Vault, Star Schema)
Konzeption und Umsetzung analytischer Datenmodelle für Reporting, Planung, Steuerung und Advanced Analytics
Durchführung von Advanced Analytics und datengetriebenen Analysen zur Unterstützung strategischer und operativer Entscheidungen
Identifikation, Bewertung und Umsetzung datengetriebener Optimierungs- und Automatisierungspotenziale im Controlling
Bewertung neuer Technologien und Methoden im Bereich Data Analytics, Artificial Intelligence und Data Engineering hinsichtlich ihres Nutzens für die Unternehmenssteuerung
Sicherstellung von Datenqualität, Data Governance, Compliance und regulatorischer Nachvollziehbarkeit
Aufbau und Weiterentwicklung moderner BI- und Reporting-Lösungen (z. B. Power BI)
Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Fachbereichen sowie Übersetzung komplexer fachlicher Anforderungen in technische und analytische Lösungen
Technische Führung von Projekten sowie Mentoring von Kolleginnen und Kollegen

Spannende Aufgaben an der Schnittstelle von Controlling, Daten, Analytics und künstlicher Intelligenz
Hoher Gestaltungsspielraum bei der digitalen Transformation der Unternehmenssteuerung
Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit Management, Fachbereichen, IT- und Datenplattformteams

Arbeit mit modernen Technologien, Cloud-Umgebungen und zukunftsweisenden Datenkonzepten
Verantwortungsvolle Rolle mit hoher Sichtbarkeit und direktem Einfluss auf die Weiterentwicklung der Mercedes-Benz Bank
