Idealerweise bringst Du Folgendes mit:


Abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik, Mathematik, Statistik, Data Science oder vergleichbar
Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung als Analytics Engineer, Data Engineer, Data Architect oder in einer vergleichbaren technischen Datenrolle
Nachweisbare praktische Erfahrung in der Entwicklung skalierbarer Datenpipelines (ETL/ELT) sowie analytischer Datenmodelle (Data Vault, Star Schema, Kimball, 3NF)
Sehr gute Kenntnisse in SQL und Python
Fundiertes Verständnis moderner Datenarchitekturen, insbesondere Data Warehouse, Data Lake, Data Mesh und cloudbasierter Datenplattformen
Erfahrung mit Cloud-Technologien wie GCP oder Azure
Erfahrung in Data Governance, Data Lineage, Datenqualität und regulatorischen Anforderungen
Kenntnisse moderner DevOps- und Automatisierungsansätze (Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD)
Fähigkeit, fachliche Anforderungen in belastbare technische Lösungsansätze und Datenmodelle zu überführen
Ausgeprägtes Interesse an digitalen Technologien, künstlicher Intelligenz und datengetriebener Transformation

Title: Data Visualization Engineer & Data Integration Analyst

Job Number: R0242934

Data Visualization Engineer & Data Integration Analyst

The Opportunity:

As a data analyst, you love diving into data and turning it into meaningful insights. With the abundance of structured and unstructured data available across operational, assessment, and planning environments, you understand the importance of transforming complex data sets into useful information to solve mission challenges. As a data analyst at Booz Allen, you can use your skills and experience to support a national security mission and use data for good. We need a data expert like you to bring your expertise to help U.S. Special Operations leaders better understand trends, gaps, risks, and opportunities across partner nation programs and operational activities.

As a client-facing Data Visualization Engineer & Data Integration Analyst on our team, you’ll work closely with Special Operations customers, planners, analysts, and mission partners to understand their questions and needs, then dig into data-rich environments to find the pieces of their information puzzle. Not only will you provide a deeper understanding of their data, you’ll also advise the client on what the information means and how it can be used to improve planning, assessment, partner engagement, and senior leader decision-making.

How You’ll Contribute:

As a data analyst on our team, you’ll:


Use your data analytics expertise to support client and stakeholder relationships.
Research, develop, and test data methodologies, and generate cross-functional solutions through collection, cleaning, interpretation, evaluation, integration, and analysis of operational and assessment data.
Contribute to impactful work and guide decision-making across planners, assessment analysts, operational environment analysts, and senior stakeholders.
Apply communication skills and data analytics expertise by simplifying technical requirements, data trends, and analytical findings based on audience.
Present data findings and recommendations to clients and stakeholders using your knowledge of databases, scripting languages such as SQL, Python, or R, visualization tools, and Microsoft Office Suite.
Apply data visualization through formats such as dashboards, graphs, tables, trackers, maps, and PowerPoint slides.
Grow your communication and technical skills by creating data-centric solutions across special operations, campaign assessment, partner nation engagement, and operational planning missions.



Work with us to drive large-scale decisions through data insights.

Join us. The world can’t wait.

You Have:


5+ years of experience supporting data visualization, data analysis, data integration, business intelligence, dashboard development, or knowledge management
Experience collecting, cleaning, structuring, integrating, analyzing, or visualizing data from multiple sources
Experience developing dashboards, visual reports, data trackers, executive-level data products, or recurring reporting tools
Knowledge of data visualization principles, data quality, workflow automation, data management, information management, or knowledge management practices
Ability to communicate technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders and translate mission requirements into practical data solutions
Ability to work with planners, analysts, and operational stakeholders to define data requirements and translate complex information into clear visual products
Ability to develop repeatable templates, dashboards, trackers, data collection frameworks, or automated workflows that support recurring reporting and assessment cycles
TS/SCI clearance
HS diploma or GED



Nice If You Have:


Experience supporting a Theater Special Operations Command, Geographic Combatant Command, or other Department of Defense client
Experience with security cooperation, partner force development, irregular warfare, counterterrorism, special operations, exercises, or campaign assessment
Experience with Microsoft Power Platform, including Power BI, Power Automate, Power Apps, or SharePoint lists
Experience with SQL, Python, R, JavaScript, Databricks, application programming interfaces, or data transformation tools
Experience supporting Mission Command System – Common Operational Picture, Maven Smart System, Palantir, Advana, Tableau, ESRI, or other mission data platforms
Knowledge of Africa regional security dynamics, partner nation operational environments, transnational threat networks, or campaign planning processes

Description:
Deloitte bietet führende Prüfungs- und Beratungsleistungen in Audit & Assurance, Tax & Legal, Consulting und Advisory - für nahezu 90 % der Fortune Global 500® und zahlreiche private Unternehmen. Wir liefern innovative Denkansätze, lösen komplexe Herausforderungen und fördern nachhaltiges Wachstum. Mit rund 470.000 Mitarbeitenden weltweit eröffnen wir hervorragende Karrierechancen - getragen von einem starken „Wir“ und einer Vielfalt an Perspektiven und Fähigkeiten.

Du willst im Bereich Assurance Financial Services Industries die Zukunft der Finanzbranche aktiv mitgestalten?

Mit deiner Expertise und deiner ausgeprägten Leidenschaft für Unternehmensberatung wirst du Teil eines hochqualifizierten Teams, das Finanzinstitute dabei unterstützt, Prozesse zu optimieren, Risiken zu minimieren, regulatorische Anforderungen umzusetzen und Compliance-Standards einzuhalten. So unterstützt du unsere Kunden dabei, nachhaltige Lösungen zu entwickeln. Sichere unseren gemeinsamen Erfolg und mach mit uns den Unterschied: als Senior AI Engineer Financial Services / Banking & Capital Markets (m/w/d).

Standorte: Berlin, Düsseldorf, Frankfurt (Main), Hamburg, München, Nürnberg und Stuttgart.

Dein Impact:

Als Senior AI-Engineer (m/w/d) bringst du modernste AI-Technologien in die Bankenwelt: Du wertest Geschäfts- und Risikoberichte mit Texterkennung aus, nutzt Predictive Analytics und Machine Learning, um Impulse für die Banksteuerung zu setzen, oder implementierst Anomalie-Detection-Modelle, um die Datenqualität von Finanzdaten zu erhöhen.


Hands-on-Einstieg: Du entwickelst AI-Modelle und Methoden wie NLP, Computer Vision und Predictive Analytics zur Optimierung von textrelevanten Prozessen, Abläufen und strategischen Banksteuerungsinstrumenten.
Tech-Expertise: Dabei setzt du AI-Frameworks wie TensorFlow und PyTorch ein und programmierst in Python, R oder MATLAB, um datengetriebene Lösungen umzusetzen.
Systemanalyse: Du untersuchst Bankensysteme, identifizierst Schwachstellen und deckst Optimierungspotenziale durch AI-Technologien auf.
Datenmanagement: Du arbeitest regelmäßig mit großen Datenmengen, bereitest Daten für eine standardisierte Nutzbarkeit auf und gestaltest Big-Data-Lösungen.
Führung: Nicht zuletzt übernimmst du die (Teil-)Projekt- und Teamleitung und trittst kundenorientiert auf.


Dein Skillset:


Abgeschlossenes Studium in Data Science, Künstlicher Intelligenz, Informatik, Statistik, Mathematik, Finance oder vergleichbar
Mindestens 2 Jahre Erfahrung in der Implementierung von AI-Systemen, idealerweise im Finanzdienstleistungssektor
Interesse an Finanzprozessen in der Financial Service Industrie mit AI-Expertise, schnelle Auffassungsgabe für regulatorische Anforderungen und eine verantwortungsvolle Umsetzung in sensiblen Branchen
Erfahrung mit agilen Methoden und Projektmanagement-Tools, strukturierte Teamarbeit, klare Kommunikation und Begeisterung für innovative Technologien
Reisebereitschaft sowie Deutsch und Englisch sehr gut in Wort und Schrift


Deine Chance:


Best-in-class Weiterbildung an der Deloitte University sowie im Rahmen individueller Qualifikationsangebote und Trainings
Umfassende Entwicklungschancen durch strukturierte Karriereplanung, Inclusive Leadership, Entsendungsprogramme, projektbasierte Job-Rotation sowie Förderung sozialen Engagements und Corporate Volunteering
Vereinbarkeit von Beruf & Familie dank Mobile Working & Teilzeit, Sabbaticals und Familienservice, z. B. zur Unterstützung für pflegende Angehörige, Elternzeit-Beratung und vielem mehr
Gesundheit & Fitness im Fokus durch regelmäßige Gesundheitstage, Kooperationen mit Fitness-Anbietern und die Unterstützung von Sport- und Teamevents
Attraktive Arbeitgeberleistungen inklusive Bike- und Pkw-Leasing, Firmen-Smartphone zur privaten Nutzung sowie flexiblen Arbeitsmodellen wie z. B. Vertrauensarbeitszeit und EU Remote Working
Vielfältige Gestaltungsspielräume und aktive Förderung einer inklusiven Unternehmenskultur - u. a. durch unsere Diversity & Inclusion Mitarbeiter:innen-Netzwerke

Ever-expanding technology like IoT, machine learning, and artificial intelligence means that there’s more structured and unstructured data available today than ever before. As a data engineer, you know that organizing big data can yield pivotal insights when it’s gathered from disparate sources.

Title: Data Scientist
Place: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Drive meaningful change

At our Data, Analytics & AI department, we specialize in data visualizations, BI tools, analytical consulting, statistics, forecasting, and modern data platforms. Working closely with various departments across Abacus, we combine our analytical expertise with a deep understanding of pharmaceutical markets—from product development to delivery.

We believe that robust Data Science and AI can give Abacus Medicine a competitive edge, uncovering trends and behaviors that drive smarter decision-making. Our advanced machine learning (ML) techniques transform complex market data into actionable forecasts. Join us on our growth journey and help shape the future of the pharmaceutical industry.

Get a glimpse of our world

The Data Science team consists of five highly skilled professionals, all dedicated to improve global healthcare through better access to medicine by delivering critical data and insights that drive informed decision-making.

In this role, you will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams—including data analysts, data engineers, product managers, and key business stakeholders—to develop data-driven solutions that scale.

Are you ready to embark on this journey with us?

As a Data Scientist, you will play a key role in developing and deploying machine learning models that power business insights and operational efficiencies and support tactical and strategic decision-making across Abacus Medicine.

Your Responsibilities Will Include


Design, develop, and deploy advanced models, including classical machine learning, deep learning, and algorithmic solutions, to solve complex business problems.
Analyze tabular datasets to generate actionable insights, ensuring data-driven decision-making.
Design and maintain scalable MLOps pipelines for seamless model deployment, monitoring, and lifecycle management.
Promote best practices in Data Science by optimizing workflows and expanding the DS/ML toolbox with tools that enhance model accuracy, runtime, and maintainability.
Strengthen our technical infrastructure by integrating modern technologies that enhance efficiency, scalability, and long-term maintainability.
Drive innovation by evaluating and integrating emerging ML/AI methodologies, including LLMs, to enhance model performance.
Translate complex model results into actionable insights for both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Share expertise through knowledge sharing and sparring sessions.
Proactively identify potential data science applications for value creation.
Contribute to branch development initiatives and long-term planning, including roadmap definition.


Fuel for your success in the role

We Imagine You Have


Master’s degree in a data science-related field (e.g., computer science, cognitive science, IT, mathematics/statistics, economics).
Advanced Python programming skills.
Proficient in Data Science skills including classical machine learning for tabular data, ML frameworks (scikit-learn, deep learning frameworks), data wrangling, data analysis, and visualization.
Experienced with the following technologies: SQL, Web APIs, Git, Linux commands.
Excellent English communication skills with the ability to present complex data clearly to non-technical stakeholders.
Show genuine care for both team dynamics and the success of the organization, fostering a positive and inclusive work culture.


Preferred Qualifications


Prior working experience in applying data science, with a focus on machine learning and predictive modeling.
Familiarity with the following technologies: MLOps, Spark, Cloud platform (e.g. Azure/AWS), mlflow, ETL processes, CI/CD processes.
Databricks environment for building and deploying ML models.
Leveraging LLMs for enhancing the performance of ML models through prompt engineering and embeddings.


Interested?

If you want to apply for the position, please follow the link and attach your CV.

To help us better understand your motivation and qualifications for this role, we kindly encourage you to attach both your cover letter and academic transcript. This will give us a clearer overview of your interests and the courses you have completed during your studies.

Would you like to know more about us?

Follow us on Instagram and LinkedIn and get an insight into everyday life at Abacus Medicine. For job openings, check our Career page.

Moving Healthcare. Moving You.

In Abacus Medicine Group, you’ll experience the power of Moving Healthcare. With our change mindset, we're moving the industry and improving healthcare as we broaden access to medicine.

But it's not just about moving healthcare, it's about Moving You. You’ll be part of a caring community of more than 1,750 people across the World. With us, you will be valued, empowered, and have a direct impact on driving change. Let's access the future of medicine and make a difference together. Your move.

Please note that the position will remain open until we find the right candidate, after which the job advertisement will be removed. We encourage interested applicants to submit their applications as early as possible.

Please note that due to the ongoing summer holiday period, the recruitment process may take slightly longer than usual. We appreciate your patience and understanding.

Title: Senior Data Scientist
Place: Aarhus Municipality, Central Denmark Region, Denmark
Description:
Vil du udvikle og lede leverancen af avancerede AI- og machine learning-løsninger, der bliver sat i produktion og skaber reel værdi hos kunden?




Vi søger en hands-on Senior Data Scientist med erfaring fra konsulentbranchen. Du har stærk teknisk dybde inden for machine learning, generativ AI eller begge områder og kan tage ansvar for komplekse tekniske leverancer hos kunden.




Du samarbejder direkte med kunden, afklarer tekniske behov og skaber fremdrift i leverancen. Det afgørende er, at du både kan bygge løsningerne selv, sætte teknisk retning og løfte kvaliteten omkring dig.




Du bliver en del af et større fagligt miljø i vores AI, Apps & Automation-capability. Her arbejder du tæt sammen med data scientists samt software- og automationsspecialister og samarbejder på tværs af capabilities med data engineers, arkitekter, forretningskonsulenter m.fl.




Om rollen

Som Senior Data Scientist leder du det tekniske arbejde og er samtidig selv en aktiv del af udførelsen. Du arbejder hands-on med kode, modeller, eksperimenter, løsningsdesign og produktionsmodning.

Du tager ansvar for de svære tekniske valg og hjælper teamet med at fastholde kvalitet og fremdrift.




Du kommer blandt andet til at:

Lede tekniske AI- og machine learning-projekter fra problemforståelse til produktionsklar løsning
Omsætte uklare forretningsbehov til konkrete tekniske problemstillinger og løsningsdesign
Sætte teknisk retning og træffe valg om modeller, metoder, arkitektur og platforme
Drive tekniske afklaringer med relevante stakeholders hos kunden
Sikre sammenhæng mellem teknisk kvalitet, anvendelighed, governance og forretningsværdi
Bidrage til scoping, estimering og kvalificering af nye kundeopgaver
Mentorere kolleger og udvikle genanvendelige metoder, komponenter og accelerators




Afhængigt af din specialisering kan du eksempelvis arbejde med forecasting, optimering, recommendation engines og MLOps eller med RAG, dokumentintelligens, copilots, agentic AI og intelligente workflows.




Sådan skaber du succes i rollen

Du omsætter komplekse AI- og machine learning-problemstillinger til løsninger med tydelig forretningsværdi
Du skaber struktur og fremdrift, også når rammerne eller løsningen ikke er givet på forhånd
Du bygger løsninger, der kan implementeres, anvendes, monitoreres og videreudvikles
Du skaber tillid gennem faglig tyngde, tydelig kommunikation og kvalificerede tekniske anbefalinger
Du løfter kvaliteten omkring dig gennem sparring, mentoring og genanvendelige metoder




Din profil

Konsulenterfaring er et krav.

Du har erfaring fra et konsulenthus, hvor du har arbejdet direkte med kunder og taget ansvar for komplekse data science-, machine learning- eller AI-leverancer.




Vi lægger vægt på, at du:

Har haft en ledende teknisk rolle eller taget tydeligt ansvar i komplekse kundeprojekter
Har udviklet og implementeret produktionsorienterede løsninger inden for machine learning og/eller generativ AI
Har stærke kompetencer i Python, kan arbejde sikkert med SQL og har forståelse for moderne software engineering
Har erfaring med Azure, Databricks, Snowflake, Microsoft Fabric eller tilsvarende cloudplatforme
Forstår deployment, test, CI/CD, monitorering, governance og driftsoverdragelse
Kan omsætte forretningsbehov til tekniske løsninger og kommunikere valg, risici og trade-offs til kunden
Har erfaring med at sparre med kolleger og gerne bidraget til scoping, estimering eller genanvendelige løsninger




Du behøver ikke være ekspert i både machine learning og generativ AI. Det afgørende er, at du har dokumenteret dybde inden for mindst ét område og kan samarbejde troværdigt med andre specialister om den samlede løsning.




Det tilbyder vi

Hos Inspari bliver du en del af et ambitiøst konsulenthus med stærk specialisering inden for data og AI og komplekse opgaver hos enterprise-kunder.

Du får blandt andet:

Ansvar for komplekse AI- og machine learning-leverancer med synlig kundeværdi
Mulighed for at sætte teknisk retning og påvirke, hvordan vi udvikler vores AI-løsninger
Et stærkt fagligt miljø på tværs af data science, software, automation og Data Platform
Gode muligheder for faglig udvikling og videre specialisering
Fleksible arbejdsforhold og mulighed for hybridarbejde
En kultur præget af høj faglighed, ansvar, samarbejde og Heartwork




Lokation

Du vil være tilknyttet vores kontor i Lystrup ved Aarhus eller Kgs. Lyngby. Arbejdet foregår i en hybrid model mellem kontoret, kunderne og hjemmearbejdspladsen.




Rejseaktivitet

Som konsulent må du forvente en vis rejseaktivitet. Omfanget afhænger af projekterne og planlægges løbende i samarbejde med dig.




Ansøg

Hvis rollen matcher din erfaring, faglige profil og det ansvar, du ønsker fremover, glæder vi os til at modtage dit CV og din ansøgning.

Vi afholder samtaler løbende og ansætter, når vi har fundet det rette match. Forventet opstart er den 1. oktober 2026.




Har du spørgsmål til rollen eller processen, kan du kontakte Talent Acquisition Director Steffen Krogsgaard på krog@inspari.dk.

We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.

We’re a diverse team of more than 3,000 tech experts united by a drive to make a difference. Title: Lead Sustainability Data Scientist
Place: Gladsaxe, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
We offer a unique opportunity to shape the future of sustainability data analytics, AI and forecasting at Novo Nordisk. Are you ready lead the development of sustainability forecasting models, scenarios, and predictive analytics to support strategic decision-making. If so, then you might be our new Lead Sustainability Data scientist working as part of the Sustainability Data Solutions and AI Team at Novo Nordisk.

The position

We offer an exciting and challenging role where you will play a significant part in tackling sustainability challenges through data and AI. A key focus will be on identifying, establishing and maintaining accurate data from source-system to final data metrics. The aim is to ensure timely sustainability reporting, delivery of data products and develop our forecasts. In this role, you will play an important role in optimizing the overall data process from the collection of data and all the way to turning it into relevant products.

The position will be working across various departments in and outside sustainability thus, working at the intersection of sustainability and technology, ensuring the development of data analytics and providing decision support. To succeed in this, you can apply a highly structured working approach while collaborating with a wide variety of stakeholders globally and across the business

As part of the Sustainability Data and AI team, your main responsibilities will be to:


Deliver the technical forecasting solution for sustainability, combining commercial data with capacity plans, supply chain and procurement data, and others
Collect data from various source systems, sometimes manual, and identify potential optimisations e.g. digitalisation, AI, etc.
Deliver full End-2-End analytics from business requirement to data source/availability to end product (e.g. front end or model)
Set direction for the application of advanced analytics such as machine learning, predictive modelling and AI models within related to sustainability


Qualifications

You are structured with a strong business understanding from a corporate setting or consultancy and proven data and digital skills. You can open doors, challenge status quo and build business sound analytics. You thrive in a high-paced environment where not everything is a straight line.

The Right Candidate Should Have The Following Skills


Proven track record (+5 years) of preparing, analysing and designing data for analytical purposes in the space of sustainability or data science within a corporate setting or consultancy
A degree in Management, Engineering, Data science or Sustainability with strong data acumen
Profound user experience in BI solutions such as Microsoft Power Suite, Tableau or similar.
At the forefront of understanding and applying AI
Experience in data analytics or engineering through self-service analytics such as Alteryx and able to work in coding languages e.g. Python, Julia or others. Experience working with solutions such as Databricks, Snowflake or Haystack is a plus but not a pre-requisite
Some prior experience working with sustainability analytics, reporting or modelling will be an advantage
Good communication skills


As a person we are looking for someone who enjoys being part of a fast-paced, diverse team and at the same time can work with a high degree of independence. You support those around you and work in a highly structured manner with a clear eye for details. Someone who is proactive and collaborative. You are ambitious and naturally focused on your deliverable. You bring the ability to deep dive into models and also to communicate with those with less technical insight than you. Finally, you have strong communication skills, both oral and written English. The ideal candidate excels at building and maintaining strong relationships with a wide range of stakeholders across different functions.

About The Department

The Sustainability Data Solutions and AI team is part of the Sustainability Strategy and Insights Department in Novo Nordisk. The team consists of highly skilled data analysts and data engineers as well as business analysts who drive data analytics on the sustainability agenda on behalf of Novo Nordisk. The Department is currently consisting of 7 people in HQ, 2 colleagues in Poland and 2 colleagues in Bangalore, India. We work closely with stakeholders across Novo Nordisk to implement the sustainability strategy across our entire value chain.

Working in Novo Nordisk

Novo Nordisk is a leading global healthcare company with a 100-year legacy of driving change to defeat serious chronic diseases. Building on our strong legacy within diabetes, we are growing massively and expanding our commitment, reaching millions around the world and impacting more than 40 million patient lives daily. All of this has made us one of the 20 most valuable companies in the world by market cap. Our success relies on the joint potential and collaboration of our more than 65,000 employees around the world.

We recognize the importance of the unique skills and perspectives our people bring to the table, and we work continuously to bring out the best in them. Working at Novo Nordisk, we’re working toward something bigger than ourselves, and it’s a collective effort. Join us! Together, we go further. Together, we’re life changing.

What We Offer

At Novo Nordisk, you’ll join a global healthcare company with a unique culture and strong results. We offer continuous learning, career development, and benefits tailored to your life and career stage.

Salary: For this role, the Annual Base Salary ranges from 742,600DKK to 1,091,600DKK, corresponding to the level of the position.

The placement within the salary range will be assessed during the recruitment process based on the candidate’s skills, competencies, knowledge, and relevant experience.

Incentives and Benefits: The salary package may include short-term and/or long-term incentives as well as other employee benefits based on position level, location, functional area and relevant market benchmarks.

Learn more about our Reward Philosophy here.

Contact

For further information, please contact Kim Salling, Director, Sustainability Data Solutions and AI

Deadline

September 11th, 2026

Please note that we will be reviewing applications on an ongoing basis, and we encourage you to apply as soon as possible. We will close this recruitment when we have found the right candidate.

You do not need to attach a cover letter to your application, but please include a few sentences about why you are applying in your resume or CV. To ensure an efficient and fair recruitment process, please refrain from adding a photo in your CV.

We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all our job applicants.

Share knowledge and develop best practices within Data Science

Experience in practical project execution and delivery to demanding businesses
Fluent Danish, as several of our clients are public authorities. 
Fast learning and a proactive mindset
Outgoing personality with excellent presentation skills, both toward business leaders and technical experts
Exceptional human and collaboration skills

Title: Senior Data Scientist - System Optimization
Place: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
The Impact You'll Make

Are you an experienced data scientist who wants to model how real energy networks physically behave — and then optimize across them?

Join Danfoss Digital Solutions, Utility, and help unlock the flexibility of district energy in the green transition.

The Vision We Are Building Towards
District heating and cooling utilities are facing their most demanding transition yet — changing production sources, electrified heat, volatile energy markets and a hard decarbonization mandate — operated, for the most part, with tools that optimize one asset or one hour at a time.

Our ambition is system-level optimization across production, network and demand, so that a utility can bring the best possible energy-economic value while honoring its decarbonization commitments.

What You’ll Be Doing
We are looking for a Senior Data Scientist to deepen the modelling and optimization core of our Utility team. You will apply mathematical modeling, programming skills and optimization theory to ensure our products deliver maximal value to our customers.

Some Of The Key Activities Will Include

Develop and extend our thermo-hydraulic simulation tools for district energy networks by applying physical modelling principles — flow, pressure and temperature dynamics across the network — augmented with machine learning and data driven methods.
Calibrate and validate the physical models against live network measurements, closing the loop between simulation, real operating data, and the hydraulic behavior of the networks we run.
Advance our production optimization solutions, where Mixed-Integer Linear Programming (MILP) and related techniques plan heat production and storage across grid-scale utilities.
Connect the layers into system-level optimization — production, network and demand treated as one problem, from heat producers through to consumers, including demand-side response.
Build and develop the data pipelines your models depend on, together with our data engineering platform team.
Own the problem and communicate with our customers – deeply understand the problem to solve, possible solution discovery, prototyping and validation. You can communicate technical solutions to non-technical collaboration partners.


The Team
Your main development team is based in Denmark, working with colleagues across several European locations. Beyond your daily team, you join a data science community in Denmark of experienced data scientists working on problems next to yours — production optimization, thermo-hydraulic network simulation, temperature optimization and forecasting. You will have people to think out loud with, review your models and challenge your assumptions, and you will do the same for them.

What We're Looking For
You are an experienced data scientist who knows how to solve complex problems by applying data modelling. You have experience working in a large development team in a modern software development environment. You own the problem and solution and at the same time collaborate with the team to make it happen.

On top of that, you should be able to check off as many of the following as possible:


Hold a Master’s degree or higher in a relevant quantitative field (mathematics, machine learning, statistics, physics, engineering, etc.)
PhD degree is a benefit, but not a strict requirement
Several years of experience applying data modelling to complex physical or industrial systems
Excellent command of Python as this is used as our main programming tool
Solid knowledge of district energy and thermo-hydraulic simulation — experience with physical modelling of flow, pressure and temperature in fluid networks is central to this role
Familiarity with numerical methods for simulating dynamic physical systems, and calibrating such models with measurement data
Experience in solving complex optimization problems, for example with Mixed-Integer Linear Programming (MILP), is an advantage
Experience with C# and C++ is appreciated, as these are used for some of our legacy solutions
Fluent in English
Willing to apply and learn about advanced methodology in the district energy field
Interested in blending physical models of heating and cooling systems with data-driven methods


Location
This position is based in our office in Copenhagen or Kolding, Denmark — Copenhagen preferred. We work closely as a team on site, and we are looking for someone who will be based in one of these two locations.

What You'll Get From Us
At Danfoss, we are engineering solutions that allow the world to use resources in smarter ways — driving the sustainable transformation of tomorrow.

Purpose-driven work. District energy is one of the most effective levers for decarbonising heat. The models you build shape how much fuel is burned, how much CO₂ is emitted, and how much value a utility can capture from flexible operation.

Depth, and the mandate to go deeper. Physics-based modelling of real networks is where our expertise sits and where we intend to stay ahead. This is not a feature factory — the hard modelling problem is the product.

Growth. We value continuous development and encourage it through courses, rotations and career tracks.

We believe that innovation and great results are driven by the right mix of people with diverse backgrounds, personalities, skills, and perspectives, reflecting the world in which we do business.

Ready to Make a Difference?

If this role excites you, we’d love to hear from you! Apply now to start the conversation and learn more about where your career can go with us.

Our Commitment to Transparency

The actual salary offer will carefully consider a wide range of factors, including your skills, qualifications, experience, and location. Any benefits listed do not promise or guarantee any particular benefit or specific action. They may depend on country or contract specifics and are subject to change at any time without prior notice.

We are looking for a Senior Data Scientist to deepen the modelling and optimization core of our Utility team. You will apply mathematical modeling, programming skills and optimization theory to ensure our products deliver maximal value to our customers.

Some Of The Key Activities Will Include
  • Develop and extend our thermo-hydraulic simulation tools for district energy networks by applying physical modelling principles — flow, pressure and temperature dynamics across the network — augmented with machine learning and data driven methods.
  • Calibrate and validate the physical models against live network measurements, closing the loop between simulation, real operating data, and the hydraulic behavior of the networks we run.
  • Advance our production optimization solutions, where Mixed-Integer Linear Programming (MILP) and related techniques plan heat production and storage across grid-scale utilities.
  • Connect the layers into system-level optimization — production, network and demand treated as one problem, from heat producers through to consumers, including demand-side response.
  • Build and develop the data pipelines your models depend on, together with our data engineering platform team.
  • Own the problem and communicate with our customers – deeply understand the problem to solve, possible solution discovery, prototyping and validation. You can communicate technical solutions to non-technical collaboration partners.

The Team
Your main development team is based in Denmark, working with colleagues across several European locations. Beyond your daily team, you join a data science community in Denmark of experienced data scientists working on problems next to yours — production optimization, thermo-hydraulic network simulation, temperature optimization and forecasting. You will have people to think out loud with, review your models and challenge your assumptions, and you will do the same for them.

What We're Looking For
You are an experienced data scientist who knows how to solve complex problems by applying data modelling. You have experience working in a large development team in a modern software development environment. You own the problem and solution and at the same time collaborate with the team to make it happen.

On top of that, you should be able to check off as many of the following as possible:

  • Hold a Master’s degree or higher in a relevant quantitative field (mathematics, machine learning, statistics, physics, engineering, etc.)
  • PhD degree is a benefit, but not a strict requirement
  • Several years of experience applying data modelling to complex physical or industrial systems
  • Excellent command of Python as this is used as our main programming tool
  • Solid knowledge of district energy and thermo-hydraulic simulation — experience with physical modelling of flow, pressure and temperature in fluid networks is central to this role
  • Familiarity with numerical methods for simulating dynamic physical systems, and calibrating such models with measurement data
  • Experience in solving complex optimization problems, for example with Mixed-Integer Linear Programming (MILP), is an advantage
  • Experience with C# and C++ is appreciated, as these are used for some of our legacy solutions
  • Fluent in English
  • Willing to apply and learn about advanced methodology in the district energy field
  • Interested in blending physical models of heating and cooling systems with data-driven methods

Location
This position is based in our office in Copenhagen or Kolding, Denmark — Copenhagen preferred. We work closely as a team on site, and we are looking for someone who will be based in one of these two locations.

What You'll Get From Us
At Danfoss, we are engineering solutions that allow the world to use resources in smarter ways — driving the sustainable transformation of tomorrow.

Purpose-driven work. District energy is one of the most effective levers for decarbonising heat. The models you build shape how much fuel is burned, how much CO₂ is emitted, and how much value a utility can capture from flexible operation.

Depth, and the mandate to go deeper. Physics-based modelling of real networks is where our expertise sits and where we intend to stay ahead. This is not a feature factory — the hard modelling problem is the product.

Growth. We value continuous development and encourage it through courses, rotations and career tracks.

We believe that innovation and great results are driven by the right mix of people with diverse backgrounds, personalities, skills, and perspectives, reflecting the world in which we do business.

Ready to Make a Difference?

If this role excites you, we’d love to hear from you! Apply now to start the conversation and learn more about where your career can go with us.

They may depend on country or contract specifics and are subject to change at any time without prior notice.

Title: Data Scientist
Description:
What if your first years in the field of data science and software development were not only about maintenance, but about shaping systems?




At NORDEN, we empower global trade through data, technology and deep industry knowledge. Behind every decision, there is a need to understand risk, navigate uncertainty and create transparency. That is where you come in.




This is a role for someone who is still developing their technical toolbox but is interested in learning, ask questions and grow in a business where technology is closely connected to real-world decisions.




You will not be handed a narrow set of development tasks. Instead, you will be supported by experienced colleagues while gradually taking on more responsibility, exploring new ideas and helping shape solutions from concept to production in a collaborative environment where knowledge sharing and curiosity are valued.







Why this role?

This role sits at the intersection of software development, engineering and business understanding.

You will work across the full development lifecycle, from understanding business challenges and designing architecture to implementing solutions and ensuring stable operations in production. At the same time, you will gain unique insights into risk management, finance and decarbonisation in a global shipping company.




As a Data Scientist in our Risk Management team, you will help build the systems that support risk measurement, financial performance analysis and decarbonisation initiatives across our business.

You will work with modern technologies in Azure and be part of a team that develops and owns its solutions end-to-end. This means you will see the direct impact of your work and can continuously improve and evolve the systems you build.




Most importantly, you will join a friendly, collaborative and people-focused environment where your ideas are welcomed, your development is supported and your contributions genuinely matter. You will join six teammates in Risk and Financial Analytics who pair an understanding of the business with technical know-how to deliver effective solutions.







What you will be doing

As a Data Scientist, you will play an important role in developing and maintaining analytical solutions that support key business decisions across NORDEN.




Among other things, you will:

Build scalable and maintainable software systems using clean, efficient and well-tested code.
Design, develop and support business-critical applications running in Azure.
Explore opportunities for applying AI to improve processes and create value.
Develop a good understanding of shipping and the business logic behind our systems.
Support risk analysts, voyage performance analysts and finance business partners with reliable and timely solutions.
Collaborate closely with stakeholders to translate business needs into technical solutions.
Contribute to the continuous improvement of our architecture, development practices and operational setup.







What you bring

We want a person who enjoys learning, approaches challenges with insight and uses technology to create solutions.




You likely have:

0-2 years of experience in working in software systems.
A degree within a relevant technical, economic or mathematical field.
A genuine interest in software development and building robust solutions.
Experience with, or an interest in, Azure Cloud technologies.
Good analytical and problem-solving skills.
Advanced English communication skills and the legal right to work in Denmark.




Beyond your technical skills, you enjoy collaborating with others and are comfortable engaging with a variety of stakeholders across the organisation. You are curious, open to new ideas and motivated by continuously improving how things are done.




If you are interested in bringing together software development, business insight and modern cloud technologies at a global company where your work makes a clear difference, we would like to hear from you.







Application

Please upload your motivation letter, resume and relevant diplomas via our website as soon as possible and no later than 21 September. Your motivation letter helps us understand what drives you, why you are interested in the role, and how your skills and experiences could contribute to the team. We are especially interested in your motivation and transferable skills, not a recap of your CV. It is your opportunity to tell us the story behind your application.




We review and interview candidates on an ongoing basis.




We will do our best to get back to you at least within ten working days after the application deadline, 21 September.




In NORDEN we value a range of perspectives, educational backgrounds and professional experience and encourages all qualified candidates to apply.




Were you missing anything in this job ad? Please share your feedback with us here.







Our company

We are a global provider of ocean-based freight services for bulk and project cargo of all sizes. We integrate freight solutions with port logistics, helping our customers optimise and decarbonise supply chains. We provide tailored solutions built on flexibility, reliability, and intelligence.




Our agile business model ensures stability by continuously adapting our fleet to market developments and customer needs.




Founded in 1871, NORDEN is one of Denmark’s oldest internationally operating shipping companies. Incorporated in Denmark, we are listed on Nasdaq Copenhagen as part of the OMX Nordic Large Cap index.




With offices across 6 continents, we are a truly integrated part of global trade.

Title: Quantitative analyst for Short-term Automated Trading
Description:
Quote

You will combine quantitative research, machine learning, and software engineering to uncover market inefficiencies and turn them into profitable trading strategies.

Here’s what the job entails

In the role, you will tackle challenging quantitative problems and develop fully automated, machine learning-driven trading strategies that operate 24/7 and have a direct impact on trading performance.

Your key responsibilities include:


designing, developing, and deploying machine learning-driven trading strategies using Python and modern machine learning/deep learning frameworks
transforming large-scale and high-dimensional datasets into actionable trading signals and predictive models
continuously improving existing models, infrastructure, and research processes to maintain a competitive edge
collaborating closely with traders and analysts to translate market insights into scalable quantitative solutions
staying at the forefront of developments in machine learning, deep learning, and quantitative finance, and taking full ownership of bringing new ideas into production


Meet your team

You will join our Short-term Automated Trading team, where we develop and operate algorithmic trading strategies in the European electricity markets by applying advanced quantitative methods, machine learning, and automation to make better trading decisions.

We are a team of highly motivated specialists with backgrounds in quantitative finance, mathematics, physics, computer science, and machine learning. We challenge each other's thinking, move quickly from idea to implementation, and share an ambition to build better models and make better trading decisions. We value intellectual curiosity, honest feedback, and rigorous thinking.

But enough about us… over to you!

You’ll work deeply with quantitative modelling and machine learning in a fast-moving domain, so you enjoy tackling complex quantitative challenges and turning ideas into measurable outcomes. You are driven by ownership, excellence, and the opportunity to collaborate with highly skilled colleagues.

We also imagine that you:


hold an MSc or PhD in data science, computer science, mathematics, physics, or a related field
are an advanced Python developer with experience building robust, production-quality code
have extensive experience with machine learning techniques and frameworks (e.g. PyTorch, Scikit-learn)
keep up with the latest innovation in machine learning and deep learning, and enjoy turning cutting-edge research into practical solutions that deliver measurable value


Please note that prior knowledge of the energy sector is not required for this role. We welcome various levels of experience from a highly analytical environment and will tailor the role to your profile.

We’ll take good care of you

At Danske Commodities, we take great care of our people. Joining us means you’ll get a lot of great perks – including social events, cultural experiences, tasty food and benefits to better your health, your life and your future.

Here are some of the benefits we offer our employees:

Shape your development tailored growth plans, 100+ DC University courses & Harvard Learning access

100+ yearly events from office parties to DC Sports events, CS:GO team, student network & more

Global career paths as part of our parent company, Equinor’s 20,000-strong international network

Flexible work life adjustable hours, part-time options & up to 2 work from home days/week

Fuel Fridays one paid Friday off every month (July and December excluded)

Top-tier parental leave up to 26 weeks paid, pension during leave & post-leave support

Unlimited paid child's sick days because family comes first

Extra time off 5 additional days on top of your 5 weeks

Senior days extra time off if you’re 55+

Attractive package 10% pension, health insurance, bonus scheme & more

Share savings the option to join Equinor’s attractive share programme

Home setup covered paid internet, phone & IT gear

Free tickets & discounts culture, family fun, hotels, restaurants & more

Organic meals light breakfast, lunch, snacks, dinner & take-away

Barista café high-quality coffee, always on us

On-site wellness state-of-the-art gym, physio, chiro and massage therapy

New HQ in the heart of Aarhus with stunning views, inspiring architecture and close to public transport

…. and much more

We're an energy trading and optimisation company that works at the intersection of technology and energy economics. Our disciplined and scalable trading strategies are designed to be competitive in volatile markets and create value for our partners.

Title: Senior Forward Deployed AI Scientist
Place: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Job ID: 3090

Welcome to Group Technology, where we pride ourselves on engineering solutions that directly impact Nordea's 2030 goals to modernize data technology and accelerate AI.

We are looking for a skilled and collaborative Senior Forward Deployed AI Scientist to join our Forward Deployed AI team at Nordea. You will design and build scalable AI solutions, working closely with cross-functional teams to deliver agentic AI applications that drive value across the organization while ensuring ethical and sustainable development practices. 

Nordea is a place where traditions meet tomorrow. We are not just a bank; we are a tech employer on a mission to evolve finance securely and responsibly. Together, we impact millions of people's daily lives by ensuring they can access our solutions anytime, anywhere, while safeguarding their personal data and wealth. Join us in making an impact on the banking industry.

This position is a full-time, permanent role with hybrid working location based in Helsinki, Finland, Stockholm, Sweden, Gdańsk / Gdynia / Warsaw, Poland, or Copenhagen, Denmark. 

About Our Team   

Meet the Forward Deployed AI team. We are a collaborative and result-driven team working closely with every part of the bank to execute AI use cases. Our deep connections throughout Nordea and trusted reputation enable us to transform ambitious AI visions into practical, impactful solutions.

In this role, you will be embedded with the business areas, building strong partnerships and gaining deep domain expertise. This collaboration creates natural pathways for future career development, including potential transitions into business teams where your AI expertise will be highly valued. 

Main responsibilities in this role include, but are not limited to:


Design, develop, and scale transformative AI applications from concept to production to create technology that makes a real impact.
Translate ambiguous, open-ended business problems into well-defined machine learning problem statements in close collaboration with engineers and product teams.
Provide input to the full modeling lifecycle: problem framing, hypothesis formulation, model selection, experimentation, evaluation and iteration.
Develop and implement advanced machine learning models and agentic solutions for various business applications.
Explore emerging AI methods; share insights and build proofs of concept applicable to Nordea’s use cases.


Who You Are  

You will thrive in this role if you are excited to build AI solutions that solve real-world problems and drive meaningful change. You bring a growth mindset, collaborative problem-solving skills and excel at transforming complex technical concepts into clear solutions for both technical and non-technical audiences. 

We are looking for someone with most of the following experience and skills:  


BSc, MSc or PhD in Computer Science, Engineering Physics, Data Science, Statistics, or equivalent practical experience
Strong software engineering fundamentals and proficiency in Python, with minimum 3 years of hands-on experience developing and deploying AI/ML solutions in production environments
Hands-on experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure or GCP), with a focus on deploying and operating AI/ML and data services at scale
Deep understanding of machine learning and statistics, with the ability to turn a business problem into a modelling one
Strong communication skills with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to both technical teams and business stakeholders 
Excellent collaboration skills and experience working with diverse teams including data scientists, engineers, and product stakeholders


It would be ideal if you also have: 


Knowledge of agent testing methodologies, performance monitoring and maintaining agent reliability in production environments
Experience using agentic AI tools like Claude Code/Cowork, OpenAI Codex
Experience working in agile environments or tech-driven transformation projects
Familiarity with agent development frameworks and harnesses such as LangGraph, Deep Agents, AutoGen, CrewAI or similar, including multi-agent coordination and sub-agent delegation
Professional experience from working in regulated industries, e.g. banking, government, etc. 


We encourage applications from candidates who are passionate about AI and meet most of these criteria. We value diverse perspectives and welcome applicants from all backgrounds. 

If this sounds like you, get in touch!

Next steps

We kindly ask you to submit your application as soon as possible, but no later than 20/09/2026. Any applications or CVs sent by email, direct messages, or any other channel than our application forms, will not be accepted or considered.

At Nordea, we know that an inclusive workplace is a sustainable workplace. We deeply believe that our diverse backgrounds, experiences, characteristics, and traits make us better at serving our customers and communities.

Title: Machine Learning Researcher
Place: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Imagine working with cutting-edge machine learning models, crunching high frequency data sets and sparring with exceptional and fun colleagues, all while taking part in scaling our business even further.




Does this sound highly appealing to you? Then you might be our new Machine Learning Researcher at Alipes.




At Alipes, we have been the market leader in automating the financial markets since we started back in 2008, shaping a fully automatic natural language processing system for reading and interpreting financial news.




To accomplish our mission of being the best at what we do, we understand the importance of elevating our predictive modeling standards to the highest levels. Your work will involve leading the efforts in creating a world class modeling workflow, enabling the team to seamlessly turn massive data sets of financial information into mathematical models that accurately predict movements in the financial markets.




In doing so, you will get a chance to tackle a variety of software infrastructure challenges, such as:

Development and optimization of calibration and benchmarking frameworks
Building out and implementing best practices for data preparation and dataset generation pipelines
Prototyping and releasing novel predictive architectures, especially with respect to time-series models.




You will get instant validation of your work and experience short feedback cycles, where going from inception to deployment can be a matter of hours. There will be no red tape to cut and no sales people to consult.




About the team

All of this will happen in an informal atmosphere where technical discussions are valued, and you are encouraged to take ownership of, and pride in, your work. You will impact the direction of the team, prioritize your work and choose the tools that get the job done. We are a tight-knit modeling team with fourteen passionate quantitative researchers covering 6 nationalities – eleven PhD’s and three MSc’s with expertise in statistical analysis, mathematical modeling and machine learning. We enjoy collaboration and are always willing to lend a helping hand. We are working alongside two other teams of software developers and traders that implement and conceive the mathematical models together with us. What makes this constellation work great is that all of the individual team members write code and understand that a seemingly trivial change can actually require a lot of work, and vice versa.




About you

Fluency within mathematics and statistics.
Experience working with the full Machine Learning stack from data generation through model calibration and real-life validation and monitoring.
Programming experience with Python, in particular data-wrangling and numerical programming.
Proficiency with computer science fundamentals.
A scientific and inquisitive mind.




Nice to have

Experience working with ‘out-of-core’ datasets.
Experience working with tools like PyTorch, Tensorflow, XGBoost and/or Catboost.
Programming experience with languages like C# and C/C++.
PhD or MSc degree in engineering, physics, computer science, mathematics or economics.




What we can offer you

Competitive benefits, including pension, health insurance, and 30 days of vacation.
A modern, harbour front office in Copenhagen (Nordhavn) with a flexible hybrid work model.
A flat hierarchy with high levels of trust, autonomy, and freedom to make decisions.
A valued role with unique responsibilities and plenty of room for creativity.
Fast feedback and recognition of your contributions in a high-growth company.
Strong team spirit - successes are celebrated with company events and trips.




Practicalities

To apply, please send us your CV and, in lieu of providing a cover letter, concisely answer the questions on the application. If your profile looks like a good match, we will get in touch to coordinate an online technical test as a first step in the interview process.




Should you have questions about the role that you would like clarified before applying, you're welcome to send an email to quant_jobs@alipescapital.com. Please note that applications should not be sent to the email address but rather via the job link.

Title: Join Halfspace’s AI & Advanced Analytics Team - Shaping the Future with AI
Place: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Who We Are

At Halfspace, Part of Accenture - Center for Advanced AI - we believe that the smallest edge can make the biggest difference. We began in sports, predicting outcomes in live football matches, and today we bring that same precision and ambition into the world of business. We're here to unlock value through artificial intelligence and help organisations make better, more informed decisions, faster.

With more than one hundred AI and data projects delivered, our work has transformed industries and earned international recognition. But awards and numbers tell only part of the story. What truly defines us is our people. Our team comes from leading institutions such as KU, DTU, Stanford, Oxford, Harvard, Caltech, Yale, Colombia and many more, blending expertise in physics, engineering, mathematics, statistics, operations research, computer science, chemistry, economics, biology, design and strategy. Together, we share curiosity, boldness, and a pioneering spirit.

Halfspace is a specialized spearheading unit within Accenture, focused on bringing the deepest expertise in applied AI. We are 'Inch Wide - Mile Deep' in our capabilities.

What You'll Be Doing

As part of the AI & Advanced Analytics team at Halfspace, you’ll be working at the cutting edge of artificial intelligence — designing, building, and deploying systems that push what’s possible. You’ll contribute to the development of intelligent agents, generative AI models, and advanced analytical frameworks that deliver real-world impact across industries.

You’ll work alongside engineers, scientists, and strategists from some of the world’s leading institutions, applying deep technical expertise and creative thinking to solve complex problems. From prototyping novel AI applications to operationalizing models at scale, you’ll bridge research and engineering to turn ideas into solutions that redefine performance.

Every experiment, model, and insight you create will help organizations make better decisions, faster — embodying our mission to deliver the smallest edge that makes the biggest difference.

Who We're Looking For

We’re looking for curious and technically exceptional individuals who live at the intersection of AI, mathematics, and software. You combine a strong foundation in statistical modeling and machine learning with the creativity and rigor to turn theory into working systems.

You’re fluent in Python and comfortable working with modern AI stacks — whether that means fine-tuning large language models, architecting agentic systems, or building robust analytical pipelines.

For our Generative AI unit we value:



Strong proficiency in Python and core AI libraries

Experience working with integrating Generative AI and developing AI Agents or other applications

Intellectual curiosity, precision, and a pioneering mindset — the qualities that define Halfspace



For our Advanced Analytics unit we value:



Strong proficiency in Python and core ML libraries

Solid understanding of statistical modeling, optimization, and experimental design

Familiarity with MLOps and model deployment practices

Intellectual curiosity, precision, and a pioneering mindset — the qualities that define Halfspace



If you have less than two years of professional experience, please include your academic transcripts with your application.

Life at Halfspace, part of Accenture

We think and act like a professional sports team. We value flexibility, trust, and balance. We invest in learning and development to keep our team ahead of the curve on everything AI. And we create an environment where ambitious people can grow while working on projects that matter, side by side with some of the world’s leading companies and greatest minds.

About Halfspace, Part Of Accenture

Halfspace was established in 2015. We're on a mission to bring the power of artificial intelligence to industry and deliver exceptional quality and value, whenever we engage, while creating a space which attracts the brightest, most curious and most talented people. As of March 2025 Halfspace became a part of Accenture to help build and grow the Accenture Center for Advanced AI across the Nordics and EMEA.

Title: Commercial AI & Data Lead - Aurocon
Description:
Kan du omsætte data fra Aurocons intelligente IoT-forbundne Aurotrap-enheder til konkrete produkter, bedre beslutningsgrundlag og nye kommercielle muligheder?




Fra IoT-data til produktudvikling og forretningsmuligheder




Aurocons voksende base af IoT-forbundne Aurotrap-enheder genererer store mængder data om blandt andet hændelser, sensoraktivitet, connectivity, batteri, drift og installationer. Som ansvarlig for AI & Data bringer du disse data i spil.




Stillingen kombinerer strategi med hands-on udvikling, og særligt i starten er du selv den tekniske drivkraft. Du analyserer data, skriver kode, bygger prototyper og dokumenterer, hvor AI og machine learning kan skabe reel kunde- og forretningsværdi.




Dit ansvar omfatter blandt andet at:

kombinere IoT- og tidsseriedata med produktdata, historiske hændelser, supportviden og teknisk dokumentation
skabe struktur, kvalitet og en skalerbar arkitektur omkring virksomhedens datagrundlag
udvikle machine-learning-løsninger til analyse, anomalidetektion, klassifikation og prædiktion
definere og implementere Aurocons AI- og datastrategi
udvikle fundamentet for en modeluafhængig Aurocon AI Engine baseret på egne data og domæneviden
identificere nye AI- og dataprodukter, der øger værdien af Aurotrap-platformen og kan skabe recurring revenue
arbejde hands-on med LLM'er, RAG, embeddings, vector databases, function calling og AI-agenter
udvikle proof-of-concepts og bringe de rigtige løsninger fra prototype til produktion sammen med CTO og udviklingsteamet




Du refererer direkte til CEO, arbejder tæt sammen med CTO og udviklingsteamet og kommunikerer med både kunder og kommercielle samarbejdspartnere. CTO har ansvaret for hardware, embedded software, firmware og den tekniske produktplatform, mens du får ejerskab for data, analytics, machine learning og AI.




Teknisk builder med blik for produkt og forretning




Du er enten Head of AI i dag eller er klar til dit næste karriereskridt fra din nuværende position som AI Engineer, ML Engineer, Data Scientist, Applied AI Lead eller tilsvarende. Det afgørende er din tekniske tyngde, evne til selv at bygge løsninger og din ambition om med tiden at tage et strategisk og ledelsesmæssigt ansvar.




Du har solid erfaring med flere af følgende områder:

Data Science, Machine Learning og generativ AI
Python, SQL, data engineering og større datamængder
LLM-arkitektur, RAG, embeddings og vector databases
function calling og AI-agenter
API-integrationer, model deployment og MLOps/LLMOps
cloud-, data- og analyticsarkitektur.




Kendskab til f.eks. Qwen, Llama, Mistral, OpenAI, Anthropic, Hugging Face eller vLLM er relevant. Du er ikke bundet til én teknologistak, men har en pragmatisk tilgang til teknologi og vurderer modeller og løsninger ud fra kvalitet, økonomi, latency, sikkerhed, GDPR, skalerbarhed og den konkrete forretningsværdi.




Derudover har du erfaring med IoT, tidsseriedata, hardware-enabled software og operationelle eventdata.




Du er analytisk stærk, nysgerrig og selvkørende og trives med opgaver, hvor løsningen ikke er defineret på forhånd.




Din tekniske faglighed kombinerer du med et produkt- og forretningsorienteret mindset, der gør dig i stand til at prioritere muligheder ud fra kundeværdi, betalingsvillighed, differentiering, udviklingsomkostninger og skalerbarhed.




En spændende karrieremulighed




Du får en sjælden mulighed for at bygge et strategisk vigtigt område fra bunden. Aurocon har allerede de fysiske produkter, en international installeret base og et voksende datasæt fra enheder i virkelige miljøer. Ambitionen er, at data og AI bliver en central del af virksomhedens næste produktgeneration og langsigtede konkurrenceevne.




I takt med at området vokser, får du mulighed for at opbygge og lede et AI- og datateam. For den rette profil kan stillingen derfor blive et markant karriereskridt fra teknisk specialist til leder med et bredere strategisk teknologiansvar.




Om Aurocon




Auroconudvikler og producerer avancerede løsninger til skadedyrsbekæmpelse baseret på banebrydende teknologi.




Flagskibsproduktet The Aurotrap med tilhørende IT platform og mobil app, er en IoT baseret intelligent, giftfri multi-kill rottefælde, som gør det muligt at overvåge og håndtere rotteaktivitet i realtid.




Fra hovedsædet i Aalborg opererer Aurocon.io på internationale markeder og leverer løsninger, der forbedrer både operationel effektivitet og miljømæssig bæredygtighed.

Title: Machine Learning Engineer
Place: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Veo is a global leader in AI-based sports camera technology. Our innovative, fully automatic camera solution enables sports teams to record matches and training sessions without a camera operator. We’re democratizing the world of sports by granting video analysis for teams on all levels—a privilege that used to be only for the few. More than 50,000 clubs in 90+ countries record their games every week.

Growing as fast as we do in Veo means that every day is different, exciting, and challenging, both on the front line and in the back office.

But that’s not the most remarkable thing about us.

The coolest thing is our people. We’ve attracted some of the brightest minds in the industry. They are the reason we can create a great product and do it while enjoying ourselves.

As a Machine Learning Engineer at Veo you will get to work on challenging problems and directly contribute to the value created by our AI-driven end-user products.

You will become part of our AI team, which comprises 15 researchers and engineers responsible for all stages in the machine learning lifecycles across different projects - from scoping and defining data annotation tasks to modeling, validation, and deployment. You will be free to determine the directions of the project you work on while also getting feedback and being encouraged to spar with the rest of the team to assist each other in improving and succeeding.

We stay current with the latest research and continuously discuss concepts and ideas in recent papers to assess their relevance to our tasks and product-specific challenges.

We are looking to add yet another ambitious, high-performing junior to senior engineer/researcher with proven experience from real-world machine learning projects to the team. Experience with computer vision is advantageous but not a must.

What you will do:



Train state-of-the-art machine learning models
Write efficient inference pipelines for cloud and edge
Define and supervise data annotation tasks
Improve evaluation schemes to increase understanding of model performance and shortcomings
Contribute to long-term planning and prioritization of tasks




What you will need:



MSc or PhD in a relevant field
Hands-on experience with real-world, large-scale machine-learning projects
Great coding skills
Skilled at both autonomous tasks and contributing to group efforts
Ability to examine details closely and critically




Our Copenhagen office mirrors our innovative technology – with an indoor ball court, rooftop terrace, and well-equipped gym. We have created a facility that supports connecting disciplines across the business, facilitates creative thinking, and gives the space to engage with colleagues, our global partners, and the entire Veo community.

Values we hold at Veo:

Dare - We take initiative, stay curious, and challenge the status quo in our work.

Own it - We drive impact by identifying opportunities, taking responsibility, and confidently executing.

Level up - We embrace growth, continuously learning and shaping our skills.

Play as a team - We collaborate across a diverse organization, leveraging shared insights for stronger

outcomes.

Customer Centric - We deliver value by having close partnerships and a deep understanding of our customers (internally and externally)

We value diversity and inclusion and welcome applicants from all backgrounds, even if your experience doesn’t completely match every qualification listed. What matters most is your creativity, potential, and ability to make meaningful contributions.

Title: Senior Clinical Data Scientist
Place: Gladsaxe, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Clinical Data Management and Programming

Søborg or Aalborg, Denmark

Join Novo Nordisk as a Senior Clinical Data Scientist and play a key role in delivering high-quality clinical trial data that supports the development of innovative medicines for people living with serious chronic diseases. Working closely with global trial teams, statisticians, and regulatory experts, you will drive clinical data science activities throughout the clinical development lifecycle, from trial setup and execution to regulatory submissions.

Your new role

As a Senior Clinical Data Scientist, you will play a pivotal role in planning, executing, and delivering clinical data science activities across global clinical development programmes. As a key member of multidisciplinary trial teams, you will collaborate with regulatory experts and external partners to ensure the delivery of high-quality, compliant, and submission-ready clinical data.

Your Responsibilities Will Include


Leading clinical data science activities from trial setup through analysis, submission, regulatory interactions, and the preparation of regulatory submission documents.
Providing expertise on trial design components, including electronic case report forms (eCRFs), Data Flow Plans, Blinding Plans, protocols, and statistical analysis plans.
Ensuring high-quality Study Data Tabulation Model (SDTM), Analysis Data Model (ADaM), and tables, figures, and listings (TFL) deliverables that meet industry standards and Novo Nordisk requirements.
Acting as an operational partner within trial squads, supporting key data-driven decisions and collaborating with internal and external stakeholders, including contract research organisations and functional suppliers, to drive efficient and compliant trial execution.
Driving continuous improvement, innovation, and knowledge sharing within Clinical Data Science, while helping to shape future standards and ways of working.


Your new department

You will join Clinical Data Management and Programming, a global organisation responsible for delivering high-quality clinical trial data and analyses that support development activities and data submissions to governmental approval authorities. The department combines scientific excellence, advanced technology, and deep knowledge of clinical development to ensure reliable and efficient execution across the development portfolio.

As part of a highly collaborative and international environment, you will work closely with colleagues across Research and Development, as well as with internal and external partners worldwide. We foster a culture of continuous learning, innovation, knowledge sharing, and professional development, where diverse expertise comes together to solve complex data challenges and accelerate the delivery of medicines to help patients around the world.

Your Skills And Qualifications

We are looking for a proactive and scientifically driven professional who thrives in a collaborative environment and enjoys working on complex clinical data challenges.

You Will Ideally Have


A PhD or master’s degree in life sciences, natural sciences, engineering, or a related discipline, together with more than two years of experience in statistical programming and clinical trial data analysis, preferably within the pharmaceutical industry.
Strong programming skills in R, SAS, or similar programming languages, as well as experience with SDTM, ADaM, TFL generation, and regulatory submission deliverables.
Knowledge of clinical database technologies, data models, drug development processes, and Good Practice (GxP) requirements.
Experience collaborating across functions, geographies, and external partnerships, combined with strong analytical and problem-solving skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
Excellent planning, organisational, communication, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to explain technical topics to specialist and non-specialist audiences, a continuous improvement mindset, a genuine interest in innovation and new ways of working, and fluency in written and spoken English.


Success in this role requires a self-driven, accountable, and collaborative mindset. You enjoy working in multidisciplinary teams, take ownership of your deliverables, and are motivated by improving processes, developing expertise, and contributing to better outcomes for patients worldwide.

Working at Novo Nordisk

Every day we seek the solutions that defeat serious chronic diseases. To do this, we approach our work with determination, constant curiosity and a commitment to finding better ways forward. For over 100 years, this dedication has driven us to build a company focused on lasting change for long-term health. One where diverse thinking, shared purpose and mutual respect come together to create extraordinary results. At Novo Nordisk, you'll join a global healthcare company with a unique culture and strong results. We offer continuous learning, career development, and benefits tailored to your life and career stage.

The placement within the salary range will be assessed during the recruitment process based on the candidate’s skills, competencies, knowledge, and relevant experience.
