Title: Marketing Science Analyst
Description:
Are you experienced with data and analytics, and motivated by using them to make marketing and commercial decisions sharper for strong brands in Denmark and internationally?




We are looking for an experienced analyst to join the strategy unit within NoA Denmark. You will work alongside our lead Data Scientist and a team of experienced strategists on real client challenges for leading Danish and international brands.




What matters most is that you can put analytical methods to work in practice, and that you understand the commercial and marketing context they are applied in.




About NoA

The North Alliance (NoA) is one of the leading strategic and creative networks in the Nordics, with around 1200 people across the group. In Denmark, the NoA family includes &Co, NoA Ignite, Bold, NoA Health and NoA Connect.




We bring together strategy, creativity, design, technology and specialist expertise to help ambitious organisations create growth.




The strategy unit works across NoA, supporting its agencies and clients with strategic and analytical expertise. We focus on understanding how marketing creates value for the business, using data and analysis to help clients make better decisions.

The unit is newly established, giving you the opportunity to join early and help shape how we work.




What you will do

You will work closely with our lead Data Scientist and our strategists, running analyses within the frameworks and approaches he develops, and turning them into the data and insights our strategy consultants build recommendations on.




You will work hands-on with both third-party and client data from leading brands in Denmark and international markets. Your work may cover areas such as marketing performance, customer behaviour, campaign effectiveness and commercial outcomes.

Depending on the project, you might:




Build models and pipelines to gather and analyse web and other external data
Develop and test AI- and LLM-based tools for analysing marketing and advertising
Conduct statistical analyses and modelling, including correlations and regression
Contribute to marketing measurement frameworks, dashboards and reports
Explore new data sources, tools and techniques
Work with strategists and consultants to turn analysis into clear, actionable insights
Take part in client sessions and workshops, presenting findings in a way that lands with commercial and non-technical audiences




You will own your analyses end to end, with a strong senior team around you to spar with along the way.




What we are looking for

This role is suited to someone who already has experience from an agency, media or consultancy environment, or from an in-house marketing or commercial function. Exactly how many years matters less than what you have done with them. A background in Data Science, Statistics, Economics, Marketing or a related field is relevant, but what counts most is how you have applied it in practice.




We are looking for someone who:

Understands how marketing and media work commercially, and what actually drives value for a business
Works confidently and independently in Python or R, and is comfortable with SQL
Is strong at applying established analytical and statistical methods to messy, real-world client data
Can explain analysis clearly to non-technical audiences and hold their own in a room with senior stakeholders
Enjoys working with people from different disciplines
Is structured and reliable, and can take an analysis from brief to finished output without close supervision
Is comfortable working in English




Most importantly, you are someone who gets analyses done — pragmatic about method, precise about output, and focused on making the work genuinely useful to the client.




What we offer

Real ownership of analyses for leading brands from day one
Close collaboration with an experienced lead Data Scientist and a strong team of senior strategists
The opportunity to work on challenging projects for leading brands, Danish and international
Exposure to strategy, marketing, data science and AI in a real client environment
The chance to join a new unit early and help shape how we work
A collaborative culture with a flat hierarchy and room to develop
Great colleagues, high ambitions and plenty of fun along the way




Interested?

If this sounds like you, we would love to hear from you.




Please send us your CV and a brief application, including a short introduction to yourself and why you are interested in joining the strategy unit at NoA.




We review applications as they come in, and the right fit decides the start date.

Title: ID Power Algo Trader – AAL/CPH/SG
Description:
ROLE OVERVIEW

We are currently looking for a technically strong, analytically rigorous trader with deep experience in continuous markets and real-time modelling. This pivotal role calls for a seasoned professional who combines strong trading intuition with advanced statistical and programming capabilities, and who can translate ambiguous problems into structured models that drive PnL.




As a key member of our team, you will have the opportunity to contribute directly to the performance and evolution of our intraday power trading activities. This position requires analytical depth, strong decision-making under uncertainty, and a deep understanding of market structure, pricing mechanics, and liquidity dynamics. You must be comfortable operating in real-time environments, adapting to shifting market conditions, and continuously improving models and systems to enhance predictive accuracy and trading outcomes. Collaboration is central to success in this role; therefore, the ability to work seamlessly across trading and engineering teams is essential to optimizing strategies, improving infrastructure, and scaling automated decision-making.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Develop fair value models for intraday power markets
Implement algorithms to integrate models with market dynamics to inform trading strategy
Compile high-quality datasets to integrate fundamental and real-time market data
Monitor and adjust model parameters in response to shifting market conditions, liquidity regimes, or evolving trading situations
Identify model limitations, edge cases, and structural risks, and proactively address them
Collaborate with engineering to optimize operations, enhance infrastructure, and scale automated decision-making




QUALIFICATIONS AND REQUIREMENTS

Master’s degree in Mathematics, Economics, Engineering, or a related field, possession of a PhD will be considered an advantage.
A minimum of 3 years' experience is required
Extensive experience with continuous trading, whether in prediction markets, betting platforms, crypto, or traditional markets
Expertise in predictive modelling and machine learning, with a focus on time-series analysis.
Ability to articulate model assumptions, and real-world edge cases.
Proficiency in Python and SQL, with deep working knowledge of the data and machine learning ecosystem.
Experience in a statically typed programming language is a plus
Fluency in English is required. Knowledge of additional languages will be viewed favourably.




WHAT WE OFFER

Competitive compensation, inclusive of performance-based bonuses.
Comprehensive benefits package.
Pathways for professional growth and career development.
A dynamic and supportive work environment where innovation and creativity are encouraged.
Opportunity to be part of building a great business where your efforts are recognized and valued.

Thank you for your interest in Balyasny. Please understand that we have a large volume of applicants and regrettably cannot reply to each one, if your profile is suitable we will reach out.

Title: Quantitative Analyst
Description:
Are you driven, numerically sharp and eager to shape models, algorithms and decision-making at the center of a fast-moving energy trading firm? We’re looking for a Quantitative Analyst with strong analytical instincts and an interest in building production-ready solutions that push the boundaries between quantitative modelling and power trading. You should enjoy turning ideas into reality quickly, working with code, data and complex market dynamics to improve the tools that Nitor relies on every day.




As a Quantitative Analyst at Nitor Energy, you will help advance the models, algorithms and analytical frameworks that power our trading strategies. You will work directly with complex datasets, market dynamics and production-grade code to enhance the accuracy, speed and robustness of our decision-making tools. This role offers hands-on exposure to the full lifecycle of quantitative development in a modern energy-trading company, shaping ideas, testing assumptions and turning data-driven insights into real trading impact.




The Quantitative Analyst we’re looking for is motivated, analytical and want to help elevate our data, models and workflows while accelerating their own development. You should see yourself thriving in a team that executes quickly, turning ideas into production-ready solutions with a pragmatical mindset and sense of ownership.




Your tasks will include

Work closely with traders to develop and refine quantitative models that support profitable trading strategies
Continuously seek improvements to workflows, analytics, risk tools, and business processes
Conduct ad hoc quick analysis to support trading, risk, and commercial decision-making
Design, develop, and maintain analytic and operational views used for monitoring strategies and market dynamics for trading
Support the development and maintenance of Python-based models
Contribute directly to advancing and scaling our data infrastructure




What we expect

Hold a Master within a quantitative field
You have strong quantitative, analytical, and problem-solving skills
Have great python knowledge and an eagerness to code. Other code languages is a plus
You must be a strong team player
We expect you to have a pragmatic mindset and get things done
You have a winning mentality and are willing to go the extra mile to challenge the status quo
You have a do what it takes mentality and do not take no for an answer




What we offer

A young, dynamic, ambitious and fun work environment
Extensive opportunities for personal development and career growth. You will be given responsibility from day one and receive close sparring with experienced colleagues
The opportunity to contribute and make your mark on the team's development
A fun and social work environment with events such as Friday bars, poker tournaments, summer and Christmas parties etc. throughout the year. We also offer weekly sports activities to boost team spirit, such as our Nitor-running club!
Delicious lunch arrangement with food from Meyers in our own canteen
Brand new office facilities located in the heart of Aarhus, right next to Dokk1 and Letbanen




Expected start date: As soon as possible. Please note that we review applications on a rolling basis and may close the position early if we find the right candidate.




About Nitor Energy

Nitor Energy is a fast-growing energy trading company, that has swiftly transitioned from start-up to scale-up within just a few years. We’re experiencing rapid growth, offering limitless opportunities for learning and development. We’re proud of who we are and excited about what we’re building for the future together. Our employees thrive on challenges and are motivated by the potential that lies ahead.




Our unique culture integrates traders, coders, and analysts into cohesive teams, creating a well-rounded approach to our success. We believe in a balanced work-life dynamic and foster a vibrant, engaging atmosphere where our employees can excel in every aspect.

Title: Media Decision Science Manager
Place: Billund, Region of Southern Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Job Description

We are excited to offer an opportunity for a curious, commercially minded Data Expert to help shape the future of marketing analytics at the LEGO Group. Based in our Copenhagen or Billund office, this role sits within the Global Paid Media Performance Analytics team and plays a key role in building the data foundations, analytical models, and scalable pipelines that enable better business decisions across our global marketing organisation.

Reporting to the Global Head of Paid Media Performance Analytics, you do not need a paid media background. Instead, we're looking for someone with strong data and analytics expertise who enjoys solving complex data challenges, building robust data pipelines, and translating data into meaningful business insights.

Come and join one of the most loved brands in the world in a brand-new department where you can have maximum impact. This is a 12-month fixed-term contract.

Please apply with an English CV

No relocation support offered


Core Responsibilities

Build scalable data solutions – Design, develop and maintain robust data pipelines, analytical datasets and scalable data products that support global marketing measurement and business decision-making.

Develop advanced analytics – Apply statistical methods, analytical techniques and experimentation to uncover insights and improve how marketing performance is measured.

Create trusted data foundations – Partner with engineering and digital enablement teams to ensure high-quality, reliable and well-governed data that supports analytics across the organisation.

Bridge data and business – Translate complex datasets into actionable insights and collaborate with business stakeholders to define analytical requirements and solve commercial challenges.

Enable better decision-making – Develop reusable analytical frameworks, automation and reporting capabilities that improve efficiency and help teams make data-driven decisions.

Title: Postdoc in Computer Vision for AI-based Segmentation and Quantification 3D micro-CT data for Natural Heritage - DTU Compute
Place: Kongens Lyngby, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Job Description

Are you excited about scientific AI and developing efficient computer vision methods for analysis of complex 3D scans of natural heritage samples? Join our interdisciplinary team as a postdoc to develop advanced segmentation and other analysis methods for a novel robotic micro-CT system that will transform how natural history collections are digitized and studied. You will have the opportunity to conduct high-impact research in computer vision for 3D volumetric images, contribute to widely used open-source software, collaborate with leading researchers in physics and natural history, and publish your work while helping build technology with lasting scientific impact.

Responsibilities And Qualifications

We are looking for a highly motivated early-career researcher in advanced image segmentation methods to join our imaging research group and project “Natural Heritage 3D”. This collaborative project between Visual Computing @ DTU Compute, DTU Physics, Copenhagen University, and the Natural History Museum aims to develop a fully automated robotic computed tomography system along with computational methods to enable 3D digitization of large collections of natural history specimens.

The Natural History Museum has millions of natural specimens collected over 400 years, which provide an enormous source of information on natural history. CT scans provide a unique method to visualize internal features in 3D in a fully non-destructive manner. In an effort towards digitizing collections and unlocking hidden information on an unprecedented scale, an automated CT system is being developed to scan and analyse large quantities of such specimens. Selected science cases include seal and polar bear craniums as well as snakes and lizards preserved in alcohol.

In addition to experimental CT scan equipment, a key component is the computational pipeline to turn acquired CT projections through reconstruction and image analysis into digital volumes and extract relevant quantitative data. Given the large quantities of specimens, scanning needs to be fast and automated, which demands state-of-the-art reconstruction and analysis methods to handle the data arising from very fast scans taken with few and noisy projections. The focus of this postdoc position is the segmentation and quantification steps, conducting research, and developing suitable analysis methods to produce measurements of the structures in the 3D volumetric images of natural heritage specimens. Our robotic micro-CT system at the DTU 3D Imaging Center enables scanning of thousands of samples, so we will focus on scalability and statistics at a scale beyond current state-of-the-art.

Your primary activities include:


Develop new segmentation methods for large-scale analysis of micro-CT data.
Develop and validate methods for efficient human-in-the-loop segmentation of CT images.
Explore the use of self-supervised foundation models for segmentation with limited labels.
Establish reference benchmark datasets for natural heritage.
Collaborate with domain experts in natural heritage and evolutionary biology.
Contribute to and be part of open-source scientific software communities around the Core Imaging Library and qim3D packages.
Publish scientific articles within computer vision, data, and applications in collaboration with colleagues in physics and natural history.


This role is part of the QIM Center for Quantification of Imaging Data (https://qim.dk/). As part of QIM, you will be interacting with a large imaging network in connection with large-scale facilities such as MAX IV, ESS, DTU 3D Imaging Center, and other facilities internationally. In conjunction with research and open-source software development, the role involves tasks in relation to the QIM Center, including participating in and contributing to training and hackathon events, interacting with users, helping with event organization, etc. From experience, this enables involvement in strong collaborative research projects on both theoretical and practical imaging problems and a pathway to impact of the computational methods developed.

Strong candidates for this position are expected to have:


a PhD degree in computer vision, ideally segmentation and/or quantification of micro-CT data
experience developing deep learning-based image analysis methods
experience with scientific Python programming
experience handling both simulations and large real data
strong spoken and written communication skills in English
strong collaboration skills as well as being self-driven.


As a formal qualification, you must hold a PhD degree (or equivalent). If you are close to completing a PhD degree, your application must include a written statement from your main supervisor confirming that you are expected to complete the PhD by 1. November 2026.

We offer

DTU is a leading technical university globally recognized for the excellence of its research, education, innovation and scientific advice. We offer a rewarding and challenging job in an international environment. We strive for academic excellence in an environment characterized by collegial respect and academic freedom tempered by responsibility.

Salary and terms of employment

The appointment will be based on the collective agreement with the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations. In addition, supplements can be negotiated in accordance with DTU’s salary structure for scientific staff: https://www.inside.dtu.dk/en/human-resources/during-employment/salary/salary-structures

The period of employment is 2 years. Starting date is expected to be 1. November 2026 or soon thereafter. The position is full-time.

You can read more about career paths at DTU here .

Further information

Further information may be obtained from Associate Professor Jakob Sauer Jørgensen ( jakj@dtu.dk ), Department of Applied Mathematics and Computer Science, Technical University of Denmark.

You can read more at https://www.compute.dtu.dk/ .

If you are applying from abroad, you may find useful information on working in Denmark and at DTU at DTU – Moving to Denmark .

Application procedure

Your complete online application must be submitted no later than 15 September 2026 (23:59 Danish time).

Applications must be submitted as one PDF file containing all materials to be given consideration. To apply, please open the link "Apply now", fill out the online application form, and attach all your materials in English in one PDF file. The file must include:


Motivated application (cover letter)
CV
Academic Diplomas (MSc/PhD – in English)
List of publications
Link to examples of scientific code developed by the applicant (for example GitHub link)


Applications received after the deadline will not be considered.

All interested candidates irrespective of age, gender, disability, race, religion or ethnic background are encouraged to apply. As DTU works with research in critical technology, which is subject to special rules for security and export control, open-source background checks may be conducted on qualified candidates for the position.

DTU Compute – Department of Mathematics and Computer Science – is an internationally recognised academic environment with over 400 employees and 10 research sections. We broadly cover digital technologies within mathematics, data science, computer science, and computer engineering, including artificial intelligence (AI), machine learning, internet of things (IoT), chip design, cybersecurity, human-computer interaction, social networks, fairness, and data ethics. Our research is rooted in basic research and centres on mathematical models of the physical and virtual world, as a basis for the analysis, design, and implementation of complex systems. We focus on ensuring that our research results contribute to creating a better society by supporting areas such as health, green transition, energy supply, and life science. We collaborate with universities, public and private organisations, and companies in Denmark and abroad, and through DTU’s startup ecosystem, we encourage innovation and entrepreneurship. We have a strong ethical, human, and sustainable approach that ensures integrity in our work. Therefore, we strive for and take responsibility for driving the democratisation of digital technologies, so that everyone has the opportunity to actively participate in the development, and we ensure a continued open, democratic, and inclusive society for the benefit of all. At DTU Compute, we value diversity, inclusion, and a flexible work-life balance.

DTU – For the benefit of society since 1829

DTU is one of Europe's leading elite technical universities. Job Description

Are you excited about scientific AI and developing efficient computer vision methods for analysis of complex 3D scans of natural heritage samples? Join our interdisciplinary team as a postdoc to develop advanced segmentation and other analysis methods for a novel robotic micro-CT system that will transform how natural history collections are digitized and studied. You will have the opportunity to conduct high-impact research in computer vision for 3D volumetric images, contribute to widely used open-source software, collaborate with leading researchers in physics and natural history, and publish your work while helping build technology with lasting scientific impact.

Responsibilities And Qualifications

We are looking for a highly motivated early-career researcher in advanced image segmentation methods to join our imaging research group and project “Natural Heritage 3D”. This collaborative project between Visual Computing @ DTU Compute, DTU Physics, Copenhagen University, and the Natural History Museum aims to develop a fully automated robotic computed tomography system along with computational methods to enable 3D digitization of large collections of natural history specimens.

The Natural History Museum has millions of natural specimens collected over 400 years, which provide an enormous source of information on natural history. CT scans provide a unique method to visualize internal features in 3D in a fully non-destructive manner. In an effort towards digitizing collections and unlocking hidden information on an unprecedented scale, an automated CT system is being developed to scan and analyse large quantities of such specimens. Selected science cases include seal and polar bear craniums as well as snakes and lizards preserved in alcohol.

In addition to experimental CT scan equipment, a key component is the computational pipeline to turn acquired CT projections through reconstruction and image analysis into digital volumes and extract relevant quantitative data. Given the large quantities of specimens, scanning needs to be fast and automated, which demands state-of-the-art reconstruction and analysis methods to handle the data arising from very fast scans taken with few and noisy projections. The focus of this postdoc position is the segmentation and quantification steps, conducting research, and developing suitable analysis methods to produce measurements of the structures in the 3D volumetric images of natural heritage specimens. Our robotic micro-CT system at the DTU 3D Imaging Center enables scanning of thousands of samples, so we will focus on scalability and statistics at a scale beyond current state-of-the-art.

Your primary activities include:

  • Develop new segmentation methods for large-scale analysis of micro-CT data.
  • Develop and validate methods for efficient human-in-the-loop segmentation of CT images.
  • Explore the use of self-supervised foundation models for segmentation with limited labels.
  • Establish reference benchmark datasets for natural heritage.
  • Collaborate with domain experts in natural heritage and evolutionary biology.
  • Contribute to and be part of open-source scientific software communities around the Core Imaging Library and qim3D packages.
  • Publish scientific articles within computer vision, data, and applications in collaboration with colleagues in physics and natural history.

This role is part of the QIM Center for Quantification of Imaging Data (https://qim.dk/). As part of QIM, you will be interacting with a large imaging network in connection with large-scale facilities such as MAX IV, ESS, DTU 3D Imaging Center, and other facilities internationally. In conjunction with research and open-source software development, the role involves tasks in relation to the QIM Center, including participating in and contributing to training and hackathon events, interacting with users, helping with event organization, etc. From experience, this enables involvement in strong collaborative research projects on both theoretical and practical imaging problems and a pathway to impact of the computational methods developed.

Strong candidates for this position are expected to have:

  • a PhD degree in computer vision, ideally segmentation and/or quantification of micro-CT data
  • experience developing deep learning-based image analysis methods
  • experience with scientific Python programming
  • experience handling both simulations and large real data
  • strong spoken and written communication skills in English
  • strong collaboration skills as well as being self-driven.

As a formal qualification, you must hold a PhD degree (or equivalent). If you are close to completing a PhD degree, your application must include a written statement from your main supervisor confirming that you are expected to complete the PhD by 1. November 2026.

We offer

DTU is a leading technical university globally recognized for the excellence of its research, education, innovation and scientific advice. You can read more about career paths at DTU here .

You can read more at https://www.compute.dtu.dk/ .

If you are applying from abroad, you may find useful information on working in Denmark and at DTU at DTU – Moving to Denmark .

Applications must be submitted as one PDF file containing all materials to be given consideration. To apply, please open the link "Apply now", fill out the online application form, and attach all your materials in English in one PDF file. The file must include:

Applications received after the deadline will not be considered.

Title: Senior AI Engineer (Machine Learning)
Place: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
At GetWhy, we’re on a mission to change the way brands understand people. We help the world's biggest brands get closer to their consumers—faster, smarter, and with a human touch - through breakthrough research powered by AI. Companies like Coca-Cola, Heineken, Unilever and more trust us to deliver consumer insights in hours, not weeks.

We are building an end-to-end AI-powered human insights platform, redefining the boundaries of qualitative research. To fuel our journey, we raised a $34.5M Series A investment from PeakSpan Capital in 2024, making it one of Denmark’s largest Series A rounds to date.

What the AI team does

We are dedicated to delivering high-quality AI products leveraging the latest tools and techniques and to serve them across our core products in a scalable way.

For this, we use classic machine learning for predictive models to deal with fraud detection, language classification, visual understanding and automating internal workflows. These make heavy use of video processing, speech-to-text and multilingual translations models and pipelines.

We also build a lot of functionality around state of the art LLMs. We treat off-the-shelf LLMs as future commodities and aim to benefit from their strengths while employing principled methodologies to build guardrails and fallback strategies for their weaknesses. We strive to achieve a deep understanding of prompt engineering, context management, and LLM behavior quirks (e.g., hallucinations, non-determinism, context management), by focusing on evaluation and observability through monitoring for latency, accuracy, and usage.

Who you are

We’re looking for a Senior AI Engineer to join our growing stellar AI team. You will be responsible for all stages in the machine learning lifecycles across projects, from designing and defining data annotation steps to model training, validation and deployment.

More Specifically, You Should Have These Minimum Qualifications


At least 5+ years developing machine learning systems, in particular NLP models.
Proficiency in Python, along with a solid understanding of data structures and algorithms, and the capability to write production-quality code.
Significant experience working with LLMs at scale, Prompt Engineering and AI Agents.
Solid understanding of LLM evaluation, dealing with hallucinations, inconsistent outputs, context management, conversational AI and voice technologies, including text-to-speech.
Proven experience formulating hypotheses, conducting experiments, and analyzing results.
Exceptional English skills, both spoken and in writing.


What you will do


Build AI-powered features at scale using the latest advancements in LLMs.
Research, prototype, and build advanced NLP/ML models to enable automated resolution of end-user problems.
Design and conduct rigorous experiments and evaluations to enhance model accuracy and reliability.
Refine prompts and tune hyper-parameters to maximize the performance of cutting-edge retrieval and generative AI systems.
Work closely with researchers, engineers, and product teams to define feature scope and implementation strategies.
Mentor junior team members and engage in collaborative learning with peers to promote knowledge sharing.
Contribute to technical reviews and share expertise in ML methodologies and best practices
Writing clean, maintainable, and well-structured code to meet delivery goals.


What we offer


A highly ambitious AI team driven by sky-is-the-limit long term vision and goals, while working to identify and deliver intermediate milestones.
A full-time position with a competitive salary plus benefits.
A flexible work schedule with opportunities to work from home.
A vibrant and international work environment with 60+ colleagues from 15+ nationalities.
A modern, newly renovated Nordhavnen office with stunning waterfront views, office lunch, relaxation areas, gym, free daily energizers, snacks, and drinks.
A company culture that values innovation, collaboration, and transparency.
Annual company retreats and Friday bar events – we work hard, we celebrate hard.


How do I apply?

Click on the apply button and upload your resumé or LinkedIn profile. If we see a potential match, we’ll invite you for a conversation at our office to get to know you better and share more about our culture and this opportunity.

So, what are you waiting for? Hit the apply button and come join the next Danish unicorn.

Digital Solutions & Development > Digital Solutions > AI/ML Chapter

Do you enjoy creating and scaling AI/ML solutions that deliver meaningful business results? We collaborate closely with platform, product and governance teams to ensure scalable, responsible, and impactful adoption of AI across Vestas. With disciplined engineering practices, data-focused methods, and close collaboration with business partners, the team continually raises AI/ML delivery standards and enables meaningful solutions that improve visibility, optimization, and innovation across the enterprise.

Responsibilities

In this role, you will collaborate with product owners, ML engineers, application developers and business SMEs to build and scale advanced ML/GenAI and agent-based systems embedded in digital products. This role emphasizes reasoning-driven AI, self-directed execution and significant informal leadership to deliver results across the organization.


Contribute to validating and conducting technical feasibility assessments of high-impact ML/GenAI use cases
Build, productize and scale ML/GenAI and agentic systems capable of reasoning, planning and carrying out complex tasks
Integrate AI/ML capabilities into enterprise applications, enabling seamless, human-in-the-loop and self-directed decision-making
Work with cross-functional product teams in delivering AI/ML initiatives while advising stakeholders on responsible AI adoption balancing experimentation with production considerations such as performance, cost, reliability and governance
Establish and promote reusable patterns and engineering standards for scalable delivery, AI-ready data, and trusted AI automation


Qualifications

You have a solid foundation in machine learning and software engineering, combined with clear communication and stakeholder engagement skills. You bring extensive experience in designing and scaling production-grade AI/ML systems, with experience leading solutions across the full lifecycle from problem framing to deployment and continuous improvement. 


A master's degree in a relevant field (e.g., computer science, data science, engineering) or equivalent practical experience
You have demonstrated depth in one of the fields such as NLP, generative AI, agentic systems, computer vision, ML engineering or large-scale AI systems
5+ years of experience in ML engineering, including design, delivery and scaling of production-grade AI/ML solutions; the role can be aligned to different seniority levels based on skill level and demonstrated impact
Deep knowledge of Python, ability to develop production grade code, solid experience with ML frameworks (e.g., Scikit-learn, Tensorflow, Pytorch) and GenAI/Agentic frameworks (e.g., Langchain, LangGraph, Pydantic AI)
Deep experience with AI experimentation and modeling, as well as designing robust, scalable training and inference pipelines on cloud platforms including Azure and Snowflake, deployed through CI/CD within an IaC environment
Solid experience with RESTful API design, Docker-based containerization, and Kubernetes-based deployment, scaling, and operations


Competencies


Productionize ML, LLM/GenAI models and agentic systems into reliable, high-performance services with optimized latency, throughput and cost efficiency
Design and operate scalable batch and real-time ML pipelines with high reproducibility across training and deployment
Establish robust monitoring and observability for model performance, data quality, system health and data drift detection
Manage the full ML lifecycle with clear versioning, governance, automated retraining and resilient deployment strategies
Effectively leverage AI-assisted development tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Claude Code) to accelerate prototyping, improve engineering quality and enhance developer productivity in building AI/ML and GenAI solutions


 Global Collaboration & Enablement


Effective collaboration across geographically distributed teams (Denmark, India, Portugal), with high cross-cultural awareness and communication
Ability to align product, AI/ML engineering, platform and MLOps teams to deliver shared engineering outcomes
Demonstrated experience in mentoring and enabling teams through knowledge sharing, best practices and informal leadership


What We Offer

Purpose. An opportunity to help address climate change and support future generations through building AI/ML, GenAI and agentic solutions that power the future of renewable energy and sustainable operations.

Accelerated learning and growth. Join a high-caliber global team of AI/ML engineers, data scientists and GenAI practitioners, with clear focus on continuous learning, knowledge sharing and expanding into agentic autonomous flows.

Global collaboration & collaborative team culture. Work within a multicultural Denmark-India setup that values trust, collaboration and mutual support to deliver meaningful impact.

Opportunity to shape your role. Play a key role in scaling agentic autonomous flows and high-value AI/ML solutions, with the freedom to shape direction, approaches, and outcomes.

Supportive and inclusive environment. Thrive in a diverse, inclusive workplace that promotes well-being, work-life balance and enables individuals to bring their full potential to work.

Career growth in a global organization. Join a global organization that supports ongoing skill development and career advancement

Overall, we offer you the opportunity to contribute meaningfully while growing your career in a global, multicultural environment that promotes continuous learning and development.

Powered by a community of local industry experts, Planday provides a best-in-class digital platform that is easy to use, accurate, secure, and compliant with local needs and standards. From payroll and accounting to POS and reporting, its open API and tech ecosystem is scalable to fit shifting business needs and to build an engaged, flexible workforce.

Founded in 2004, Planday is headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark and supports over 400,000 users across Europe, Australia and the US. Planday was acquired by Xero in 2021.

How You’ll Make An Impact

As a Machine Learning Engineer for Agentic AI & ML, you will work at the intersection of research and production. You will collaborate closely with internal stakeholders and customers to translate ambiguous challenges into effective, shipped features. You will work on features throughout the lifecycle - from discovery and model building to production deployment and maintenance. By designing and shipping ML and agentic systems, you will expand the platform's capabilities to fundamentally reshape how business owners run their operations and how workers manage transparency and work-life balance.

What You’ll Do


Build and optimize ML models to enhance and extend Planday, framing problems from real metrics and engineering robust feature pipelines.
Design and ship agentic systems involving tool use, function calling, and multi-agent orchestration for reliable planning workflows.
Deploy and operate model services in production, ensuring performance for cost and latency through caching, batching, and quantization.
Design and run rigorous evaluations, including LLM-as-judge and regression suites, so quality changes are always measured.
Collaborate on turning research prototypes into reliable, observable production workflows and pipelines.


Success looks like


Stable and sustainable support for live ML services in production as our variety of deployments grows.
Successful release of new features like auto-scheduler models and intelligent AI agent needs.
Reduced ambiguity in model quality through the implementation of repeatable and high-fidelity evaluation sets.
Proactive maintenance and debugging of production services, ensuring high reliability for end-users.
Delivery of research-backed features that directly improve complex workflows like shift assignment.


What You’ll Bring With You


3–5 years of hands-on experience designing, building, and deploying machine learning or data systems in production environments.
Strong collaborative skills - we are a small, high-impact team, and we view cross-functional partnership as a feature, not a bug.
Solid grounding in ML fundamentals (metrics, validation, leakage) and a strong theoretical foundation in AI research.
Practical experience shipping ML or data systems in production environments, beyond purely academic or notebook settings.
Strong Python skills, including experience with numerical and dataframe libraries such as NumPy and pandas.
Experience writing tested, maintainable, and observable code for services deployed to the cloud.
Hands-on experience with LLM applications and agentic architectures, such as RAG, function calling, or planning workflows.
Familiarity with data tooling (SQL, dbt, Snowflake/Databricks) and an end-to-end mindset for product building.
MSc or equivalent experience in a quantitative field. You combine a strong theoretical foundation with a pragmatic approach, are adept at translating business needs into technical solutions, and actively stay informed on relevant frontier developments.

Benefits like pension, health insurance, inclusive support for new parents and generous vacation
On top of your annual base salary, you are offered to be part of an Employee Share Plan
Growth and progression opportunities – we want you to grow with us
Flexible remote work
Strong social culture with lots of team and company activities
Meaningful work – everyone at Planday contributes to improving the lives of shift workers around the globe
Healthy work-life balance and autonomous approach to work. We trust in you and your abilities


Finally, our offices are not just workplaces (although they are pretty nice and well-located, we have to say!). Plandayers are open and welcoming and at Planday, everyone has the freedom and support to show their true self at work.

At Planday, we firmly believe that diversity and inclusion are the cornerstones of innovation and a vibrant workplace culture. As an equal opportunity employer, we strive to create an equitable experience for all candidates throughout the process. Please let us know if you need any reasonable adjustments during the application or interview process.

Title: PostDoc - Uncertainty-Aware Optimization in Inverse Problems for Next-Generation 3D Scanning
Place: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
3Shape and DTU Compute (Department of Applied Mathematics and Computer Science at the Technical University of Denmark) invite applications for an Industrial Postdoctoral position partially funded by Innovation Fund Denmark. The position is a 2-year fixed-term appointment starting in January 2027 (small variations in the start date may be possible depending on the candidate’s preference).




The project addresses a fundamental challenge in computational imaging and large-scale optimization: how can uncertainty in measurements be quantified, propagated, and ultimately leveraged to improve the reliability of reconstructed 3d models?




Modern 3D scanning systems rely on advanced optimization algorithms to reconstruct geometry and color from large volumes of sensor data. While these algorithms produce highly accurate results, they typically provide limited information about the confidence and uncertainty associated with the reconstructed output. Developing methods that can efficiently estimate and propagate uncertainty in the input data through large-scale iterative optimization algorithms has the potential to improve reconstruction quality, enable more informed algorithmic decisions, and support the next generation of intelligent scanning systems.




The successful candidate will conduct research at the intersection of numerical linear algebra, optimization, uncertainty quantification, and computational imaging. The project will investigate: (i) how to characterize measurement uncertainty, (ii) how uncertainty propagates through iterative solvers, (iii) how to develop new mathematical frameworks for uncertainty-aware optimization, and (iv) how to validate the proposed methods through simulations and deployment in medical 3D reconstruction algorithms developed at 3Shape.




The position offers a unique opportunity to combine fundamental research with industrial impact. Working closely with leading researchers at DTU and engineers at 3Shape, the candidate will contribute to scientific publications, software prototype development, and innovation activities aimed at strengthening the theoretical foundations and practical performance of future 3D scanning technologies.




About us

At 3Shape we aim to advance dental treatment and diagnostics with advanced software and 3D scanners designed for dental professionals across the globe. Our purpose is to advance innovation in dentistry, continuously enhancing patient care and outcomes.




This role places you at the heart of our technological advancements within Product Creation, namely TRIOS & SCANNER SW, offering the chance to shape the trajectory of our innovative products and software applications.




About the project

The project is a 2-year project between 3Shape and the Technical University of Denmark, partly funded by Innovation Fund Denmark. The academic co-supervisor will be Professor Per Christian Hansen at DTU Compute (Department of Applied Mathematics and Computer Science).




The research focuses on uncertainty-aware methods for large-scale linear least squares problems, which form the mathematical backbone of many inverse problems and optimization tasks in 3D reconstruction. The objective is to develop new theoretical and computational tools for quantifying and propagating uncertainty through iterative solution methods, and to translate these developments into practical algorithms for medical 3D reconstruction systems.




What You’ll Do

In this role, you will contribute both to the theoretical foundation and the practical implementation of next-generation uncertainty-aware reconstruction algorithms. The work spans mathematical modelling, algorithm design, and software development in a medical imaging 3D reconstruction.

You will:

Develop methods for characterizing measurement uncertainty in medical 3D scanning data, including data-driven approaches and machine learning methods where appropriate, to obtain realistic and application-relevant uncertainty models.
Work hands-on with numerical algorithms, including iterative methods such as Krylov subspace methods and related solvers.
Develop and analyse new methods for uncertainty-aware linear least squares optimization, with a focus on large-scale iterative solvers.
Design mathematical frameworks for quantifying how uncertainty evolves through optimization algorithms used in 3D reconstruction.
Contribute to the architectural design of uncertainty-aware components within existing reconstruction pipelines.
Translate theoretical models into efficient, scalable implementations suitable for industrial use.
Design and run simulation studies to validate theoretical developments under realistic conditions.
Collaborate with researchers and engineers to integrate new methods into production-oriented 3D scanning systems.
Contribute to scientific publications, conference presentations, technical reports, and potential patentable innovations.




What We’re Looking For

A PhD in Mathematics, Statistics, or a related discipline. The PhD must have been awarded after March 2021 (or will be obtained within November 2026).
Strong expertise in numerical linear algebra, optimization, and/or inverse problems.
Solid understanding of linear least squares methods and iterative solvers, ideally methods based on Krylov subspace methods.
Experience with or strong interest in uncertainty quantification, statistical modelling, or probabilistic methods.
Strong programming skills in at least one programming language (ideally two), such as C#, C++, or Python.
Familiarity with machine learning methods is an advantage, particularly for data-driven modelling of complex systems.
Ability to work independently and take ownership of research problems while also contributing to a collaborative industrial-academic environment.
Strong communication skills and the ability to present complex mathematical ideas clearly in both academic and applied settings.




What 3Shape offers

A vibrant and international environment with social, diverse, and highly skilled and collaborative colleagues - we are more than 50 nationalities in our DK based office
Breakfast every day, and delicious and healthy lunch cooked by our private chefs.
We provide a great social work environment with many optional activities and social clubs, ranging from wine & beer, board games, running to bicycle clubs.
Good work/life balance.
Attractive offices and R&D lab spaces in downtown Copenhagen close to Kgs. Nytorv, Nyhavn, and the Copenhagen Canals.
Purpose: Endeavor to improve dental patients on a global scale.




Staying true to our values and D&I efforts, we encourage all relevant applicants to apply, and we ask you NOT to add any photos or sensitive information (age, marital status, nationality) during the application process.




We encourage all relevant applicants to apply. We are committed to celebrating human diversity, and we trust that the best way to reach outstanding business results, is by welcoming diverse people into our community.

Title: Økonom til at udvikle og bearbejde finansielle data om pensionssektoren og investeringsfonde
Place: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Du løser opgaver med et enestående formål
Nationalbanken er den eneste af sin slags. Vi er samfundets bank, statens uafhængige rådgiver og landets vågne øjne på økonomien. Stabile priser, sikre betalinger og finansiel stabilitet kommer ikke af sig selv, og som medarbejder i Nationalbanken spiller du en central rolle i at sikre Danmark en robust økonomi.

Som økonom er du en del af afdelingen Finansiel Statistik, hvor vi udvikler, bearbejder og analyserer finansielle data. Finansielle data belyser det økonomiske kredsløb og robustheden af dansk økonomi, og er grundstenen i mange analyser.

Dine primære opgaver omfatter:


at udvikle og formidle data og statistikker om investeringsfonde og forsikring- og pensionssektorens investeringer, risikoafdækning og hensættelser til pensioner.
at være i dialog med danske pensions- og forsikringsselskaber og investeringsfonde om deres finansielle aktiviteter, og at sikre at de finansielle data afspejler de seneste markedsudviklinger, og
at deltage i analyser og samarbejde på tværs af Nationalbanken og internationalt.


Vi vil, at du både lykkes og trives i rollen som økonom i Nationalbanken. Derfor lægger vi vægt på, at du har følgende forudsætninger for at søge stillingen:


Du er interesseret i finansielle markeder og at arbejde med kvantitative metoder og store datasæt. Du kan have relevant arbejdserfaring fra pensionssektoren, investeringsfonde eller med håndteringen af store datamængder, men det er ikke en forudsætning. Vi sørger for at klæde dig på, så du bedst muligt kan varetage dine opgaver.
Som person sætter du pris på at samarbejde med andre. Du formår at løse egne opgaver samt tager initiativ og ansvar for dine og bankens opgaver.
Du har høj motivation og ser frem til en stejl indlæringskurve.
Du kan formidle komplekse problemstillinger og løsninger, og du har lyst til at arbejde med data, fx i SQL, R og Python. Du er også nysgerrig på at benytte Git og AI-værktøjer, fx Copilot, i det daglige kodningsarbejde.


Du er guld værd i Nationalbanken
Der er kun én Nationalbanken. Vores opgaver er at sikre betalinger, føre fastkurspolitik og levere analyser, viden og anbefalinger til gavn for landets økonomi. Dit arbejde og vores vitale systemer har essentiel betydning for det finansielle og politiske Danmark, og for landets internationale relationer.

Vi ønsker at sikre rammerne for en effektiv opgaveløsning, en stor sammenfølelse og en god balance mellem livet på og uden for arbejdet. Vi arbejder som udgangspunkt fra bankens lokationer, men du har også mulighed for at planlægge din hverdag under fleksible former, herunder aftale en ugentlig hjemmearbejdsdag, hvis rolle og opgaver tillader det. Samtidig lægger vi stor vægt på din læring og løbende udvikling af færdigheder. Vi mener det, når vi siger, at din udvikling er i højsædet. Du er nemlig guld værd i Nationalbanken.

Vil du vide mere?
Har du spørgsmål til jobbet, er du velkommen til at kontakte:

Chef for Værdipapir- og Betalingsbalancestatistik

Title: Senior Clinical Data Scientist
Place: Gladsaxe, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Clinical Data Management and Programming

Søborg or Aalborg, Denmark

Join Novo Nordisk as a Senior Clinical Data Scientist and play a key role in delivering high-quality clinical trial data that supports the development of innovative medicines for people living with serious chronic diseases. Working closely with global trial teams, statisticians, and regulatory experts, you will drive clinical data science activities throughout the clinical development lifecycle, from trial setup and execution to regulatory submissions.

Your new role

As a Senior Clinical Data Scientist, you will play a pivotal role in planning, executing, and delivering clinical data science activities across global clinical development programmes. As a key member of multidisciplinary trial teams, you will collaborate with regulatory experts and external partners to ensure the delivery of high-quality, compliant, and submission-ready clinical data.

Your Responsibilities Will Include


Leading clinical data science activities from trial setup through analysis, submission, regulatory interactions, and the preparation of regulatory submission documents.
Providing expertise on trial design components, including electronic case report forms (eCRFs), Data Flow Plans, Blinding Plans, protocols, and statistical analysis plans.
Ensuring high-quality Study Data Tabulation Model (SDTM), Analysis Data Model (ADaM), and tables, figures, and listings (TFL) deliverables that meet industry standards and Novo Nordisk requirements.
Acting as an operational partner within trial squads, supporting key data-driven decisions and collaborating with internal and external stakeholders, including contract research organisations and functional suppliers, to drive efficient and compliant trial execution.
Driving continuous improvement, innovation, and knowledge sharing within Clinical Data Science, while helping to shape future standards and ways of working.


Your new department

You will join Clinical Data Management and Programming, a global organisation responsible for delivering high-quality clinical trial data and analyses that support development activities and data submissions to governmental approval authorities. The department combines scientific excellence, advanced technology, and deep knowledge of clinical development to ensure reliable and efficient execution across the development portfolio.

As part of a highly collaborative and international environment, you will work closely with colleagues across Research and Development, as well as with internal and external partners worldwide. We foster a culture of continuous learning, innovation, knowledge sharing, and professional development, where diverse expertise comes together to solve complex data challenges and accelerate the delivery of medicines to help patients around the world.

Your Skills And Qualifications

We are looking for a proactive and scientifically driven professional who thrives in a collaborative environment and enjoys working on complex clinical data challenges.

You Will Ideally Have


A PhD or master’s degree in life sciences, natural sciences, engineering, or a related discipline, together with more than two years of experience in statistical programming and clinical trial data analysis, preferably within the pharmaceutical industry.
Strong programming skills in R, SAS, or similar programming languages, as well as experience with SDTM, ADaM, TFL generation, and regulatory submission deliverables.
Knowledge of clinical database technologies, data models, drug development processes, and Good Practice (GxP) requirements.
Experience collaborating across functions, geographies, and external partnerships, combined with strong analytical and problem-solving skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
Excellent planning, organisational, communication, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to explain technical topics to specialist and non-specialist audiences, a continuous improvement mindset, a genuine interest in innovation and new ways of working, and fluency in written and spoken English.


Success in this role requires a self-driven, accountable, and collaborative mindset. You enjoy working in multidisciplinary teams, take ownership of your deliverables, and are motivated by improving processes, developing expertise, and contributing to better outcomes for patients worldwide.

Working at Novo Nordisk

Every day we seek the solutions that defeat serious chronic diseases. To do this, we approach our work with determination, constant curiosity and a commitment to finding better ways forward. For over 100 years, this dedication has driven us to build a company focused on lasting change for long-term health. One where diverse thinking, shared purpose and mutual respect come together to create extraordinary results. When you join us, you're not just starting a job – you're becoming part of a story that spans generations.

What We Offer

At Novo Nordisk, you'll join a global healthcare company with a unique culture and strong results. We offer continuous learning, career development, and benefits tailored to your life and career stage. 

Salary: For this role, the Annual Base Salary ranges from 651,000.00 to 956,900.00 DKK, corresponding to the level of the position.

The placement within the salary range will be assessed during the recruitment process based on the candidate’s skills, competencies, knowledge, and relevant experience.

Incentives and Benefits: The salary package may include short-term and/or long-term incentives as well as other employee benefits based on position level, location, functional area and relevant market benchmarks.

Learn more about our Reward Philosophy here

Deadline

17 September 2026. Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis.

We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all our job applicants.

At Novo Nordisk, we're not chasing quick fixes – we're creating lasting change for long-term health. For over 100 years, we've been driven by a single purpose: to defeat serious chronic diseases and help millions of people live healthier lives. This dedication fuels our constant curiosity and inspires us to push the boundaries of what's possible in healthcare. We embrace diverse perspectives, seek out bold ideas, and build partnerships rooted in shared purpose. Together, we're making healthcare more accessible, treating and preventing diseases, and pioneering solutions that create change spanning generations. When you join us, you become part of something bigger – a legacy of impact that reaches far beyond today.

Place: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Veo is a global leader in AI-based sports camera technology. Our innovative, fully automatic camera solution enables sports teams to record matches and training sessions without a camera operator. We’re democratizing the world of sports by granting video analysis for teams on all levels—a privilege that used to be only for the few. More than 50,000 clubs in 90+ countries record their games every week.

Growing as fast as we do in Veo means that every day is different, exciting, and challenging, both on the front line and in the back office.

But that’s not the most remarkable thing about us.

The coolest thing is our people. We’ve attracted some of the brightest minds in the industry. They are the reason we can create a great product and do it while enjoying ourselves.

As a Machine Learning Engineer at Veo you will get to work on challenging problems and directly contribute to the value created by our AI-driven end-user products.

You will become part of our AI team, which comprises 15 researchers and engineers responsible for all stages in the machine learning lifecycles across different projects - from scoping and defining data annotation tasks to modeling, validation, and deployment. You will be free to determine the directions of the project you work on while also getting feedback and being encouraged to spar with the rest of the team to assist each other in improving and succeeding.

We stay current with the latest research and continuously discuss concepts and ideas in recent papers to assess their relevance to our tasks and product-specific challenges.

We are looking to add yet another ambitious, high-performing junior to senior engineer/researcher with proven experience from real-world machine learning projects to the team. Experience with computer vision is advantageous but not a must.

What you will do:



Train state-of-the-art machine learning models
Write efficient inference pipelines for cloud and edge
Define and supervise data annotation tasks
Improve evaluation schemes to increase understanding of model performance and shortcomings
Contribute to long-term planning and prioritization of tasks




What you will need:



MSc or PhD in a relevant field
Hands-on experience with real-world, large-scale machine-learning projects
Great coding skills
Skilled at both autonomous tasks and contributing to group efforts
Ability to examine details closely and critically




Our Copenhagen office mirrors our innovative technology – with an indoor ball court, rooftop terrace, and well-equipped gym. We have created a facility that supports connecting disciplines across the business, facilitates creative thinking, and gives the space to engage with colleagues, our global partners, and the entire Veo community.

Values we hold at Veo:

Dare - We take initiative, stay curious, and challenge the status quo in our work.

Own it - We drive impact by identifying opportunities, taking responsibility, and confidently executing.

Level up - We embrace growth, continuously learning and shaping our skills.

Play as a team - We collaborate across a diverse organization, leveraging shared insights for stronger

outcomes.

Customer Centric - We deliver value by having close partnerships and a deep understanding of our customers (internally and externally)

We value diversity and inclusion and welcome applicants from all backgrounds, even if your experience doesn’t completely match every qualification listed. What matters most is your creativity, potential, and ability to make meaningful contributions.

Title: Lead Data Analyst (Pricing & Monetization)
Place: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
At Trustpilot, we're on an incredible journey. We're a profitable, high-growth FTSE-250 company with a big vision: to become the universal symbol of trust. We run the world's largest open customer review platform, and while we've come a long way, there's still so much exciting work to do. Come join us at the heart of trust!

About the Role

Data isn’t just a byproduct of our business; it’s the engine that drives our growth. We are looking for a Lead Pricing & Monetization Analyst to join our Go-To-Market (GTM) Analytics team. This is a high-impact, individual contributor role designed for a seasoned expert who can bridge the gap between complex statistical modeling and strategic GTM execution in a B2B SaaS environment.

Your mission is to help us answer critical questions about our go-to-market strategy, driving growth across the customer lifecycle. You will lead the charge in analyzing our revenue engine and providing crucial insights into our pricing architecture and monetization strategies to maximize our overall commercial impact.

The GTM Analytics team operates in a semi-embedded model where each analyst serves as a trusted partner and owner for a specific strategic focus area. In this role, you’ll focus on empowering the Pricing & Monetization team while working cross-functionally across our commercial organization, and broader analytics and data teams. 

What You’ll Be Doing

Pricing & Monetization Analytics: Partner with product and commercial leadership to evaluate pricing and packaging strategies, analyzing discount behaviors and tracking the financial performance of new monetization initiatives.
Advanced Statistical Analysis: Design and execute complex analyses, including cohort analysis, customer segmentation (clustering), and predictive modeling to identify growth levers.
Tool & Capability Development: Build and scale our analytics infrastructure. This includes developing proprietary solutions in R/Python and integrating them into our data stack.
Stakeholder Influence: Provide actionable insights to collaborate with, and influence stakeholders in making data informed decisions and drive data literacy around GTM optimization.
Scalable Reporting: Architect intuitive dashboards in Looker that don't just show data, but provide actionable insights for stakeholders ranging from Commercial Ops to executive leadership.
Data Engineering Collaboration: Work closely with our data engineering team using dbt to ensure our GTM data pipelines are robust, efficient, and "analyst-ready."

Who You Are

A Proven Analytical Lead: You bring demonstrated experience successfully driving strategic GTM initiatives, establishing best-in-class analytical standards, and mentoring team members to elevate overall capabilities across the analytics function.
A Technical Expert: You are fluent in SQL and R/Python and have a solid understanding of regression models, clustering, propensity and statistical significance with an ability to apply them to complex commercial and GTM problems.
A Strategic GTM Thinker: You have several years of experience solving go-to-market problems using appropriate analytical techniques. You don't just build models; you understand the "why" behind the numbers. You understand core SaaS metrics and have experience evaluating pricing strategies, monetization models, or commercial packaging structures.
A Trusted Advisor: You possess strong stakeholder management skills knowing how to challenge assumptions and guide leadership toward data-informed decisions.
An Expert Communicator: You can explain complex solutions and models to a non-technical audience and present a compelling case for strategic optimization to executive leadership.
Data Storytelling: You have proven experience with Looker (LookML) or similar BI tools, emphasizing best practices in data storytelling.
A Data Architect: You have a high bar for data quality and have experience working within modern data stacks (e.g BigQuery, dbt, Airflow)

 

What’s in it for you:

A range of flexible working options to dedicate time to what matters to you
Competitive compensation package + bonus
25 days holiday per year, with an extra 5 days holiday allocated after your 1 year anniversary (prorated) 
Two (paid) volunteering days a year to spend your time giving back to the causes that matter to you and your community
Rich learning and development opportunities are supported through the Trustpilot Academy and Blinkist
Comprehensive health package, pension, and full access to Headspace, a popular mindfulness app to promote positive mental health
Paid parental leave
Central office with  a laid-back vibe and constant buzz of different languages being spoken everywhere you go It’s complete with a coffee bar, canteen, and table tennis and has a wide variety of refreshments available - you can opt-in for breakfast and lunch at an affordable price
Regular opportunities to connect and get to know your fellow Trusties, including company-wide celebrations and events, ERG activities, and team socials
Opportunity to join the Trustpilot Social Club for a small monthly fee and attend regular social and leisure activities like go-karting, cooking classes, and escape rooms 
Employee discounts to restaurants and shops

About us

Trustpilot began in 2007 with a simple yet powerful idea that is more relevant today than ever — to be the universal symbol of trust, bringing consumers and businesses together through reviews. Trustpilot is open, independent, and impartial — we help consumers make the right choices and businesses to build trust, grow and improve.

Today, we have more than 350 million reviews and 60 million monthly active users across the globe, with 149 billion annual Trustpilot brand impressions, and the numbers keep growing. We have more than 1000 employees and we’re headquartered in Copenhagen, with operations in  Amsterdam, Denver, Edinburgh, Hamburg, London, Melbourne, Milan and New York. 

We’re driven by connection. It’s at the heart of what we do. Our culture keeps things fresh –– it’s built on the relationships we create. We talk, we laugh, we collaborate and we respect each other. We work across borders and cultures to be the universal symbol of trust in an ever-changing world. With vibrant office locations worldwide and over 50 nationalities, we’re proud to be an equal opportunity workplace with diverse perspectives and ideas. 

Our purpose to help people and businesses help each other is a tall order, but we keep it real. We’re a great bunch of humans, doing awesome stuff, without fuss or pretense. About the Role

Data isn’t just a byproduct of our business; it’s the engine that drives our growth. We are looking for a Lead Pricing & Monetization Analyst to join our Go-To-Market (GTM) Analytics team. This is a high-impact, individual contributor role designed for a seasoned expert who can bridge the gap between complex statistical modeling and strategic GTM execution in a B2B SaaS environment.

Your mission is to help us answer critical questions about our go-to-market strategy, driving growth across the customer lifecycle. You will lead the charge in analyzing our revenue engine and providing crucial insights into our pricing architecture and monetization strategies to maximize our overall commercial impact.

The GTM Analytics team operates in a semi-embedded model where each analyst serves as a trusted partner and owner for a specific strategic focus area. In this role, you’ll focus on empowering the Pricing & Monetization team while working cross-functionally across our commercial organization, and broader analytics and data teams. 

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Pricing & Monetization Analytics: Partner with product and commercial leadership to evaluate pricing and packaging strategies, analyzing discount behaviors and tracking the financial performance of new monetization initiatives.
  • Advanced Statistical Analysis: Design and execute complex analyses, including cohort analysis, customer segmentation (clustering), and predictive modeling to identify growth levers.
  • Tool & Capability Development: Build and scale our analytics infrastructure. This includes developing proprietary solutions in R/Python and integrating them into our data stack.
  • Stakeholder Influence: Provide actionable insights to collaborate with, and influence stakeholders in making data informed decisions and drive data literacy around GTM optimization.
  • Scalable Reporting: Architect intuitive dashboards in Looker that don't just show data, but provide actionable insights for stakeholders ranging from Commercial Ops to executive leadership.
  • Data Engineering Collaboration: Work closely with our data engineering team using dbt to ensure our GTM data pipelines are robust, efficient, and "analyst-ready."

Who You Are

  • A Proven Analytical Lead: You bring demonstrated experience successfully driving strategic GTM initiatives, establishing best-in-class analytical standards, and mentoring team members to elevate overall capabilities across the analytics function.
  • A Technical Expert: You are fluent in SQL and R/Python and have a solid understanding of regression models, clustering, propensity and statistical significance with an ability to apply them to complex commercial and GTM problems.
  • A Strategic GTM Thinker: You have several years of experience solving go-to-market problems using appropriate analytical techniques. You don't just build models; you understand the "why" behind the numbers. You understand core SaaS metrics and have experience evaluating pricing strategies, monetization models, or commercial packaging structures.
  • A Trusted Advisor: You possess strong stakeholder management skills knowing how to challenge assumptions and guide leadership toward data-informed decisions.
  • An Expert Communicator: You can explain complex solutions and models to a non-technical audience and present a compelling case for strategic optimization to executive leadership.
  • Data Storytelling: You have proven experience with Looker (LookML) or similar BI tools, emphasizing best practices in data storytelling.
  • A Data Architect: You have a high bar for data quality and have experience working within modern data stacks (e.g BigQuery, dbt, Airflow)

  • Competitive compensation package + bonus
  • 25 days holiday per year, with an extra 5 days holiday allocated after your 1 year anniversary (prorated)

  • Rich learning and development opportunities are supported through the Trustpilot Academy and Blinkist
  • Comprehensive health package, pension, and full access to Headspace, a popular mindfulness app to promote positive mental health

Title: Machine Learning Engineer – Cost Index Optimization
Place: Odense, Region of Southern Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Engineering | Odense, Denmark | Full-Time

Jeppesen ForeFlight builds software that airlines and pilots around the world rely on every day. From our Odense office, you'll join an international engineering organization where your work has a direct, measurable impact on airline fuel efficiency and emissions.

Train models that save fuel on every flight

We're hiring a Machine Learning Engineer for a new team building our next-generation Cost Index Optimization (CIO) product. You'll design and train the neural network models that produce tail-specific performance profiles from recorded flight data, and build the training and validation pipeline that keeps them accurate as fleets and data grow.

What You'll Do


Design neural network architectures for tail-specific performance modeling
Build the training pipeline — data preparation, feature engineering, hyperparameter optimization, retraining
Define and automate validation against real-world flight data and accuracy targets
Work with aircraft performance specialists to blend physics-based and learned models, keeping outputs physics-bounded
Package trained models into compact, fast artifacts that run offline on EFB devices in the flight deck
Take models to production, with monitoring for drift and data quality



What We're Looking For


Strong applied ML experience — you've trained, validated, and shipped models to production, not just prototyped them
Solid Python and ML tooling (PyTorch/TensorFlow, experiment tracking, model serving)
Experience with time-series or sensor data, and comfort with noisy real-world datasets
Enough physics intuition to sanity-check model outputs against how aircraft actually behave
Interest in aviation is a plus; domain expertise is not required



Why Join Jeppesen ForeFlight?

We believe a rewarding career is built on meaningful challenges, a supportive environment, and great colleagues. At Jeppesen ForeFlight, we empower our employees to make a direct impact on our products and services while supporting their overall wellbeing.

Our benefits package includes comprehensive health insurance, a pension plan, generous paid vacation plus additional time off during Christmas, a health and wellness allowance, an employee assistance program, two paid volunteer days annually, an employee referral program, and flight rewards and a flight stipend.
