Title: Trelleborg Sealing Solutions Helsingør - Project Bank
Place: Helsingør, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Sista ansökningsdag 2028-12-01 Plats: DNK - Helsingør

If You're a University Student, You Can Explore The Projects Available At Trelleborg In This Project Bank. To Apply For a Project At Trelleborg, Please Submit An Application That Includes


Whether you're applying for an internship, bachelor's project, or master's thesis
The project you're interested in
Your preferred start date
Some information about yourself and why this project has caught your interest


Below are some tracks: Data & Computer Science, IoT, Embedded and Automation, Industrial / Management Engineering, and Natural Sciences. These tracks are defined to guide student projects and internships, for example, exploring data analytics applications, developing IoT solutions for manufacturing, optimizing industrial processes, or advancing research. However, we welcome innovation and are excited to learn from your perspective. If you have skills or ideas that you believe could contribute to our manufacturing environment or inspire a new project direction, please do not hesitate to email us with your thoughts or suggestions.

Data & Computer Science

Project Proposals


Industrial Data Analytics: Improve, design and implement data pipelines for our data service stack to collect, process, and visualize manufacturing data. Projects may involve predictive analytics, anomaly detection, and the integration of machine learning models for operational insights. Project proposals: Routing data architecture, Routings automation, Data Engineering for Data Service Stack.
Process Optimization with AI & Machine Learning: Develop and apply machine learning algorithms to optimize production processes, planning, forecasting and more. Collaborate on data-driven experiments using Python (or R) and SQL. Project proposals: Routing mapping, Capacity Modeling.
Computer Vision & Automated Inspection: Apply computer vision techniques for real-time defect detection, object recognition, and production monitoring. Explore open-source platforms and deep learning frameworks for visual analysis. Project proposals: Rod Vision, Vision Touch For Quality.
Do you have an idea for another project within this field? We’re always open to fresh perspectives and innovative suggestions. If you have a project proposal you’d like us to consider, feel free to submit it through the application function below.


Who should apply?

We welcome students with a strong interest and academic background in data science, engineering, computer science, mathematics, statistics, and related disciplines. If you are eager to work on interdisciplinary projects and drive technological advancement in manufacturing, we encourage you to apply.

IoT, Embedded and Automation

Project Proposals


ESP32-Based Industrial Sensors: Develop and test sensors using ESP32 for real-time monitoring of manufacturing processes. Projects may include wireless data collection, predictive maintenance, and integration with existing data platforms. Project proposals: Wagon RFID monitoring, Time registration Cells.
Raspberry Pi Automation Controllers: Design and implement automation solutions using Raspberry Pi for process control, machine interfacing, or visualization. Explore Python scripting, edge computing, and IoT connectivity. Project proposals: Weights Network, Network solutions.
Open-Source Machine Vision: Apply open-source vision platforms (such as OpenCV, TensorFlow, etc.) for defect detection, object tracking, and measurement in manufacturing environments. Develop algorithms that enhance production quality and efficiency. Project proposals: Rod Vision, Vision Parts Counting for Manufacturing Traceability, Vision inventory surveillance.
Do you have an idea for another project within this field? We’re always open to fresh perspectives and innovative suggestions. If you have a project proposal you’d like us to consider, feel free to submit it through the application function below.


Who should apply?

All students with significant interest and academic value in engineering, computer science, robotics, and related disciplines who are eager to work on interdisciplinary projects and drive technological advancement in manufacturing.

Industrial & Management Engineering

Project Proposals


Smart Production Planning & Scheduling: Design and implement innovative planning and scheduling systems to optimize resource utilization, minimize downtime, and enhance throughput. Projects may involve advanced algorithms, capacity modelling and digital tools, and simulation models.
Cost Savings & Economic Analysis: Analyze production workflows to identify opportunities for cost reduction, improve process efficiency, and maximize return on investment. Collaborate on developing economic models and savings strategies for manufacturing operations.
Lean Management & Process Improvement: Apply lean management principles to streamline production, eliminate waste, and drive continuous improvement. Projects may include value stream mapping, kaizen initiatives, and deployment of best practices.
Smart Calculation & Data-Driven Decision Making: Develop tools and methodologies for real-time calculation and analysis of production metrics, supporting informed decision-making and operational optimization.
Industrial Project Management: Lead and support projects focused on process upgrades, technology integration, and operational change management. Gain experience in planning, execution, and evaluation of industrial engineering initiatives.
Do you have an idea for another project within this field? We’re always open to fresh perspectives and innovative suggestions. If you have a project proposal you’d like us to consider, feel free to submit it through the application function below.


Who should apply?

We welcome students with a strong interest and academic background in production engineering, industrial engineering, management, economics, project management, operations research, and related disciplines. If you are eager to work on interdisciplinary projects and drive technological advancement in manufacturing, we encourage you to apply.

Natural Sciences and Computing

Project Proposals


Applied Machine Learning and AI: Develop machine learning models and AI-driven tools to optimize production planning, forecast demand, and analyze manufacturing data. Projects may include algorithm development, data visualization, and integration with existing platforms. Project proposals: Capacity modeling, Routing mapping.
Experimental Design: Conduct experiments to characterize materials and improve processing methods. Investigate material properties and their relationship to machine performance and settings and design experiments to explore these interactions. Project proposals: Speed vs. quality vs. tools.
Measurement: Computer Vision and 3D Scanning: Apply computer vision techniques for automated measurement, defect detection, and process control in manufacturing environments. Develop algorithms for object identification, tracking, and quality assurance. Vision-based inventory surveillance, Inline product measurement.
Do you have an idea for another project within this field? We welcome new perspectives and innovative suggestions. If you have a project proposal you would like us to consider, feel free to submit it through the application function below.


Who should apply?

Students with a strong interest and academic foundation in physics, mathematics, chemistry, computer science, or related disciplines, who are eager to work on interdisciplinary projects and drive scientific and technological advancement in manufacturing.

Why join Trelleborg?

By joining as an intern or project participant, you will immerse yourself in hands-on scientific projects that drive real innovation in manufacturing and research. Gain academic value, enjoy the freedom to explore your own ideas, and build projects with potential for further development. Please note that internships are not paid; our focus is on academic growth, providing a sandbox for students to develop their experience and personal academic and professional preferences.

If you have any questions, please contact Tobias Ottsen, ME Manager, at +45 60 80 97 31.

We conduct interviews continuously, so please feel free to send your application today.

We look forward to hearing from you.

Description:
Our Purpose

Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.

Title And Summary

Senior Analyst, Analytics & Metrics

Who is Mastercard?

Mastercard is a global technology company in the payments industry. Our mission is to connect and power an inclusive, digital economy that benefits everyone, everywhere by making transactions safe, simple, smart, and accessible.

Using secure data and networks, partnerships and passion, our innovations and solutions help individuals, financial institutions, governments, and businesses realize their greatest potential. Our decency quotient, or DQ, drives our culture and everything we do inside and outside of our company. With connections across more than 210 countries and territories, we are building a sustainable world that unlocks priceless possibilities for all.

Overview

The Data & Analytics team is looking for a Senior Analyst to help drive data-informed decision-making and support the continued growth of our business across the Nordics.

This role brings together analytics, business understanding, and stakeholder collaboration. You will work closely with commercial teams, product specialists, and leadership to transform data into insights that help shape decisions, improve performance, and identify new opportunities.

We are looking for someone who enjoys solving problems, working with data, and making complex information easier to understand and act upon. Whether your experience comes from analytics, business intelligence, commercial analysis, consulting, or a related field, we encourage you to apply.

What You'll Do:

Deliver Insights that Drive Decisions:

Analyze business performance and identify opportunities, trends, and risks

Translate data into meaningful insights and recommendations for stakeholders

Support data-informed decision-making across commercial, product, and leadership teams

Help move the organization from reactive reporting to proactive analytics

Build Scalable Analytics Solutions:

Develop and improve datasets, reporting solutions, and analytical frameworks

Help create data products and tools that are easy for colleagues to access and use

Contribute to improving data availability, quality, and consistency across the business

Advance Business Intelligence Capabilities:

Support the ongoing development of dashboards, reporting, and self-service analytics

Work with data from multiple sources to create valuable business insights

Collaborate with colleagues to establish scalable and sustainable ways of working with data

Support Commercial Growth:

Provide analysis that supports customer engagements, pricing decisions, and business performance

Partner with commercial teams to identify opportunities for growth and optimization

Help stakeholders understand performance drivers and emerging market trends

Develop Market Intelligence:

Contribute to our Market Monitor and broader market intelligence capabilities

Combine internal and external data sources to create actionable insights

Help ensure insights reach decision-makers at the right time

Contribute To Strategic Data Initiatives:

Support the development of data-driven products, services, and capabilities

Help strengthen analytics capabilities across the Nordic organization

Promote the effective use of data as a strategic business asset

About You:

We're looking for someone with strong analytical thinking, business curiosity, and a track record of turning data into meaningful outcomes. You don't need experience with every tool or technology we use, but you should be confident navigating data, solving problems, and influencing decisions.

You May Be a Great Fit If You:

Enjoy working with data to solve business problems

Can turn information into clear recommendations and actions

Communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical audiences

Are comfortable collaborating across teams and functions

Take ownership and proactively identify opportunities for improvement

Balance attention to detail with an understanding of the bigger picture

Are eager to learn and continuously develop new skills

Experience That Would Be Valuable:

Experience in analytics, business intelligence, data management, consulting, finance, commercial analysis, or a related field

Familiarity with data visualization and reporting tools

Experience working with structured data and analytical techniques

Understanding of how data and analytics can support business growth and decision-making

Exposure to payments, financial services, or other data-intensive industries is beneficial but not required

Why Join Us?

You'll have the opportunity to influence decisions at both strategic and operational levels, work with a broad range of stakeholders, and play a key role in strengthening analytics capabilities across the Nordic business. This is a role for someone who wants to combine analytical expertise with commercial impact and help shape the future of a growing data-driven organization.

Corporate Security Responsibility

Every Person Working For, Or On Behalf Of, Mastercard Is Responsible For Information Security. All Activities Involving Access To Mastercard Assets, Information, And Networks Carry Inherent Risk. Therefore, You Are Expected To:

Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices

Ensure confidentiality and integrity of information

Report any suspected violations or breaches

Complete all mandatory security trainings

All Activities Involving Access To Mastercard Assets, Information, And Networks Comes With An Inherent Risk To The Organization And, Therefore, It Is Expected That Every Person Working For, Or On Behalf Of, Mastercard Is Responsible For Information Security And Must:


Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;

Title: Senior Performance Manager - BI, Analytics & Portfolio Intelligence
Place: Humlebæk, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Senior Performance Manager – BI, Analytics & Portfolio Intelligence

About The Job

Are you an analytical, technically strong performance manager who can turn complex R&D data into insights leaders trust? Are you motivated by building the data foundation, KPI architecture and Power BI dashboards that help R&D

optimise the value of its innovation portfolio?

Join our PMO, Innovation Portfolio Management within R&D Chronic Care organisation.

Coloplast has a long history of developing innovative products that make life easier for people with intimate healthcare needs. At our headquarters in Humlebæk, you will join the PMO department within the R&D Innovation Portfolio Management organization, where we drive portfolio management and execution across the innovation portfolio, enable strategy deployment, and advance performance management across the R&D organization.

As Senior Performance Manager, you will play a key role in establishing a trusted performance management system across R&D. You will create a single source of truth for portfolio, functional, and organizational performance, enabling leaders across the organization to make better business decisions, strengthen business performance, and maximize the value delivered through innovation investments. Through KPI frameworks, dashboards, analytics, and performance insights, you will help leaders to drive continuous performance improvement across both the Innovation Value Stream portfolio and the wider R&D organization, ensuring leaders have the insights needed to improve outcomes, productivity, and value delivery

Turn performance insights into better R&D decisions

In this role, you move beyond traditional reporting. You will help build the performance foundation that gives R&D leadership one trusted view of performance and portfolio progress, risk and value — so they can act with confidence.

Your key responsibilities include:


Develop and maintain performance management framework and KPI matrix used to track value creation across the IVS portfolio and R&D organisation.
Design and build the Power BI data model, dashboards and reporting logic, from architecture through to visual design
Establish one trusted source of truth for portfolio, business and value performance, supporting better decisions and performance improvement across R&D and the Innovation Value Stream
Create one integrated portfolio view of milestones, cost, risk and value across programs and projects
Turn complex data into clear insights and recommendations that support value-optimising decisions for senior leadership
Work closely with Finance, R&D and IVS stakeholders to provide insights and analytical support that help leaders improve business performance, identify improvement opportunities, and make better business decisions
Develop and run value realization tracking, ensuring initiatives deliver against the impact they promised
Support portfolio scenario design and decision preparation with fact-based analysis
Apply hands-on BI, AI, data and analytics capabilities to improve reporting quality, automation and insight generation




Turn complexity into clear insights and recommendations

First and foremost, you are an analytical, technically strong performance manager who builds dashboards people actually trust. When you present a number, stakeholders don't question whether it's right — they ask what it means for the decision ahead.

You have a strong analytical mindset and enjoy creating structure where complexity exists. You turn fragmented information into insights that leaders can act on, and you're motivated by building performance management practices that create real business value.

You combine business understanding with solid hands-on BI, data and analytics experience. You are comfortable working with data models, dashboards, reporting logic and performance metrics — and you can translate technical complexity into clear insights for senior stakeholders.

What you bring:


Minimum 5 years of experience from performance management, portfolio management and reporting, PMO, business analytics, BI/data analytics or finance reporting
Master’s degree in business, Finance, Engineering, Data/Analytics, Life Science, Technology or equivalent
Solid hands-on technical experience building and developing Power BI reports and dashboards, including data modelling, reporting logic and visual design - this is a core, hands-on part of the role
Strong track record in KPI framework design, dashboard development and data-driven performance follow-up in a project, program or portfolio context
Experience supporting portfolio scenario design, trade-off discussions and fact-based decision-making
Strong stakeholder management skills and a proactive, solution-oriented approach
Have experience from R&D, medical devices, pharma, life science or another regulated industry — this is an advantage
Communicate effortlessly in written and spoken English




Interested?

If you would like to know more about the position, please contact Anna Revva, Head of PMO, R&D Innovation Portfolio Management by mail dkanre@coloplast.com.

Please note that due to the summer holiday period, response times in the recruitment process may be slightly longer than usual.

Employing about 16.000 people and with products available in more than 143 countries, we are one of the world´s leading medical device companies. We are constantly growing our business and always looking for new ways to move forward – we explore, learn and look for new ways of doing things.

Title: Laboratory Automation & Digitalization Engineer
Place: Hørsholm Municipality, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Do you want to help build the digital foundation for a modern laboratory and a CMC environment? Are you motivated by creating practical digital solutions, automating manual processes, and connecting systems and data? And would you like to take on a key role in an early-stage digitalization journey where your ideas and technical skills can make a real impact?




Then this could be the right opportunity for you.




The position

Global CMC at ALK is at the beginning of an important digitalization journey, and our department, Laboratory Automation Development, is looking for a hands-on Laboratory Automation & Digitalization Developer to help build the foundation for our future digital landscape.




This is a key role for an experienced profile who enjoys developing practical solutions, automating workflows, connecting systems and data sources, and working closely with both users and IT. You will not be joining a mature digital setup — you will help shape it from the start.




You will work across cross-functional areas with digital solutions such as LIMS, ELN, equipment connectivity, data transfers, visualization, automation, data and AI platforms and future digital infrastructure. The role is ideal for you if you can translate user needs into robust technical solutions and want to help build standards, tools, and ways of working from the ground up.




Your primary tasks will be:

Develop small and larger digital solutions to support and improve workflows, data handling, reporting, and decision-making in collaboration with end-users.
Automate manual processes such as calculations, file handling, data transfers, data mapping, and recurring reporting tasks.
Develop data-driven applications, dashboards, workflows, and visualization tools that create practical value for users.
Support connectivity between analytical equipment, LIMS, ELN, databases and data storage systems.
Work closely with IT to help establish scalable, secure, and maintainable digital infrastructure.
Contribute to standards for documentation, testing, version control, data flow design, and long-term solution ownership.
Ensure that solutions are developed with appropriate focus on data integrity, traceability, compliance, and maintainability.




Your profile

We expect that you have:

An academic degree within a relevant scientific or technical field, such as Engineering, Data Science, Computer Science, Biotechnology, Chemistry, or similar.
Solid hands-on experience programming data processing and automation workflows and scientific or engineering applications.
Experience with programming or scripting languages such as Python, C#, R, JavaScript, or similar.
Good understanding of SQL and relational databases, data structures and exchange formats such as CSV, XML, and JSON, and system integration through APIs.
Experience with visualization or reporting tools such as Power BI, Tableau, Qlik, Dash, Streamlit, Plotly, or similar.
The ability to work independently with an innovative and development-oriented mindset in an area that is still being established
Good communicates skills to work well with both scientific and technical stakeholders, including end-users, IT, QA, project managers and external vendors.




Experience with cloud-based data platforms, LIMS, ELN, CDS, SDMS, equipment connectivity, GxP, CSV/CSA, data integrity, audit trails, or validated systems is considered an advantage, but not a strict requirement if you have the right technical mindset and willingness to learn.




To succeed in this role, you should enjoy building practical solutions that solve real operational problems. You are curious, structured, and self-driven, and you are motivated by helping define how digital solutions should be developed, governed, and maintained in the future.




Become a part of ALK

We provide an attractive working environment for individuals looking for both personal and professional development. ALK is a global pharmaceutical company specialised in allergy immunotherapy. We are driven by a high level of professionalism, integrity, an open-minded approach and contributing to an inspiring and fun working environment together with our colleagues. You will be part of an engaged and informal team who values skill and knowledge creation. The result of your efforts will be significant throughout the organisation, and you will be able to actively influence and challenge the status quo.




Our offices in Denmark offer a green view of the DTU Science Park in Hørsholm. We believe that physical presence enforces strong teamwork and collaboration and creates success, so it is important that you enjoy coming to work at our site with a degree of flexibility to also work from home.




Apply

Apply by attaching your CV and a short letter of motivation, no later than 13 September 2026.




We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equal opportunity for all our job applicants. We evaluate applications and call for interviews on an ongoing basis, so start your application today! We reserve the right to take down the advert when we have found the right candidate.




If you want to learn more about our company, we encourage you to visit us at www.alk.net. For further information regarding the position please contact Associate Director, Rune Scheldon Gustafsson by phone +45 50899596. We kindly ask you not to contact us with commercial inquiries.

Title: Data Engineer
Description:
Job Description

Data Engineer – Junior/mid-level

Requirements Description Experience & Track Record


Experience in data engineering.
Experience working closely with Business Analysts to transform defined business requirements into robust, scalable, and high-quality data solutions.
Experience taking on more complex tasks with guidance and support from senior team members.
A strong interest in business operations and how data can be used to improve performance – for example fleet, rostering, dispatch, or response data – or a willingness to develop that understanding quickly.
Comfortable working with stakeholders and data sources across multiple countries and time zones.
Familiarity with implementing AI solutions and creating applications for AI use cases is a plus.


Skills & capabilities


Experience with Python and SQL
Experience in our core technical stack: Azure, Databricks, PySpark, Azure Data Factory.
Ability to build and maintain data pipelines for various common data sources, including operational systems that differ between countries.
A good understanding of data modeling concepts and their practical application, including harmonising similar data from different operating models into common models.
You are comfortable using CI/CD pipelines for deployment and have a pragmatic approach to troubleshooting.
Awareness of handling sensitive operational and personal data responsibly, in line with GDPR, HIPAA and equivalent requirements.
Contribute to the implementation of AI solutions.


Offer description

We are looking for a motivated Data Engineer with a developing T-shaped profile. This is a role for someone with a solid foundation in data engineering who is eager to apply their skills to solve tangible business challenges, deliver data-driven insights, and contribute to innovative AI applications.

You will join our growing community of 60+ data and AI professionals across Copenhagen and Warsaw. While based in our Copenhagen hub, your role will focus on building and delivering critical data solutions for our ambulance operations in Europe and the United States. Title: Student Quantitative Analyst
Description:
Are you passionate about quantitative analysis, technology, and energy markets?




Join our Physical Asset Management team and help develop quantitative solutions that optimise energy assets in real time. You'll work alongside experienced colleagues in a fast-paced environment where you'll quickly turn theory into practice and gain hands-on experience within energy trading.




About the team

We are a team of experienced specialists working with the optimisation of energy assets. We set high standards, collaborate closely, and believe the best results come from curiosity, knowledge sharing, and continuous development.




About the role

You'll contribute to the development of quantitative solutions used to optimise energy assets in real time. You'll gain insight into our technical landscape while supporting the development, testing, and improvement of trading algorithms that create value across our portfolio of assets, including renewables and batteries.




Your key responsibilities

You'll support the team across a range of quantitative and technical tasks, contributing to the continuous development of our optimisation capabilities. Your responsibilities will include:




Develop and improve trading algorithms for real-time asset optimisation.
Build an understanding of the Physical Asset Management IT landscape and algorithmic decision engine.
Analyse data and apply statistical models to support optimisation.
Support the development, testing, and debugging of quantitative solutions.
Contribute to the optimisation of renewables, batteries, and other asset classes.
Collaborate closely with experienced colleagues across the team.




This role offers a unique opportunity to combine quantitative analysis, technology, and energy markets. You'll work on solutions that create real value while gaining hands-on experience in a collaborative team where learning and continuous development are part of everyday work.

— Peter Lumbye Thomsen, Head of Intraday Analytics




What we are looking for

We're looking for a curious and motivated student who enjoys combining quantitative thinking with technology and problem-solving. You take initiative, enjoy collaborating with others, and are eager to learn.




Must-have




Currently enrolled in an advanced degree within a quantitative field such as physics, statistics, data science, or mathematical economics.
Experience with data analysis and statistical modelling.
Excellent problem-solving skills and strong attention to detail.
Ability to collaborate effectively in a fast-paced team environment.
A "no job too big, no job too small" mindset, a can-do attitude, and a strong sense of urgency.
Nice-to-have
Programming skills in Python, R, VBA, or similar languages.
Experience within power trading.




What we offer

You'll join an experienced team where you'll have the opportunity to apply your academic knowledge to real-world challenges while developing your technical and analytical skills.




Hands-on experience in a professional energy trading environment.
Close collaboration with experienced colleagues in Physical Asset Management.
A steep learning curve and high level of responsibility.
A student position of 15 hours per week, allowing you to combine work with your studies.

Title: Business Analytics Consultant
Description:
Twoday er den førende digitale transformationspartner i Nordeuropa med en global tilstedeværelse. Med cirka 3.000 teknologer samarbejder vi med de mest beundrede private og offentlige organisationer for at levere banebrydende digitale løsninger. Vores dybe brancheekspertise omfatter Data & AI, softwareudvikling, digitale oplevelser og forretningsapplikationer. Vores team, der opererer i hele Norden og Litauen, genererede en omsætning på 280 millioner euro i 2023. Vi betjener over 8.000 kunder og understøtter deres digitale transformationsrejser.

Vil du være med på Danmarks stærkeste team af Business Analytics-konsulenter? Vil du arbejde med nogle af Danmark største virksomheder? Tænder du på at gøre komplekse problemstillinger til simple løsninger for kunderne? Så er twoday Data & AI det rigtige sted for dig! Vi søger nye Business Analytics-konsulenter til et af vores kontorer i Danmark.

Om stillingen

Som Business Analytics-konsulent vil du indgå i et stærkt team med en varierende hverdag – du vil få ansvar, frihed og faglig udvikling. Vores konsulenter besidder hver især stærke kompetencer, og du vil opleve kolleger, der er specialister på deres område.

Du vil sammen med vores kunder afklare de forretningsmæssige behov og derefter designe, udvikle og implementere løsningen. Alt efter kompleksitet og størrelse af løsningen arbejder du enten i et team eller som primær konsulent på løsningerne.

Vi holder faste firmadage, hvor sparring, idéudveksling og kollegialt sammenhold er i højsædet. Du vil opleve at blive udfordret, men du vil også få mulighed for at udfordre dine kolleger.

Fristet, men stadig i tvivl?


Turbo på det faglige! Hos twoday Data & AI er vores medarbejdere kendt for at have et skyhøjt fagligt niveau. Samtidig med at vi har det godt socialt.
Lækre kontorer! twoday Data & AI har lækre og moderne kontorer centralt placeret i København, Aarhus, Aalborg og Kolding.
Tid til fordybelse! Vi har fire årlige fagdage, hvor idéudvikling, udvikling og sparring er i højsædet.
Uddannelse! Hos twoday Data & AI får du mulighed for efteruddannelse og certificeringer.
Attraktiv lønpakke! Vi tilbyder en attraktiv lønpakke med branchens bedste bonusordning.
Fantastisk kaffe! Hos twoday Data & AI har du adgang til fitness, frugt og fantastisk god kaffe.


Om dig

Du har flere års relevant erhvervserfaring og brænder for hele tiden at blive bedre. Du har en baggrund som BI- eller datakonsulent, controller i en større virksomhed eller noget lign. Du har erfaring med Azure Data Platform, Microsoft Fabric, Databricks og/eller SQL Server. Endvidere har du kendskab til én eller flere front-end værktøjer såsom Power BI, Excel eller lign.

Du ved, at livet som konsulent er udfordrende og til tider meget krævende. Vores vigtigste aktiv er vores kunder og medarbejdere, og du er klar til at give, hvad der skal til, for at skabe et godt forhold både internt og eksternt samt at udvikle Business Intelligence-løsninger i verdensklasse.

Din uddannelse kan være cand.merc., cand.merc.dat eller cand.oecon – eller for den sags skyld noget helt fjerde. Det vigtigste er, at du brænder for Business Analytics og ønsker at gøre en forskel.

Dine kommunikative evner er i top, og du skriver og taler flydende dansk og engelsk.

Vi begejstrer med data – måske vil du være med?

Så send din ansøgning i dag, de vil løbende blive læst.

Der vil løbende blive indkaldt til indledende samtaler. Du ansøger ved at klikke på knappen nedenfor. Alle ansøgninger behandles fortroligt.

Hvis du har spørgsmål til stillingen, er Ann Brahe-Orlandi, Talent Acquisition Manager, klar til at hjælpe. Hun glæder sig til at høre fra dig på ann.brahe-orlandi@twoday.com.

Hvad kan vi tilbyde?

Twoday er placeret i moderne lokaler på 30 steder i Norge, Sverige, Danmark, Finland og Litauen. Vi har et stærkt og unikt socialt miljø med højt engagerede medarbejdere. Hvis du er den kandidat, vi leder efter, vil du få en central rolle med spændende muligheder for at udvikle dig i en international og innovativ gruppe, med spændende produkter og tjenester inden for teknologi og software. Du vil også have fleksibiliteten til at "jumpe" og arbejde fra et af vores hovedkontorer i Oslo, Stockholm, København, Helsinki eller Vilnius til tider.

Title: Experienced Data Engineer - Innovation and Consumers, Aarhus or Gdansk
Description:
Are you passionate about data, AI and technology, and eager to build digital solutions that create real business value?

Our mission is simple to deliver business value through digital solutions that meet real business needs. We are looking for a curious and collaborative Senior IT Developer who is eager to leverage data, AI, and technology to solve challenges, enable better decisions, and make a lasting impact says Marianne Helleshøj, Head of IT Product for Innovation & Consumers.

How You Will Make An Impact

As an Senior IT Developer, you will join the Commercial IT Product team supporting Innovation and Consumer Intelligence. You will help develop and maintain data-driven solutions that enable better insights, decision-making and business outcomes. Working closely with business stakeholders and your team members, you will translate requirements into scalable and maintainable technical solutions.

Together with the team, you will build and maintain data products on Arla’s data platform primarily built around Azure Databricks, Power BI, and Microsoft Foundry. The solutions will be built in a mixture of PySpark and SQL and deployment will happen via Terraform with version control in Azure DevOps or GitHub.

Your key responsibilities include


Collaborate with business stakeholders to understand requirements and translate them into technical solutions.
Develop and maintain data pipelines, data models and digital solutions that support business needs.
Build scalable ETL/ELT processes and contribute to high-quality data engineering practices.
Support the continuous improvement of existing solutions and development processes.
Work closely with developers, architects, IT specialists and business stakeholders to deliver reliable and maintainable solutions.
Contribute to the development of modern cloud-based data platforms and applications.


What Will Make You Successful

To succeed in this role, you are curious, analytical and with strong collaboration skills. You enjoy solving complex problems, working with data and collaborating with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. You strive to get the best out of the collaboration and supporting and helping your colleagues just as they help you when you need it. We imagine the ideal candidate brings


A degree in information systems, computer science, engineering or similar
3-5 years of experience as Data Warehouse Developer, BI Developer, SQL Developer or Data Engineer
The ability to translate business needs into practical technical solutions
Experience developing with Spark in Databrick
Proficient in vector databases, embeddings, LLMs, data agents and generative AI
Proficient in SQL and PySpark
Proficient in any ETL/ELT/Integration/Workflow/Task Automation tool (e.g. Azure Data Factory, Logic Apps, Azure Function, SSIS etc.)
Knowledge of data engineering best practices and scalable solution design in a lakehouse environment
A proactive, positive mindset and willingness to learn new technologies – especially within AI


It is an advantage but not a requirement if you also have any of these


Databricks experience
Experience with basic data science concepts and LLM know-hows
Azure cloud experience
Terraform knowledge
Knowledge of deployment concepts and containerization
Experience in web application development


What do we offer?

You will join a collaborative IT Product team within Commercial IT, working closely with Innovation and Consumer Intelligence. The role offers a unique opportunity to work at the intersection of business, data, AI and technology, where your solutions help transform data into actionable insights and measurable business value.

We believe in learning by doing and provide an environment where curiosity, knowledge sharing and continuous development are encouraged.

Would you like to join us?

If you are ready to start your career in a role where technology, data and business come together, we would love to hear from you. Please apply as soon as possible, as we review applications on a continuous basis and may close the recruitment once the right candidate has been found.

For additional information, please contact Marianne Helleshøj, Head of IT Product for Innovation and Consumers, at +45 91 31 16 39.

AI is changing how software gets built.

Building modern data platforms and pipelines

Helping clients move AI into real operational environments
Working closely with both technical teams and decision makers
Shaping how modern AI infrastructure is built in practice

Title: Data & Analyse-lead
Place: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Vil du være med til at skabe digitale oplevelser, der gør komplekse kunderejser enkle, intuitive og meningsfulde?  





I København søger vi en analytisk stærk og forretningsorienteret profil, der kan tage ansvar for at etablere og drive vores datadrevne beslutningsgrundlag på tværs af flere produktteams med fokus på digitale løsninger, der understøtter kunderejsen. JP/Politikens Hus leverer nogle af Danmarks stærkeste mediebrands som Ekstrabladet, Jyllands-Posten, Politiken og Watch Medier. 





Rollen kombinerer data enablement, metrikdesign, analyse og governance. Du bliver bindeled mellem produktledelse, domæneansvarlige productmanagers og teams, der arbejder sammen med centrale dataplatforms-teams – og du får en central rolle i at sikre tillid til data – og omsætte data til indsigter og reel værdiskabelse i vores produkt- og platformteams. Du kommer til at arbejde tæt sammen med produktchefen omkring strategiske temaer. 





I rollen kommer du til at være en central drivkraft i vores produktstyring på flg områder: 






Du skal hjælpe med at definere og konsolidere lean-metrikker, der tydeligt afspejler værdiskabelse og sparre med product managers om formulering af klare og målbare SMART-mål.


Du skal elske at skabe gennemsigtighed gennem selv at bygge Power BI dashboards, der visualiserer relevante metrikker på en forretningsvenlig måde og understøtter både operationelle og strategiske beslutninger med indsigter.


Definere og dokumentere domænets data-leverancekontrakter mod den fælles dataplatform og bidrage til moden dataarkitektur og standardisering.


Sikre at teams har adgang til nødvendige analytiske værktøjer og datagrundlag og at Product managers får analytisk støtte i det daglige arbejde.






Vi forventer, at du: 






Har en kandidatgrad inden for fx IT, data science eller business analytics eller lign.


Har solid erfaring med metrikdesign, KPI-rammer og værdimåling.


Har arbejdet med BI- og visualiseringsværktøjer (fx Power BI, Tableau, Looker el.lign.).


Forstår datamodellering og grundlæggende data governance.


Har erfaring fra en produktorganisation, der arbejder agilt.


Kan bevæge dig sikkert mellem tekniske specialister og forretningsbeslutningstagere.






Det er en fordel, hvis du har erfaring med: 






Lean-principper og værdistrømsforståelse.


OKR- eller målstyringsrammer.


Dataplatforme og serviceorienteret arkitektur






Vi tilbyder 





Som en del af vores mediehus-familie kan vi tilbyde en dynamisk og inspirerende arbejdsplads, der står midt i en rivende digital udvikling. Teresa Torres og Marty Cagans produkttanker er vores forbilleder. 





Som arbejdsplads støtter vi medarbejdere i deres personlige og faglige udvikling og tilbyder adgang til faglige og sociale fællesskaber, netværk på tværs af teams, samt masser af kulturelle aktiviteter i huset. 





Vi tror på en sund balance mellem arbejde og privatliv og tilbyder en række andre fordele, såsom en god pensionsordning og sundhedsforsikring. 





Vi har en uformel og åben omgangstone med et godt kollegialt fællesskab, samt høj grad af frihed og ansvar til at forme vores daglige arbejde sammen i teamet.  Sidst, men ikke mindst, har vi glæden af et godt kontormiljø på Rådhuspladsen i København. 





Ansøgningsfrist:  20. september 2026 





Vi evaluerer ansøgninger og indkalder til samtaler løbende i hele perioden. Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, kan du kontakte produktchef Svenn Andersen, svenn.andersen@jppol.dk.

Title: Senior Data Engineer
Place: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Er du specialist i Azure, Databricks og PowerBI – og klar til at gøre en forskel for store kunder? Så er du måske vores nye Senior Data Engineer.




Stillingen kan besættes fra vores kontor i København.




Solitas danske Data & AI-team vokser, og vi søger derfor flere Data Engineers med solid erfaring i Microsoft Azure, Databricks og Power BI, som vil være med til at designe og bygge moderne dataplatforme og analytics-løsninger for store kunder på tværs af brancher.

Med en kundeportefølje, der inkluderer nogle af Danmarks største offentlige og private virksomheder, oplever Solita i Danmark en betydelig vækst – særligt inden for data og kunstig intelligens.




Hos Solita skaber vi digitale løsninger, der gør en forskel. Vi kombinerer dyb teknisk ekspertise med stærk forretningsindsigt og arbejder tæt sammen med vores kunder for at levere skræddersyede løsninger fra strategi til implementering.




Vores kultur er præget af tillid, samarbejde og høj faglighed, og vores teams består af passionerede specialister.




Hvad bliver din rolle?

Som Senior Data Engineer hos Solita bliver du en central del af vores datateam, hvor du er med til at udvikle og optimere avancerede dataplatforme for vores kunder.




Du bidrager gennem hele projektforløbet – fra analyse og design til implementering af robuste data pipelines og dataprodukter, der skaber reel forretningsværdi.




Som Senior Data Engineer i vores Data/AI-team indgår du i en udadvendt konsulentrolle, hvor en del af arbejdet foregår on-site hos kunden. Her deltager du blandt andet i presales-aktiviteter og yder teknisk rådgivning, hvor du anvender din faglige ekspertise til at omsætte forretningsbehov til effektive og værdiskabende dataløsninger.




Dine primære arbejdsopgaver:

• Analyse, design og implementering af data pipelines

• Udvikling af ETL-processer, data warehouses og lakehouses

• Implementering og vedligeholdelse af dataplatformsteknologier som Databricks, MS Fabric eller Snowflake

• Arbejde med teknologier som Databricks, MS Fabric, Snowflake, Azure Data Factory, SQL, Spark, Python/Scala




Hvem er du?

Du har erfaring som konsulent og trives i en udadvendt rolle med flere samtidige projekter. Du har solid erfaring med moderne teknologier og dataplatforme og motiveres af faglig udvikling i et innovativt miljø, hvor kvalitet og forretningsværdi er i fokus.




Vi forestiller os, at:

• Du har min. 5-7 års erfaring med data engineering og dataløsninger

• Du har mange års erfaring med teknologier som Databricks, Data Factory, MS PowerBI og Azure

• Du kender til datamodellering, ETL, analytics, BI, AI/ML arkitektur

• Du har erfaring med Python, SQL og PL/SQL




Du arbejder selvstændig, struktureret og samarbejdsorienteret, og du kommunikerer flydende på både dansk og engelsk – såvel mundtligt som skriftligt.




Om Solita

Solita er en AI-drevet, teknologi-, data- og softwarevirksomhed dedikeret til digital transformation og softwareudvikling.




Vi hjælper virksomheder og samfund med at gentænke deres fremtid gennem avanceret teknologi, datainnovation og menneskelig indsigt. Vores ydelser spænder over technology consulting, AI og analyse, data og softwareudvikling samt application management, leveret som services og projekter.




Solita blev grundlagt i 1996 og beskæftiger i dag over 2.200 medarbejdere i ni lande: Finland, Danmark, Sverige, Norge, Belgien, Tyskland, Schweiz, Polen og Storbritannien.




Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

Stillingen ønskes besat snarest muligt, og afholder derfor samtaler løbende.




Har du spørgsmål, er du velkommen til at kontakte:

Rikke Meng, Director TA – tlf. +45 22 65 02 18 / rme@solita.dk




Vi ser frem til at modtage din ansøgning, og lære dig bedre at kende!

Title: Business Intelligence Engineer
Place: Hillerød, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Help build and operate the future of Business Intelligence at Ellab




Ellab is on an exciting growth journey, and data is at the heart of our success. We are building a unified, company-wide Business Intelligence platform that will enable better decision-making across our global organization spanning 15 different countries with approximately 800 employees and 980 million DKK in turnover.




We are looking for a Business Intelligence Engineer who enjoys building things, solving problems and making data work in the real world.

If you like to get into the details, understand how operational systems work, turn raw data into reliable solutions and take ownership when something doesn't work as expected, this role is for you!

As part of our growing Business Intelligence team, you'll work alongside Data Engineers, BI Engineers and an analyst, owning the data value chain from operational source systems through to semantic models and reporting. You will help move Ellab from fragmented reports and ad hoc data extracts toward a centralized, scalable BI platform - while also making sure that the solutions we build work reliably in day-to-day operations.




What You'll Be Doing




This is a hands-on engineering role. You will spend your time building, improving, troubleshooting, and maintaining BI solutions, while working closely with the business to understand the problems behind the data.

You will:




Build, maintain and optimize semantic models in Power BI to enable reliable, scalable and compliant reporting, ensuring consistent data integrity and traceability across Finance, Supply Chain, Operations, Field Services and Sales.
Develop and improve data solutions using SQL, Microsoft Fabric and ADF.
Work directly with operational data sources from Microsoft business applications such as Business Central and Dynamics 365 Customer Engagement (Field Service, Project Operations) and investigate data quality, integration, and reporting issues.
Troubleshoot problems and take end-to-end responsibility from idea to implementation and continuous improvement.
Work closely with stakeholders to translate business processes, needs and operational challenges into practical, robust BI solutions.
Continuously improve existing data models, reports, and ways of working in the team and the organization.
Help establish standards and best practices for BI development, data quality, and documentation.




What You'll Bring




You combine strong technical skills with a hands-on, problem-solving mindset.

You'll ideally have:




3+ years of experience working with Power BI, DAX and SQL.
3+ years of experience working with semantic layers, ensuring consistent metric definitions across business units.
Experience working with data from operational systems such as ERP and CRM
A track record of building and delivering working BI or data solutions, rather than primarily managing projects or coordinating others.
Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills.
The ability to understand a business problem, investigate the underlying data, and turn it into a practical solution.
A structured and pragmatic approach to problem-solving.
The ability to work independently and take ownership from problem identification through implementation.
Strong communication skills and the ability to work effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.




It would be an advantage if you also have:




Experience with Microsoft Fabric and the wider Microsoft data ecosystem.
Experience working in complex, enterprise-scale environments.
Experience integrating data from multiple operational systems.
Exposure to multinational organizations and diverse business domains.
Knowledge of finance, supply chain, procurement, resource planning, manufacturing, or related business functions.




The Hiring Process




If you are ready to take on this exciting opportunity, apply now to join our team.

We aim to hire the best fit as soon as possible. Interviews will be conducted on a rolling basis until a mutually suitable match has been identified.

Title: Data Scientist
Company: Halian | Managed Services, Recruitment Agency & Contract Staffing
Description:
JOB- Data Scientist

LOCATION- Norwich

TERM- Permanent

SALARY- £55,000 to £75,000 per annum

BENEFITS – Bonus, Pension, Private Healthcare, Hybrid Working, Learning & Development Budget, Flexi-time, Career Progression etc.




We are a growing, data-driven organisation where analytics and machine learning are central to improving customer engagement, operational efficiency, and commercial performance. As we continue to invest in our data capability, we are looking to appoint a Data Scientist to help develop innovative, production-ready machine learning and AI solutions.




We are looking to hire a commercially minded Data Scientist to take ownership of the complete data science lifecycle, from problem definition and experimentation through to production deployment. You will work with large-scale transactional and behavioural datasets, partnering with stakeholders across the business to deliver measurable commercial impact through data.




The Data Scientist MUST have:

• Commercial experience delivering end-to-end Data Science and Machine Learning solutions

• Strong programming skills in Python, including pandas, NumPy, and Scikit-learn

• Excellent SQL skills and experience manipulating large datasets

• Experience building predictive models including classification, regression, forecasting, or anomaly detection

• Strong understanding of statistics, hypothesis testing, and experimental design

• Experience designing and analysing A/B tests and controlled experiments

• Experience deploying machine learning models into production environments

• Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills with the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical audiences




The Data Scientist will ideally have the following attributes:

• Experience working with cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, or GCP

• Experience building reproducible machine learning pipelines using Git and modern software development practices

• Knowledge of data visualisation tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or similar

• Experience with Azure Machine Learning or equivalent cloud ML platforms would be beneficial

• Experience developing time-series forecasting models

• Knowledge of feature engineering techniques for large-scale transactional datasets

• Familiarity with MLOps, model monitoring, and production AI systems

• Exposure to Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), or Agentic AI applications would be advantageous

• Experience with OCR, document processing, or intelligent automation would be beneficial

• Knowledge of tools such as Streamlit, MLflow, or similar would be advantageous

• A proactive mindset with a passion for solving complex business problems using data




The Data Scientist role will involve:

• Designing, developing, and deploying production-ready machine learning models to solve commercial challenges

• Building classification, segmentation, forecasting, anomaly detection, and predictive models

• Designing, executing, and analysing A/B tests and statistical experiments

• Engineering robust feature pipelines from large transactional and behavioural datasets

• Taking models from prototype through validation, deployment, monitoring, and optimisation

• Developing reusable, version-controlled machine learning pipelines following engineering best practices

• Creating dashboards and visualisations to communicate analytical findings to business stakeholders

• Collaborating with commercial, product, and operational teams to identify data-driven opportunities

• Contributing to the development of AI-enabled products, including Generative AI applications where appropriate




If you are interested in this position, please apply with an up-to-date CV as soon as possible, along with your availability and salary expectations.

Title: Demand Reporting Data Scientist
Description:
Circa £43,344 (depending On Skills & Experience)

Permanent

Full Time / 37 Hours (Flexible working opportunities available)

Huntingdon or Peterborough - Hybrid

Double Matched Pension Scheme (up to 21% combined)

Private Healthcare

Make every drop of your potential count!

We're looking for two Demand Reporting Data Scientists to join Anglian Water's Strategic Asset Management team and help shape how consumption data is understood, reported and used across the business.

Our smart meter estate is expected to grow to 2.3 million meters by 2030, creating a rapid increase in the volume, frequency and strategic value of water consumption data. As part of our central Consumption Data Team, you'll turn this information into advanced analytical models and actionable insight that strengthen, regulatory reporting, demand management, leakage understanding and long-term water efficiency.

This is a hands-on data science role with real operational and environmental impact. You'll work with large, high-frequency datasets, applying statistics, predictive modelling and machine learning to improve how we calculate and understand household and non-household consumption. You'll also help automate data preparation and reporting, retain specialist scientific capability in-house, and support our ambition to achieve world-leading water efficiency outcomes.

What you'll be doing:


Build and develop models that will feed directly into regulatory reporting and consumption component of the water balance, Household and Non household consumption, and night usage.
Enrich stakeholder insight of our Big Data Smart Meter set, applying quality assurance techniques and automation processes to deliver consistent reporting.
Develop statistical and predictive models that improve understanding of consumption, per capita consumption, business demand and leakage, and feed directly into regulatory reporting.
Carry out exploratory analysis, data mining and empirical analysis to identify trends, drivers and opportunities.
Apply data science techniques such as linear and multivariate regression, decision trees, Monte Carlo analysis and neural networks to complex business problems.
Define and apply performance and accuracy measures to validate models and communicate their limitations clearly.
Translate complex findings into clear visualisations and practical recommendations for operational, strategic and regulatory stakeholders.
Identify, cleanse, combine and prepare large, high-frequency datasets for analytical and data science products
Build reusable checks, automated workflows and repeatable data preparation processes
Create and maintain data pipelines, working with Data Engineers to support testing and production deployment
-Collaborate with subject matter experts, reporting teams and data squads to develop solutions that deliver measurable business value
Explore emerging data science, machine learning and artificial intelligence approaches while maintaining strong data ethics, privacy and governance standards
Stay up to date with changes to water industry regulation, reporting requirements, data protection and governance policies, and apply this knowledge to your work.



What We're Looking For


A Level 5 or higher qualification in Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics or a related quantitative subject, or equivalent professional experience
A portfolio of data science solutions that demonstrates your approach, technical contribution and the outcomes delivered
Strong Python and SQL capability, with experience preparing, manipulating and analysing complex datasets
Practical experience applying statistical analysis, predictive modelling and machine learning techniques
Strong Power BI experience, including data discovery, semantic models, visualisation and insight communication
Experience working collaboratively in cross-functional teams and translating business problems into analytical solutions
Strong written, verbal and visual communication skills, with the ability to explain technical approaches to non-technical audiences
Awareness of data ethics, privacy considerations and relevant data protection requirements
Curiosity, ownership and a commitment to continuous technical development



Desirable:


Experience using Microsoft Azure, Databricks or comparable cloud data platforms
Experience collaborating on shared codebases and working with DevOps, Agile or Waterfall delivery methods
Knowledge of the water industry, consumption reporting, leakage or a related engineering domain



Why join Anglian Water?

At Anglian Water, data is central to how we secure resilient water supplies and support customers to use water more efficiently. In this role, you'll help unlock the value of one of the UK's fastest-growing smart meter datasets and directly influence how we understand demand, improve reporting and plan for the future.

You'll gain exposure to complex, high-value data science challenges with clear regulatory, operational and environmental outcomes. Working alongside Data Engineers, reporting specialists and subject matter experts, you'll develop your capability across modelling, machine learning, data pipelines and applied water-sector analytics while helping establish sustainable in-house expertise.

This is an opportunity to create data products that move beyond reporting to diagnostic and prescriptive insight, supporting better decisions across water resources, customer demand and leakage performance.

Benefits


26 days annual leave plus bank holidays (increasing with length of service)
Flexible working options
Private health care
Competitive pension scheme - Anglian Water double-matches contributions up to 7%
Life assurance at eight times your salary
Annual bonus
Potential funded car allowance depending on evidenced business mileage
Personal medical assessments
Virtual GP service
Cancer screening
Financial wellbeing support and salary finance benefits
Lifestyle savings including discounts on retail, travel and utilities
Employee Assistance Programme
Volunteer days



Inclusion at Anglian Water

We're committed to creating a workplace where everyone feels they belong. We are proud signatories of the Social Mobility Pledge, Race at Work Charter and Armed Forces Covenant, and we're a Disability Confident employer.

Closing Date: 16th September 2026

Title: Data Scientist
Description:
Description

ABOUT THE COMPANY

Infleqtion is a global quantum technology company solving the world’s most challenging problems. The company harnesses quantum mechanics to build and integrate quantum computers, sensors, and networks. From fundamental physics to leading edge commercial products, Infleqtion enables “quantum everywhere” through our ecosystem of devices and platforms. Our mission is to commercialise atom-based quantum products that provide orders of magnitude improvements in performance and computing applications.

LOCATION

Infleqtion has offices in the USA, United Kingdom and Australia. This is a full-time position based at our Kidlington, Oxford office. Work from home permitted up to 2 days per week based on business needs and manager approval.

Position Summary

Infleqtion is recruiting a passionate and detail-driven Data Scientist to join our team, focusing on time series modelling and control systems. You’ll be developing predictive algorithms, identifying dynamic patterns and anomalies, and building models that help automate decision-making in real-time systems involving quantum sensors. This is a high-impact role bridging data science, physics and engineering disciplines.

Job Responsibilities

The duties and responsibilities outlined below include essential functions of the role. Depending on business needs, this role may perform a combination of some or all of the following duties.


Design and implement robust time series models for forecasting, anomaly detection, and predictive maintenance.
Collaborate with product and engineering teams to integrate predictive models into live quantum sensors.
Evaluate performance of deployed models and develop tools/pipelines to continuously refine them.
Analyse large-scale sensor and telemetry data from quantum sensor systems
Effectively manage technical priorities, meet deadlines, and deliver on project objectives.


Requirements


Masters degree in a STEM field (maths, science, engineering etc.) or equivalent
Strong programming skills in Python (e.g., NumPy, Pandas, scikit-learn, TensorFlow/PyTorch).
Demonstrable experience in creating and developing Python libraries.
Demonstrable experience designing, implementing and training machine learning models from scratch.
Strong foundations in applied mathematics and physics, particularly in statistical modelling, systems dynamics and differential equations.
Familiarity with software engineering best practices: version control (Git), code review workflows, unit testing, CI/CD pipelines.
Experience writing clean, efficient, and modular code suitable for production environments.


Desirable Skills Or Knowledge


Familiarity with AMO physics or quantum machine learning.
Experience with MLOps best practices.
Knowledge of systems like Apache Kafka, MQTT or real-time data pipelines.
Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP).
Deep expertise in time series modelling techniques (e.g., ARIMA, VAR, Prophet, LSTM).
Solid grasp of control theory concepts (e.g., PID controllers, Kalman Filters, Model Predictive Control, Reinforcement Learning).
Familiarity with lower-level development of data pipelines in e.g. C++/Rust.


Travel

Up to 10% travel, including international travel, may be required

Working Conditions And Physical Requirements

Work will normally be performed in an office and laboratory environment. Able to efficiently use automated office equipment such as laptops, copiers, and printers; able to effectively engage in communications (via phone, computer, or in-person). Will involve sitting, standing, walking, lifting, and carrying up to 10 kg.

Equal Opportunity

Regardless of your interest in the quantum industry, you can take pride in the fact that Infleqtion is building an ecosystem of quantum technologies and commercial products, driving the industry towards the future. Studies reveal that while men apply for jobs when they meet an average of 60% of the requirements, women and other groups tend to apply only when they meet all the criteria. If you believe you have the potential but don't meet every single point in our job advertisement, please don't hesitate to contact us! We would love to chat with you and see how you could bring great value to our team. Our goal is to find exceptional individuals who can enrich our team culture, actively contribute, and have a genuine passion for their work. Here you have freedom to embrace your whole self: who you love, your gender identity and expression, skin colour, age, appearance, disability, neurodiversity, DNA, military/veteran status, citizenship, and other factors that make up who you are. Your uniqueness is valued, welcomed, and appreciated here. We are dedicated to providing a positive workplace and base all employment decisions on your qualifications, performance, merits, as well as business needs. We are proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer.

Notice to Recruitment Agencies

Infleqtion does not accept unsolicited CV's from agencies. Infleqtion is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited CV's.

Benefits

In addition to your base compensation, we offer a generous Total Rewards program which includes:


Competitive salary
Bonus Program
Incentive Stock Option Plan
Unlimited PTO subject to fair usage
Generous company 10% pension contribution regardless of employee contribution
Cycle to work scheme
Tax efficient technology schemes
BUPA Private Healthcare Insurance once probationary period is successfully completed
Life assurance (4 x salary)

Description:
Location: Belfast, NI / Hybrid

(This role requires working in-office 3 days per week.)

About us:

EverQuote is a leading AI-powered growth solutions partner for regulated property and casualty insurance entities, enabling the largest insurance carriers and thousands of agents to maximize customer acquisition across digital channels. Fueled by our proprietary data assets and our AI traffic engine, EverQuote is transforming the way providers attract and engage consumers to grow market share.

Joining our team puts you at the forefront of this transformation. You will collaborate with a group of builders to solve complex problems and reshape a massive industry. If you want to drive real-world impact and do the best work of your career, you’ve found your home. We move fast, follow the data, and hold ourselves to high standards. If that's how you work too, this is the role for you.

About the role:

EverQuote is seeking a Data Scientist to join our growing team! As a member of the Data Science team, you will be instrumental in delivering and deploying artificial intelligence and machine learning models that drive Everquote’s long term success.

What you’ll do:

Work with a cross-functional team to convert business problems into scalable solutions using your knowledge of mathematics, statistics, and machine learning. You will join a team of talented and collaborative data scientists and machine learning engineers, and have the opportunity to establish yourself as a technical contributor as our team continues to grow.

What you bring to the team:


Bachelor's degree in a technical field such as mathematics, statistics, computer science, or economics, or equivalent practical experience; a Master's degree or PhD in a relevant field is a plus
2+ years of professional experience as a data scientist developing predictive models, preferably with experience deploying those solutions to production environments
Demonstrated success turning business problems into data problems and developing innovative solutions
Ability to explain results to technical and non-technical teammates, using strong communication and data visualization skills
Demonstrated experience building machine learning models using standard tools such as scikit-learn or R, to drive business improvements
Solid knowledge of applied mathematics and statistics and their common applications in online businesses


Nice to have:


Experience with, or strong interest in, understanding and optimizing online auctions for both bidders and sellers
Experience with, or strong interest in, optimization using reinforcement learning and contextual multi-armed bandits
Strong skills in statistical and scientific programming in Python or R, fluency in SQL, and proficiency with Jupyter notebooks
Experience packaging code for deployment and reusability
Enjoy sharing knowledge and mentoring teammates, and communicating designs to technical and non-technical stakeholders
An interest in staying current with data science trends and helping the team expand its tech stack
Comfortable working in an Agile team environment with everyday impact


The base salary offered for this position is determined by several factors, including the applicant’s job-related skills, relevant experience, education or training, and work location.

In addition to base salary, our total compensation package may include participation in variable cash bonus programs, equity, and a comprehensive range of health, welfare, and wellbeing benefits based on eligibility which are designated by role.

Your recruiter can provide more details about the specific salary/OTE range for your role during the hiring process.

Statement on Fair Employment and Equal Opportunities

EverQuote NI is committed to ensuring equal opportunity for all job applicants and employees. We will not discriminate on the grounds of religious belief, political opinion, race, gender (including gender reassignment), sexual orientation, marital or civil partnership status, pregnancy or maternity, age, or disability.

As a registered employer in Northern Ireland, EverQuote NI complies with the Fair Employment and Treatment (Northern Ireland) Order 1998. EverQuote NI carries out background checks on all candidates offered a position. A criminal record will not automatically disqualify you from working with EverQuote NI Limited; each case is considered on its individual merits in line with our fair recruitment practices.

Reasonable Adjustments

We are committed to ensuring an inclusive and accessible recruitment process for all candidates. If you require any reasonable adjustments or accommodations at any stage of the interview process, please let us know and we will work with you to arrange them.

Title: Data Scientist
Description:
About You.

Are you a Data Scientist who's worked within a credit risk, lending, banking, fintech or consumer finance environment previously?
Can you create compelling reports that tell a story and explain complex data sets to all audiences?
Do you have the experience and drive to help establish and develop our data science and credit risk modelling capability from the ground up?




About the Role.

We're looking for a highly skilled and motivated Data Scientist to join us during an exciting time of Change and Transformation.

Reporting to the Credit Risk Manager and working closely with the Director of Credit Risk and Data Analytics, this is a unique opportunity to become one of the key architects of our future decisioning and risk management framework.

What You’ll Do.

You'll be responsible for developing our first generation of predictive credit risk models, including Probability of Default (PD), Loss Given Default (LGD), Exposure at Default (EAD), application scorecards, affordability models and collections strategies.




You will work with large and complex datasets to identify opportunities that improve lending decisions, enhance customer outcomes and support sustainable portfolio growth.

Combining traditional data science techniques with practical commercial application, you'll leverage modern analytics, machine learning and AI-assisted development tools to accelerate model development, improve decision making and deliver tangible business value.




You'll collaborate with stakeholders across Credit Risk, Operations, Finance, Collections and Technology to deliver innovative, data-driven solutions that support the company's strategic objectives and will use your quantitative skills to deliver actionable insights to a variety of senior external and internal stakeholders.

Responsibilities

Design, develop, validate and monitor predictive credit risk models including but limited to ECL, pricing, forecasting and provisioning models.
Maintain application scorecards, affordability models and decisioning strategies that support responsible lending and portfolio growth.
Support the development of provisioning, forecasting and portfolio monitoring methodologies.
Analyse customer, bureau, affordability and behavioural data to identify trends, risks and opportunities.
Utilise machine learning and AI-assisted development techniques to accelerate model development and improve analytical efficiency.
Produce robust model documentation, validation reports and governance materials.
Work closely with Credit Risk, Operations, Transformation and Finance teams to translate business problems into analytical solutions.
Build scalable analytical processes using BigQuery, Python and Google Cloud technologies.
Develop clear and insightful visualisations and presentations for both technical and non-technical audiences.
Stay informed of industry best practice, emerging technologies and regulatory developments relevant to consumer credit risk modelling.
Collaborate with stakeholders across departments to understand their data needs and deliver tailored solutions.
Ensure data integrity and compliance with relevant regulations (e.g., GDPR).
Identifying and analysing causes of urgent defects and making predictions on likelihood of recurrence
Acting as an internal consultant to the business on data driven decision making and insights
Developing differentiated pricing models and educating stakeholders on findings
Discovering trends and patterns within complex data and present findings to stakeholders
Leveraging state-of-the-art data mining and machine learning tools and methodologies to drive improved business decisions
Documenting and articulate key learnings from the data mining exercises




Your Working Style and Experience.

You're proactive with excellent stakeholder managements skills, a confident presenter and someone who stays informed about emerging technologies and methodologies.




You've experience of using Python, a strong knowledge of SQL, a solid understanding of statistical modelling techniques and predictive analytics, and experience developing, validating or monitoring predictive models and scorecards.




About Billing Finance

We are a privately-run family owned vehicle financing Company based on the outskirts of Northampton. We focus on customers with non-standard credit profiles that may not fit the automated underwriting processes of other lenders.




Our mission is to help get all our people, including customers and staff “where they need to be” by “putting them at the heart of everything we do”. We are entering an exciting phase of transformation and as a small company, this role will offer the successful candidate the opportunity to work across the whole customer journey cycle, and to directly see the impacts that they made.




Our values are:




We are responsible – We are conscious of our impact on people and planet
We care about you – We are kind and compassionate with our customers and with each other
We work with you – We support financial wellbeing for our customers and the wider community




The successful candidate will not only have a successful and fulfilling career with us but will also receive a fantastic range of benefits:




Discretionary bonus scheme
Electric Vehicle salary sacrifice scheme
Pension salary sacrifice scheme
Private Medical
Income Protection
Hybrid working
Employee Assistance Programme
Annual £200 personal growth fund
Paid volunteering days




The Recruitment Process and How We Will Use Your Data

The recruitment process will involve obtaining information and/or exchanging it with the following organisations to assist with our pre-employment checks prior to interview.




Credit Reference Agencies – to complete a soft credit check to understand your financial history




CIFAS – to check both National and Internal databases for fraudulent activity. The personal information we have collected from you will be shared with Cifas who will use it to prevent fraud, other unlawful or dishonest conduct, malpractice, and other seriously improper conduct. If any of these are detected, you could be refused certain services or employment. Your personal information will also be used to verify your identity. Further details of how your information will be used by us and Cifas, and your data protection rights, can be found here https://www.cifas.org.uk/fpn.




To complete these checks, you will be asked to provide your address history for the past six years, along with your full name and date of birth.




The successful candidate will be required to undergo a Basic DBS check to comply with our FCA compliance framework. A satisfactory Basic Disclosure showing no unspent convictions is a prerequisite for this position.




We may also ask for proof of your right to work status or evidence of any qualification or experience prior to being offered employment. Further information on how we collect and use your data during the recruitment process can be found in our Privacy Policy here https://billingfinance.co.uk/privacy-policy/




Billing Finance is an equal opportunities employer, and we understand that for some candidates to perform their best they may need some reasonable adjustments. If we can make your application journey with us more suitable for you, please do let us know and we will endeavour to help.
